title: Director, Puget Sound Real Estate & Facilities
description:
Overview

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As Director, Puget Sound Real Estate & Facilities, you will lead integrated facilities management (IFM) operations across Microsoft's largest and most complex campus portfolio, spanning owned and leased buildings, garages, labs, and shared amenity spaces in Redmond and the greater Puget Sound region. You will own the day-to-day operational health of the portfolio - building services, maintenance and lifecycle replacement, engineering and critical environments, mail and logistics, and workplace readiness - delivered primarily through strategic third-party vendor partners. This is a people leadership role. You will lead a team of Microsoft employees and a large extended vendor organization, set clear performance standards, and build the bench strength and succession depth the portfolio requires. You will bring strong financial acumen to a portfolio with a significant operating budget and a capital project pipeline in the hundreds of millions of dollars, driving disciplined forecasting, savings delivery, and transparent cost accountability. Success in this role depends on collaboration: you will partner closely with peer leaders across portfolio strategy and planning, commute operations, dining and events, projects, security, sustainability, EHS, Finance, Procurement, and Microsoft Digital to translate Microsoft's real estate strategy into an employee experience that is safe, reliable, sustainable, and cost-effective.



Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end integrated facilities management (IFM) service delivery for the Puget Sound portfolio - maintenance and engineering, critical environments, building automation, janitorial, landscaping, mail and logistics, and workplace readiness - ensuring safe, reliable, and high-quality operations at scale.

  • Own financial performance for the portfolio's operating and capital budgets: build and support annual budgets, deliver accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts, manage variance and emergent spend, identify and deliver year-over-year savings targets, and surface unbudgeted cost exposures early with clear options and recommendations.

  • Partner with Procurement and Finance on purchase order governance, invoice and approval controls, shared-savings models, and contract structure - applying analytical rigor and data to every spend decision.

  • Direct the performance of strategic vendor partners as an owner: set scope and service levels, run KPI and scorecard governance, lead formal performance reviews, hold partners accountable to SLA and quality standards, and drive continuous improvement in cost, responsiveness, and occupant satisfaction.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Microsoft employees - setting clear expectations, providing candid and supportive feedback, building career growth and succession depth, and modeling an inclusive culture where the team does its best work.

  • Collaborate as a peer leader across the Puget Sound leadership team and the broader Global Workplace Services organization - portfolio strategy and planning, commute operations, dining and events, projects and construction, workplace design, and regional operations - to align priorities, resolve tradeoffs, and drive one coordinated strategy.

  • Plan and execute lifecycle replacement (LCR), building refresh, reactivation, and decommission activity in partnership with project teams, sequencing work to minimize disruption to occupants and to protect business continuity across a live campus.

  • Represent Puget Sound IFM in quarterly business reviews and executive forums - preparing clear, data-grounded narratives on performance, risk, savings, and forward-looking initiatives and translating operational detail into leadership-ready decisions.

  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with business clients, campus stakeholders, and building leadership; proactively engage to solve problems and balance specific client needs against broader Microsoft interests.

  • Own operational readiness and resilience for the portfolio - emergency preparedness and mock drills, air quality and wildfire smoke response, severe weather, utility and power events - in partnership with Security, EHS, and Business Continuity.

  • Advance sustainability and compliance commitments across the portfolio, including energy and water performance, waste diversion, recycling and repurposing programs, indoor environmental quality, and regulatory obligations - ensuring compliance with all statutory requirements, Microsoft policies, and internal controls.

  • Champion technology, tooling, and process innovation in facilities operations (work order and service platforms, building orchestration and smart building capability, automation of manual processes), using data and reporting to drive decisions and measurable efficiency gains.

  • Drive change management and clear communication across a large stakeholder base, ensuring lessons learned and best practices are shared with peer regions and the global IFM community.

Microsoft Substrate is the foundational cloud platform that powers many of Microsoft’s most critical services including Exchange Online and M365 Copilot, providing shared infrastructure, identity, messaging, storage, and service-to-service capabilities used across Microsoft 365 and related cloud offerings. Substrate services operate at global scale and are designed to deliver high availability, reliability, and security for some of the world’s most demanding workloads.

We are seeking a Principal Site Reliability Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for building and operating Substrate services in highly regulated environments. In these environments, success depends not only on operational excellence, but also on strong software engineering fundamentals—clean, maintainable code; sound design decisions; robust telemetry; and disciplined engineering lifecycle practices that make systems reliable by design.

This role requires deep appreciation for software engineering as a reliability lever. You will lead teams that write and maintain production code, build automation and self-healing systems, and partner closely with feature engineering teams to ensure reliability, diagnosability, security, and compliance are embedded early in design and sustained throughout the service lifecycle. As a Principal-level manager, you will scale impact through others—developing senior and principal engineers, shaping reliability and engineering strategy, and influencing how Substrate services are designed, implemented, and operated across organizational boundaries.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of Site Reliability Engineer ICs, providing clear expectations, regular coaching, and career guidance across senior and principal levels. Foster a culture of accountability, learning, and inclusion.

  • Own the operational health and reliability posture of Substrate services running in regulated environments, ensuring strong availability, incident readiness, and recovery practices.

  • Drive change and influence across the org as you establish and drive SLOs, SLIs, and operational metrics, using data and learning loops to continuously improve reliability, diagnosability, and customer experience.

  • Lead effective incident management and post-incident reviews, emphasizing systemic fixes, automation, and long-term resilience rather than short-term remediation.

  • Serve as an actively engaged on-call engineer (OCE) and participate in an on-call rotation, leading incident response for Substrate services in regulated environments, providing hands-on leadership during incidents, and driving high-quality post-incident reviews that result in durable engineering improvements.

  • Own reliability, resilience, and disaster recovery, including driving and coordinating DR and game day exercises, validating recovery objectives, and ensuring operational playbooks and restore procedures remain current, effective, and auditable.

  • Drive engineering led operational excellence at scale, leveraging strong software engineering practices, automation, and AI assisted techniques to reduce operational toil, improve diagnosability, and raise overall service and OCE health in partnership with infrastructure and service teams.

  • Partner with engineering and product teams to embed reliability, security, and compliance considerations early in service design, architecture, and deployment decisions.

  • Influence technical and operational strategy beyond your immediate team, particularly for cross‑cutting reliability and compliance challenges that span multiple services or organizations.

  • Represent your team’s work clearly to leadership and partners, articulating risks, trade‑offs, and progress in regulated environments with precision and credibility.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships with security, compliance, infrastructure, and operations teams to deliver durable, compliant, and auditable reliability outcomes.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Doctorate Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 2+ years technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, or systems administration
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ years technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, or systems administration
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 5+ years technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, or systems administration
    • OR equivalent experience.

title: SCS Clinical Specialist II- Sacramento, CA
description:
Additional Location(s): N/A

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

About the role:

Spinal Cord Stimulator Boston Scientific Neuromodulation

At Boston Scientific, we’re dedicated to improving the quality of life for millions of people living with chronic pain. Our Neuromodulation team delivers personalized pain solutions using innovative, evidence-based technologies that make a real difference for patients and physicians.

As a Clinical Specialist 2, you’ll partner with healthcare professionals to support implant procedures, provide technical expertise, and ensure the best outcomes for patients. You’ll join a passionate team that never stops advancing pain management through innovation, service, and care.

If you’re driven to help others and want your work to truly matter, join us and help change lives.

Your Responsibilities will include:

  • Provide expert clinical support through programming, troubleshooting, and intraoperative guidance for spinal cord stimulation procedures.
  • Deliver patient follow-up care, ensuring optimal therapy performance and long-term success.
  • Partner with the sales team and healthcare professionals to drive therapy adoption and deliver exceptional clinical outcomes.
  • Educate customers on the merits and proper clinical usage of company products by giving presentations and demonstrations using a wide variety of formats and platforms (e.g., slides, transparencies, manuals) to keep all customers abreast of the latest product, therapy, technological developments, and current items of interest in the industry.
  • Lead educational initiatives for customers by presenting and demonstrating company products using diverse formats—including presentations, hands-on demonstrations, and digital platforms—to ensure healthcare professionals remain informed about the latest advancements in product technology, therapy options, and industry trends.
  • Work closely with physicians, hospital staff, and other healthcare providers to deliver tailored education regarding the clinical benefits and best practices for utilizing company products and patient care.
  • Engage clients through regular training sessions, workshops, and informational meetings to support optimal therapy outcomes and foster ongoing professional development.
  • Serve as a resource for current and prospective customers, providing updates on innovations and evidence-based therapies to support informed decision-making in pain management.
  • Actively participate in surgical cases within hospital and surgery center environments, providing hands-on support throughout procedures.
  • Take an integral role in patient follow-up care by regularly monitoring therapy progress, addressing patient needs, and collaborating with healthcare teams to ensure optimal outcomes and satisfaction with company products.
  • Leverage company resources to proactively identify potential patients and referral sources, providing education on neuromodulation and the benefits of pain management for chronic pain treatment.
  • Actively participate in the development and execution of community awareness initiatives designed to increase patient volume and drive engagement.
  • Develop relationships with hospital and ambulatory surgery center personnel (e.g., through conversation, meetings, participation in conferences) to make new contacts in other departments within the hospital and to identify key decision makers in order to facilitate future sales.
  • Build and nurture strong relationships with office, hospital, and ambulatory surgery center personnel by utilizing outstanding interpersonal communication skills. Through engaging conversations and effective meetings, you will establish new connections across various departments, identify key decision makers, and foster trust and collaboration to facilitate future sales opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and efficiently whenever the office reaches out, ensuring that inquiries and requests are addressed in a timely manner. Demonstrate reliability by maintaining open lines of communication and quickly providing the information, support, or assistance needed by office personnel.
  • Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner and in full compliance with all applicable regulatory guidelines. Failure to properly perform these duties may result in noncompliance with governmental regulations and could lead to disciplinary action, up to and including termination.
  • This position requires frequent travel throughout the assigned region, primarily day trips, with some overnight stays depending on business needs. Flexibility regarding the expansion or reduction of your geographic territory is essential.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2 years’ work experience in a sales and/or clinical role.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Medical device sales and/or clinical education experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Biology, Kinesiology or other science field.
  • Experience as Physical Therapy Assistant, RN, Chiropractor Assistant, Radiologic Tech or Surgical Tech or similar field.

Requisition ID: 633566

Overview

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Regional Security Operations Manager.

As a Regional Security Operations Manager in CO+I Physical Security, you will be part of a global team dedicated to delivering the most trustworthy security program to protect the personnel, infrastructure, data, and confidential information foundational to the Microsoft Cloud. You will be accountable for physical security operations at datacenters and other related facilities within the applicable region and will manage in-region Datacenter Security Operations Managers who are responsible for security operations in their respective metros. You will lead teams in collaborating with stakeholders to meet collective security requirements and provide security capabilities, anticipate specific insecurity and security disruption (e.g., life safety, business operations, reputation) and lead discussions on developing strategies for mitigating risks and responding to residual risks. You will communicate risk analysis findings and root cause analysis reports to internal and external stakeholders and leaders. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deeper physical security acumen and global security program management. The Regional Security Operations Manager must be located in the applicable region and there is a flexible work opportunity to work from home partially or fully.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Regional Security Operations Manager you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

title: Americas - Frontier Industry Advisor - Insurance
location: United States, New York, New York
description:
Overview

Americas – Frontier Industry Advisor – Insurance

Are you passionate about insurance industry transformation for the AI era? Insurance is undergoing a fundamental shift in how carriers, brokers, reinsurers, and benefits providers grow, operate, manage risk, and serve customers. Insurers are moving away from experimentation to enterprise-scale transformation, reshaping underwriting, claims, distribution, policyholder engagement, risk modeling, fraud detection, compliance, and employee productivity. By applying trustworthy, secure, scalable AI, Microsoft is helping insurers reimagine their businesses from outcomes inward, using breakthrough technologies to simplify operations, improve decision quality, deepen customer trust, and unlock new sources of growth. Microsoft’s Frontier Industry Advisory team is at the heart of that innovation, working directly with insurance business leaders to rewrite the playbook in light of disruption while living to the mission and business objectives of their industry.

As a Frontier Industry Advisor on the Americas Frontier Insurance Industry team, you will help Microsoft’s most strategic insurance customers define and execute AI-led transformation agendas. This role is responsible for originating industry-led business opportunities and executive conversations that connect business outcomes to Microsoft cloud, data, AI, security, and partner capabilities. You will be the insurance industry subject matter expert engaging with senior business decision makers to identify, generate, and nurture transformational opportunities. You will go deep with select customers to help them move beyond isolated pilots toward governed, scalable AI adoption that delivers enterprise outcomes such as profitable growth, combined ratio improvement, claims and underwriting efficiency, better customer and agent experience, operational resilience, and regulatory trust. And you will develop Microsoft’s frontier insurance practice overall through thought leadership, targeted customer engagements, and strategic planning with Microsoft’s account teams and industry leadership.



Responsibilities

Planning and Engagement

Serves as the insurance industry subject matter expert in digital and AI transformation and account planning. Engages internal stakeholders on account planning and partner business planning, including key business leaders, global systems integrators, independent software vendors, solution partners, and Microsoft account teams. Reviews customer industry plans and lends credibility by aligning Microsoft capabilities to strategic insurance priorities.

Brings a multi-year strategic insurance perspective to account planning. Applies knowledge of insurance market dynamics, AI adoption, legacy modernization, rising claims costs, climate and catastrophe risk, distribution change, aging workforces, evolving customer expectations, regulatory scrutiny, and the shift from reactive risk transfer to proactive risk prevention and advisory models.

  • Leads multi-horizon planning that connects customer outcomes, business processes, data foundations, AI capabilities, governance models, and technology investments. Helps customers define roadmaps from near-term productivity and modernization opportunities to enterprise-scale AI operating model transformation.

  • Builds and maintains relationships with senior executive-level business decision makers. Acts as an industry advisor to executive teams by understanding their business strategy, operating model, market pressures, regulatory environment, and opportunities to create value with Microsoft technologies and partners.

  • Identifies stakeholders, decision makers, influencers, and implementation leaders for strategic insurance transformation opportunities and engages with those leaders to make it happen. Helps teams connect business sponsors, technology leaders, risk and compliance leaders, operations executives, and partner ecosystems around a shared transformation agenda.

Sales Execution

Identifies customer needs, industry readiness, and business value opportunities across the insurance value chain, including underwriting, claims, distribution, customer service, policy administration, actuarial and risk modeling, fraud detection, reinsurance, group benefits, life insurance, property and casualty, specialty insurance, and insurance brokerage.

Leads industry-led conversations that connect Microsoft technology to measurable business outcomes. Helps customers understand how AI, agentic workflows, data platforms, copilots, automation, security, and governance can improve speed, accuracy, cost, customer experience, employee effectiveness, and risk decisioning.

Uses an outcomes-inward approach to shape market-making opportunities. Starts with the customer outcome, such as faster turnaround, higher underwriter throughput, reduced claims cycle time, improved fraud detection, personalized policyholder engagement, increased producer productivity, or lower operational complexity, and works backward to the process, architecture, data, AI, and change-management requirements.

Collaborates with account teams, rapid deployment teams, and other internal stakeholders to build and mature pipeline across the insurance industry territory. Conducts research with customers on their markets, operating models, pain points, and opportunities to apply AI and cloud technologies to enterprise-scale transformation.

Represents the insurance industry perspective in customer conversations and ideation sessions. Helps create a shared vision and future direction for how Microsoft technology can transform the customer’s business from the front office to the core operational estate.

Identifies, advances, and scales high-impact repeatable scenarios for strategic accounts, including agentic claims orchestration, AI-assisted underwriting, intelligent document processing, producer and broker copilots, claims fraud investigation, customer service automation, climate and catastrophe analytics, risk placement workbenches, actuarial modeling modernization, compliance support, and enterprise knowledge assistants.

Helps customers move beyond AI pilots to scalable, enterprise-ready transformation. Encourages customers to rethink operating models, redesign workflows, modernize data foundations, and integrate responsible AI practices so AI becomes a source of sustainable business performance.

Creates and maintains an insurance-focused vision with business and technology solution scenarios that help large-scale, high-stakes customers achieve industry-relevant outcomes, advance their long-term corporate vision, and maximize commercial success.

Leads and facilitates strategic discussions with board-level and senior executive stakeholders at customers and within Microsoft to define the future state of insurance operations and show how Microsoft capabilities can help achieve it.

Articulates financial and strategic value cases in insurance business metrics. Connects Microsoft solutions to outcomes such as premium growth, improved loss and expense ratios, faster claims resolution, better risk selection, increased retention, improved agent and employee productivity, stronger compliance, and higher customer trust.

Originates, develops, and drives transformational opportunities and multi-year partnerships. Works with account teams to translate customer priorities into opportunity strategies, solution plays, partner motions, executive alignment, and commercial execution.

Acts as a trusted advisor who can shape, lead, and challenge strategic decision makers. Uses a compelling storyline, strong industry insight, and defensible business case to help customers understand the AI-led transformation journey and sequence that journey into practical action.

Collaboration and Partner Management

Collaborates with account teams, business strategy leads, business development managers, solution architects, technical specialists, industry solution teams, consulting teams, and partner organizations to plan, orchestrate, and execute customer opportunities.

Works across the Microsoft partner ecosystem to bring together capabilities that solve complex insurance business problems. Helps customers understand how Microsoft cloud, data, AI, security, low-code, productivity, business applications, and partner solutions come together into practical, outcome-oriented transformation patterns.

Coordinates with commercial, legal, compliance, engineering, and customer success teams to establish formal partnerships and advance strategic programs that support customer transformation, Microsoft growth, and long-term trust.

Industry Expertise

Builds and maintains knowledge of insurance industry trends, Microsoft capabilities, competitive dynamics, partner solutions, regulatory considerations, and emerging AI patterns. Maintains a perspective on how AI is transforming insurance from task-level automation to enterprise-scale operating model change.

Serves as an insurance thought leader within Microsoft and with customers. Advises internal teams on industry trends, customer pain points, emerging use cases, and market-making opportunities where Microsoft solutions can support insurance outcomes.

Provides feedback across the Microsoft ecosystem, including sales, marketing, engineering, partner, solution, and product teams, to inform future product direction, solution development, industry messaging, and sales execution.

Helps customers and internal teams understand the implications of responsible AI in insurance, including transparency, explainability, human oversight, model governance, privacy, security, bias mitigation, regulatory compliance, and auditability.

Advises and presents at customer, partner, and industry forums. Contributes to industry communities and executive engagements that position Microsoft as a strategic partner for AI-led insurance transformation.

Establishes a learning baseline for less experienced colleagues and shares industry knowledge, customer insights, and patterns that improve team capability and field execution.

Other

Embody Microsoft’s culture and values.



Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant technology, business, or strategy field AND 7+ years of customer-facing experience in insurance, financial services, management consulting, consultative selling, enterprise technology, digital transformation, data, AI, or industry-relevant equivalent management or technical work experience OR Master’s Degree in a related field AND 5+ years of customer-facing experience in insurance, financial services, management consulting, consultative selling, enterprise technology, digital transformation, data, AI, or industry-relevant equivalent management or technical work experience OR 10+ years experience in a consultative sales, advisory, strategy, transformation, or industry leadership capacity within the insurance industry, serving insurance customers through enterprise technology, management consulting, professional services, systems integration, fintech, insurtech, or related industry roles.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with insurance business leaders on transformation opportunities across areas such as underwriting, claims, distribution, customer experience, policy administration, actuarial and risk modeling, fraud, compliance, life insurance, property and casualty, reinsurance, brokerage, group benefits, or specialty insurance.
  • Ability to engage senior business decision makers, shape business value propositions, and translate strategic insurance priorities into technology-enabled transformation opportunities.
  • Working knowledge of cloud, data, AI, automation, security, and modern application capabilities as applied to regulated financial services and insurance environments.
  • Proven ability to work across account teams, solution teams, engineering, partners, consulting organizations, and senior customer stakeholders to shape complex transformation programs and drive execution.
  • Knowledge of insurance business and technology domains, including claims, underwriting, distribution, policyholder engagement, producer and broker productivity, actuarial modeling, risk management, regulatory compliance requirements, core systems modernization, and customer experience.
  • Experience helping large enterprise customers move AI initiatives from ideation to production-scale transformation with measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience developing executive narratives, industry points of view, business cases, transformation roadmaps, co-innovation proposals, partner strategies, and multi-horizon account plans.

Overview

Microsoft Search & AI platform team delivers the cutting-edge infrastructure for Microsoft search and feeds experience which is used by billions of users. We are looking for a passionate platform developer to join us building the next generation of compute and storage fabric using in-house and open-source technologies. You will be hands-on in a massively scaled and distributed system. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud and machine learning technologies.

  • Share accountability of a wide array of assets and be comfortable with learning a broad array of technologies.
  • Design and implement features in a distributed environment using data to guide and measure success.
  • Debug and mitigate incidents in live production environments.
  • Participate in regular team scrums and communicate regularly and clearly with team members and leads.
  • Look for opportunities to use open-source technologies in our service or to share learnings, services and tools we have created with Microsoft broadly or the open-source community.

We are a fast-paced team with product releases every week. If you are self-motivated and want to make a large impact in the cloud serving area, then we are looking forward to meeting you!

This is a core engineering team dealing with tens of thousands production servers, sub-millisecond latency and millions of RPS traffic. We develop advanced vector search algorithms, optimize model acceleration kernels, and build large scale distributed deep learning serving system. Our system leverages popular open-source components including ONNX, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Docker, Kafka, g-RPC, etc. We work on wide range of CPU and GPU hardware for high-performance serving.

We are expanding our established deep learning platform to the largest scale in industry, in order to serve the growing demand of search volume, office intelligence and Dynamics experience. To do that, we are looking for a solid system engineer on performance analysis, components scaling-up, distributed system debugging, and new feature/algorithm development. Our projects collaborate with the Microsoft Research deeply. This is a great opportunity to work on a large production system with cutting-edge technology innovation.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. title: Product Manager
description:
Overview

We are the Windows Cloud organization at Microsoft; our product lines include Windows 365, a cloud service that streams the full Windows experience — apps, data, and settings — from the Microsoft cloud to any device. Building on that foundation, we are now creating Windows 365 for Agents: a secure, governed, cloud-hosted Windows environment purpose-built for AI agents to autonomously execute computer-use tasks on behalf of users and organizations. Agents need a real Windows desktop to operate the long tail of enterprise apps, browsers, and line-of-business tools — Windows 365 for Agents gives them one, with identity, isolation, observability, and policy controls inherited from Microsoft’s Zero Trust stack. Windows 365 is generally available since August 2021 with millions of active users across thousands of Enterprise customers, and Windows 365 for Agents extends that platform into the agentic era.



Responsibilities

As a Product Manager in Windows 365, you will lead product thinking at the intersection of AI agents, operating systems, and cloud infrastructure. You will shape how AI agents perceive, reason about, and act on a Windows desktop — defining the APIs, runtime primitives, safety guardrails, and admin controls that make agentic computing trustworthy at enterprise scale. You will work hands-on with frontier models, computer-use agent frameworks, and evaluation harnesses to turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into shipping product. You will partner deeply with engineering, applied science, and design, and represent the product to customers, partners, and the developer community. This role includes customer and partner meetings and a small amount of travel.



Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, Science, or other technical field

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of product or program management experience shipping software products, with hands-on experience building, integrating, or evaluating AI / LLM-powered features
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, agent frameworks, or computer-use / browser-use agents (e.g. building prompts, tools, evals, or end-to-end agent workflows)
  • Ability to write code or scripts (Python, TypeScript, or similar) well enough to prototype, run evaluations, and reason about API design — this is a builder role, not a purely strategic PM role
  • Strong product intuition for agentic experiences — designing for non-deterministic systems, defining success metrics, and shipping safely in the face of model behavior change
  • Experience with one or more of: operating systems and virtualization, identity and security, enterprise SaaS, developer platforms / SDKs, or AI evaluation and red-teaming
  • Excellent written communication — able to turn fast-moving AI research into crisp specs, customer-facing narratives, and decision documents for executive review
  • Comfort with ambiguity, bias for action, and a builder’s mindset — you would rather prototype an agent loop and look at traces than write a deck about it.

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft’s Observability & Intelligent Cloud team is reimagining how large-scale cloud services stay reliable. We build intelligent systems that help prevent incidents, detect failures earlier, accelerate diagnosis and mitigation, and reduce operational effort across Microsoft services.

Our work spans the full reliability lifecycle—from telemetry and anomaly detection to AI-assisted diagnosis, safe automation, and intuitive operational experiences. You will help create secure, scalable platforms that protect customers and enable engineering teams to operate services with greater speed and confidence.



Responsibilities
  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate reliable backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and automation workflows.
  • Create intelligent capabilities that turn large volumes of operational data into timely, actionable insights for engineering teams.
  • Apply software engineering and AI techniques to improve anomaly detection, alert correlation, incident diagnosis, and safe mitigation.
  • Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and turn lessons from live-service events into durable product and engineering improvements.
  • Partner with service teams, product managers, and engineers to understand reliability challenges and translate them into scalable solutions.
  • Improve the security, observability, performance, quality, and maintainability of the services you own.
  • Contribute to technical designs, documentation, operational readiness, and shared engineering practices.


Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems, cloud services, or large-scale backend platforms.
  • Strong technical depth in service architecture, reliability, debugging, performance, security, and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to lead ambiguous technical work from problem framing through design, execution, deployment, and production support.
  • Strong cross-team collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across partner teams.
  • Experience collaborating across teams and communicating technical concepts clearly to engineering and product stakeholders.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.



Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

title: 2027 Intern - Systems Engineer (Lycoming) - Williamsport, PA
description:
Why This Internship

As an intern with Textron, you’ll gain hands-on experience while exploring your interests and building new skills. You’ll be supported and challenged to contribute in meaningful ways – working on real projects alongside experienced professionals to prepare for future success.

Who We Are

We are Lycoming Engines, best known as a world leader in aircraft engines. Here at Lycoming Engines, we produce four-, six-, and eight-cylinder aircraft engines that power 60% of the world’s general aviation fleet. For nearly 100 years, we have earned a reputation for reliability and flexibility with our extensive range of aircraft engines trusted by pilots, owners, and general aviation enthusiasts. Lycoming Engines takes great pride in being the only U.S. owned and operated aviation piston engine manufacturer, and we build every engine as though we were going to fly it ourselves.

All efforts are backed by the strength of our parent company — Textron Inc. — which includes prominent brands such as Bell, Cessna and Beechcraft. Drawing from our diverse teams of experts and harnessing the unlimited power of teamwork, we put tomorrow’s technology in the world’s hands today.

Learn more about our products and history at Lycoming.com and TextronSystems.com.

Responsibilities

· Develop requirements and specifications for mechanical and electrical systems

· Develop certification plans and supporting artifacts to meet applicable regulatory compliance of these complex systems

· Develop trade study analysis with adequate support and supervision of senior engineers

· Testing of systems for both feasibility (engineering level) and certification (for-credit testing)

· Generate test reports based on test results and establish congruence from engineering leaders and/or Lycoming Organization Designation Authority (ODA)

· Assist with familiarization briefs to internal/external customers and cross-functional teams for alignment in scope of a project

· Assist Lycoming product support team with field related troubleshooting of current engine systems as an engineering representative

· Assist Lycoming production floor with engineering needs as required

title: Senior Contractmanager
description:
Is techniek jouw passie? Vind je het leuk om te werken aan het beheer en onderhoud van onze langdurige prestatiecontracten? En passen de termen teamspeler, verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel, resultaatgericht en klantgericht echt bij jou? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Word Senior Contractmanager bij Hanab Property Management in Vianen.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Als Contractmanager bij Hanab Property Management vervul jij een sleutelrol in het realiseren en optimaliseren van integrale prestatiecontracten binnen een complexe en dynamische omgeving, zoals onderwijs, cultuur, ziekenhuis en overheid. Je bent bekend met de processen en gevoeligheden van deze omgeving en weet hier effectief op te sturen.

Je bent integraal verantwoordelijk voor een contractportefeuille met een jaarlijkse waarde van circa €4 tot €6 miljoen, inclusief spin-off, aanvullende projecten en optimalisaties. Binnen deze kaders stuur je actief op kwaliteit, prestaties en financieel resultaat. Je geeft leiding aan een multidisciplinair team en zorgt voor duidelijke kaders, structuur en ontwikkeling van mensen. Je bent in staat om zowel op tactisch als strategisch niveau te schakelen en weet de vertaling te maken van contractafspraken naar concrete uitvoering.

Wat ga je doen:

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de integrale uitvoering en performance van meerdere contracten en het vermogen continu te schakelen tussen de verschillende omgevingen in onder meer tijd, aandacht en beschikbaarheid.
  • Aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van je team én individu, met focus op verantwoordelijkheden, samenwerking, eigenaarschap en resultaat.
  • Rapporteren en sturen op KPI’s en contractafspraken inclusief optimalisaties, innovaties en projectmatige uitbreidingen.
  • Verantwoordelijk voor (onderhouds)begrotingen en sturen op financiële doelstellingen.
  • Onderhouden van relaties met opdrachtgevers op tactisch niveau en fungeren als gesprekspartner bij voortgang, prestaties en escalaties.
  • Proactief signaleren en beheersen van risico’s en het doorvoeren van verbeteringen.
  • Adviseren van opdrachtgevers over MJOP/MJOB en bijdragen aan het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten.
  • Opstellen, monitoren en bijsturen van het acceptatie-, kwaliteits- en uitvoeringsjaarplan, zodat contractdoelstellingen en -afspraken structureel worden aangetoond en gerealiseerd.
  • Inrichten en verbeteren van processen binnen het contract, met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap.

Binnen deze functie krijg je veel ruimte en vertrouwen om invulling te geven aan je rol en de verdere professionalisering van contractmanagement binnen HPM. Groei is een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel: je ontwikkelt je richting contracten met een omvang tot circa €5–8 miljoen en speelt een actieve rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

WAT BRENG JE MEE?

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een technische of bedrijfskundige richting.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring als contractmanager binnen de utiliteit, bij voorkeur in een complexe omgeving zoals het onderwijs, cultuur, ziekenhuis en/of overheid.
  • Inhoudelijke kennis van beheer- en onderhoudsprocessen en het vermogen om deze te vertalen naar contractsturing en performance.
  • Kennis van complexe prestatiecontracten en vormen zoals UAV-GC, DB(F)M(O).
  • Ervaring met het aansturen en ontwikkelen van teams; je weet mensen te verbinden en in beweging te krijgen.
  • Sterk ontwikkeld verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en eigenaarschap over zowel resultaten als samenwerking.
  • Vermogen om te schakelen tussen operationeel, tactisch en strategisch niveau, afhankelijk van de situatie.
  • Proactieve en analytische houding, met oog voor risico’s, kansen en continue verbetering.
  • Flexibiliteit en stressbestendigheid in een dynamische omgeving met uiteenlopende belangen.

WAT HEBBEN WE JE TE BIEDEN?

Jij mag onder andere het volgende verwachten als je bij ons komt werken:

  • Een informele en prettige werksfeer. We werken in een platte organisatiestructuur, dat betekent dat alle deuren altijd voor iedereen open staan;
  • Volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen en genoeg doorgroeimogelijkheden;
  • De salarisschaal loopt van € 4612 tot € 8000 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. Indeling is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, opleiding en ervaring;
  • Een auto passend bij jouw functie en functiegroep;
  • Goed materiaal voor goede professionals. Of het nou een telefoon van de zaak, een bedrijfsauto, een laptop of gereedschap is, bij ons ben je verzekerd van goed materiaal;
  • Wij vallen onder de CAO metaal en techniek technisch installatiebedrijf. Dit betekent een goed pensioen, 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV dagen;
  • Wij hechten veel waarde aan het welzijn van onze medewerkers, daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijke leasefiets-regeling aanWe zien graag dat jij met veel plezier bij ons werkt en geloven dat fysieke en mentale gezondheid daarvoor belangrijk zijn. Daarom bieden we de mogelijkheid om samen met jouw collega’s gratis deel te nemen aan diverse sportevenementen, zoals Limburgs Mooiste, padell-toernooien en hardloopwedstrijden.

LATEN WE KENNISMAKEN!

Enthousiast? Stuur dan direct je sollicitatie. Heb je inhoudelijke vragen, bel of whatsapp dan met Tom Werkhoven (Business Unit Manager Hanab Property Management) +31 (0)6 1160 1786

Let op: Wanneer bureaus ongevraagd een kandidaat voorstellen, kunnen hier geen rechten aan worden ontleend. Wij behouden ons het recht voor om zelf een keuze te maken en de verdere selectieprocedure te volgen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Administrativ Koordinator
description:
På PwC bygger vi långsiktiga relationer och omvandlar utmaningar till möjligheter. Genom att uppmuntra samarbete och en öppen dialog skapar vi förtroende och värde – för våra kunder, för samhället och för dig. Hos oss får du möjlighet att växa, bidra med nya idéer och arbeta i projekt som gör skillnad. Vi drivs av en gemensam ambition: att skapa förtroende och bidra till positiv förändring som håller över tid. Genom att kombinera den senaste tekniken med våra olika perspektiv utvecklar vi morgondagens företag och organisationer – tillsammans.

Bli en del av PwC:s administrativa team

I närmsta teamet är vi 7 målmedvetna och härliga administratörer. Jag som din närmsta chef leder med fokus på tydlighet, tillit och mänsklighet. För mig är det viktigt att alla i teamet känner sig engagerade och viktiga för helheten. Genom att sätta gemensamma mål och ge kontinuerlig feedback vill jag skapa en arbetsplats där vi ständigt växer och trivs. Tillsammans skapar vi en arbetsmiljö där alla känner sig sedda och motiverade att göra sitt bästa.

Vi erbjuder attraktiva förmåner som gör vardagen lite enklare och roligare. Hos oss värdesätter vi också gemenskap och ordnar regelbundet roliga aktiviteter, både i mindre grupper och tillsammans med hela företaget, för att stärka teamkänslan och skapa en trivsam arbetsmiljö.

Från årsskiftet sitter vi i vårt nybyggda huvudkontor i Stockholm på Tegelbacken 4. Vi är en flexibel hybridarbetsplats när arbetet så tillåter.

Är du vår nya Administrativa koordinator?

Vi söker dig som har några års erfarenhet i liknande roll och som trivs med att ge förstklassig service. Du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift. Du har god vana av att arbeta i Office-paketet och vi ser gärna att du är i framkant när det kommer till digitala kunskaper.

Dina personliga egenskaper spelar en stor roll och vi söker dig som är strukturerad, noggrann, proaktiv och lösningsorienterad. Du är flexibel och har förmågan att växla mellan olika uppgifter som tjänsten kräver. Du arbetar självständigt men kan också samarbeta när det krävs. Du är ansvarstagande, har hög integritet och förmåga att hantera konfidentiell information. Du gillar att skapa kontakter och bygga nätverk. Vidare tror vi att du är en serviceinriktad och kvalitetsmedveten person som bidrar med en okomplicerad och positiv energi.

Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter

Du kommer att vara ett administrativt stöd till ett eller flera team där du i huvudsak stöttar partners (ägare) och gruppchefer samt viss support till konsulter på avdelningen. Du kommer att fungera som ett nav på avdelningen och ditt uppdrag blir att självständigt, effektivt och noggrant stötta avdelningen.

Dagarna och arbetsuppgifterna varierar men kommer i huvudsak att fyllas med följande arbetsuppgifter:

  • Kalenderhantering
  • Fakturering, kontera leverantörsfakturor, reseräkningar samt annan projektadministration
  • Förbereda presentationer
  • Planera och ansvara för möten, interna events och aktiviteter
  • Koordinering av resor och tillhörande administration
  • Vara behjälplig i onboarding- och rekryteringsprocesser
  • Restaurangbokningar inkl. beställningar av frukost, luncher etc.
  • Övriga administrativa och koordinerande arbetsuppgifter

Rekryteringsprocessen

Vi kommer att gå igenom ansökningarna löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas tidigare än sista ansökningsdagen.

Vi ber dig bifoga följande handlingar med din ansökan:

  • CV

Tillträde: så snart som möjligt

Vi tror på att ha en rekryteringsprocess som gäller för alla. För att bidra till en opartisk och rättvis urvalsprocess inkluderar vi arbetspsykologiska tester.

Vi värdesätter det personliga mötet för att se vilket värde just du kan tillföra PwC men också vad vi kan erbjuda dig. Intervjuprocessen består vanligtvis av flera steg och olika typer av intervjuer. När du träffar HR, har du en kompetensbaserad intervju där vi tittar på personlighetstestet som du genomfört innan intervjun. Vid intervjun med verksamheten får du möjlighet att träffa det aktuella teamet för att gå igenom rollen. Vi kallar till intervju löpande.

För frågor angående tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare nedan.

title: IT-Specialist
description:
Vill du utveckla säkra och moderna lösningar som gör konkret skillnad för våra motorförsäkringskunder? Som IT‑specialist/systemutvecklare inom Motorområdet får du arbeta med .NET och moderna webbramverk i ett agilt team där samarbete, kvalitet och affärsnytta står i fokus. Du deltar i hela utvecklingsprocessen – från design och utveckling till testning, driftsättning och förvaltning – och är med och säkerställer robusta, säkra och affärsnyttiga IT‑lösningar.

Om jobbet
Vi söker en systemutvecklare med fokus på .NET inom Motorområdet. Rollen innebär deltagande i hela utvecklingsprocessen: design, utveckling, testning, driftsättning och förvaltning av säkra och moderna applikationer/integrationer, både webb och backend. Huvudansvar inkluderar att säkerställa robusta, säkra och affärsnyttiga IT‑lösningar samt bidra till teamets gemensamma leveranser.

Du ingår i ett systemteam om cirka 6–10 personer inom Motorområdet. Teamet består av utvecklare, testare, Scrum Master och produktägare. Närmaste samarbeten sker inom teamet, men du har även kontaktytor mot affär, IT‑drift och andra specialistteam. Arbetssättet är agilt med stort fokus på samarbete, gemensamma mål och ständig kunskapsdelning. Rollen rapporterar till närmaste chef och innebär löpande kontakter med produktägare, verksamhet, IT‑stöd och externa partners beroende på projekt och process.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:

  • Utveckla, underhålla och optimera applikationer i .NET.
  • Vidareutveckla och förvalta befintliga system (webb och backend).
  • Arbeta med Blazor, Angular, SQL Server, CI/CD och OpenShift.
  • Övervaka och förbättra system med Splunk, Dynatrace och ServiceNow.
  • Säkerställa säker kod och hög kvalitet med bland annat Checkmarx.
  • Delta i kravarbete samt samarbeta med produktägare och andra intressenter.
  • Hantera incidenter, felsöka samt dokumentera.
  • Föreslå och implementera process- och teknikförbättringar.
  • På sikt: ta utökat ansvar inom arkitektur, DevOps eller systemintegrationer.

Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:

  • Akademisk examen inom datateknik, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande.
  • 2–5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling.
  • Gedigen kompetens inom .NET‑utveckling (C#).
  • Erfarenhet av webbteknologier såsom Blazor och Angular.
  • Kännedom om databaser och integrationer, gärna SQL Server.
  • Erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git.
  • Erfarenhet av CI/CD och deployment pipelines är ett plus.
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Meriterande är även om du har:

  • Certifiering inom .NET eller Guidewire.
  • Erfarenhet av agila ramverk/certifiering (t.ex. SAFe).
  • Erfarenhet av Guidewire.
  • Erfarenhet av monitoring/loggning (Splunk, Dynatrace, ServiceNow).
  • Erfarenhet av testautomatisering och säker kodgranskning (Checkmarx).

Som person är du en lagspelare som bidrar till gott samarbete och delar kunskap med teamet. Du är analytisk och problemlösande, med förmåga att identifiera och lösa tekniska problem snabbt och effektivt. Du trivs i ett agilt sammanhang, tar ansvar för dina leveranser och uppskattar en miljö där man kontinuerligt förbättrar både teknik och arbetssätt.

Kontaktpersoner
Rekryterande chef: axel.ornevall@lansforsakringar.se
Facklig representant Forena: susanne.Hirsch2@lansforsakringar.se
Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: maria.eriksson@lansforsakringar.se


Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.

title: Teamleider Incidentenbestrijding Zuid
description:
Jij geeft richting aan een team dat 24/7 klaarstaat om incidenten op het spoor veilig en effectief af te handelen.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Als Teamleider Incidentenbestrijding zorg jij ervoor dat onze medewerkers veilig, vakbekwaam en met vertrouwen hun werk kunnen doen. Jij bent in de eerste plaats een coachend leidinggevende en competentieverantwoordelijke. Je helpt medewerkers zich te ontwikkelen, zet hen in hun kracht en creëert een veilige werkomgeving waarin leren, samenwerken en elkaar aanspreken vanzelfsprekend zijn.

Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 25 medewerkers en bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar. Je weet wat er speelt in de operatie, spreekt de taal van de buitendienst en begrijpt de uitdagingen van een 24/7-organisatie. Hoewel je voornamelijk vanuit kantoor werkt, ben je regelmatig aanwezig bij oefeningen en incidenten om feeling te houden met de praktijk en je team optimaal te begrijpen en ondersteunen.

Je bent een verbinder die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen de operatie, het management en andere regio’s. Je vertaalt signalen uit de praktijk naar het managementteam en zorgt er tegelijkertijd voor dat veranderingen begrijpelijk en uitvoerbaar zijn voor je medewerkers. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met de regiomanager, die je adviseert over de ontwikkeling van het team.

Met jouw coachende leiderschap bouw je aan een team waarin medewerkers verantwoordelijkheid nemen, zich blijven ontwikkelen en iedere dag bijdragen aan een veilige en betrouwbare spooromgeving.

Goed leiderschap

Als leidinggevende creëer je een omgeving waarin medewerkers zich verbonden voelen met het eindresultaat voor reiziger, verlader en omgeving. Je bouwt aan een bevlogen team dat samen resultaten behaalt in een omgeving die steeds verandert. Je geeft medewerkers de ruimte zichzelf te zijn en daagt hen uit het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Jouw leiderschapsstijl sluit je moeiteloos aan bij wat de situatie en medewerkers nodig hebben: zowel resultaatgericht als mensgericht. Het herkennen van talent en het ontwikkelen van potentie horen daar vanzelfsprekend bij. Daarbij leg je de nadruk op resultaat en eigenaarschap. Je kijkt verder dan je eigen domein, hebt oog voor het geheel en handelt steeds in het belang van de klant.

Jouw plek

We bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien we talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als Teamleider Incidentenbestrijding is er een plek binnen Incidentenbestrijding Regio Zuid, met standplaats Eindhoven.

Samen met de regiomanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en het functioneren van het team. Je geeft leiding aan de medewerkers, begeleidt hen in hun vakmanschap en zorgt ervoor dat zij beschikken over de juiste competenties om hun werk veilig en professioneel uit te voeren. Daarbij krijg je veel ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid om zelfstandig invulling te geven aan jouw rol. Je komt terecht in een dynamische omgeving waarin geen dag hetzelfde is. Juist daarom weet jij rust en structuur te brengen, houd je overzicht en zorg je voor verbinding tussen mensen, teams en verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.468,- en € 6.258,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, schaal 8.

Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.

The Customer & Commercial Success (CCS) organization, an organization within MCAPS-Core, is the connected engine that turns Microsoft’s commercial strategy into execution at scale — making it simpler and faster for the field to win for every customer, in every segment, region, and role. The organization brings together planning, landing, execution excellence, services portfolio and delivery, and field activation across ATU, STU, and CSU to accelerate customer value, drive growth, and strengthen the end-to-end experience across every customer moment.

The Capacity Shared Services team builds and operates the shared tooling, data, predictive insights, demand-management practices, and operating processes used across Microsoft’s AI and non-AI capacity functions. As a lean Functional Center of Excellence, the team owns the “how” of capacity management by creating one connected operating system from demand intake and prioritization through routing, decisioning, reporting, escalation, and field enablement. By providing common capabilities once for use across AI Capacity, Non-AI Capacity, and White Glove, the team reduces fragmented processes, manual reporting, tool sprawl, and dependency on individual heroics while establishing a common data and reporting backbone, demand-driven intake, self-service workflows, and forward-looking signals. This enables the capacity organization to match constrained supply with the highest-value demand, improve the customer and field experience, accelerate decision-making, and manage capacity as one end-to-end business from demand through delivery.

Want to help shape the AI era? AI and cloud technologies are transforming industries, and Microsoft helps customers seize that opportunity. Trusted for mission-critical workloads, Azure provides a secure, responsible path to build with AI — with AI and non-AI capacity as a strategic lever for success.

As the Business Program Manager – Organic Capacity Demand, you will help create and scale the programs that make capacity planning a standard part of commitment planning and strategic pursuit execution. You will translate capacity requirements into clear, repeatable field motions that help account teams identify customer demand earlier, improve preferred-region and workload planning, and reduce capacity-related risk before and after customer commitments are made.

This is a hands-on program-building role. You will work across sales, finance, customer success, capacity, and engineering teams to design practical guidance, operating rhythms, enablement, reporting, and delivery offers that make the right field behavior easy to understand and repeat. A key part of the role will be shaping capacity-specific customer engagements.

This important role sits within Capacity Shared Services in MCAPS Core, where AI and non-AI capacity are managed as one business under the One Capacity approach. You will partner with MACC, Strategic Pursuit Team, delivery, sales, customer success, and capacity stakeholders to move capacity planning from a late-stage escalation activity to an embedded component of account planning, deal shaping, customer success, and consumption execution.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  • Develop repeatable operating models that enable efficient capacity planning, forecasting, and execution across Capacity Shared Services

  • Lead change management efforts that improve planning quality, workload readiness, and operational effectiveness.

  • Partner with Unified, Industry Solutions Delivery, Services Sales, and capacity stakeholders to operationalize scalable delivery models.
  • Ensure offerings improve customer outcomes, execution quality, and business impact.

Operational Excellence & Rhythm of Business

  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and action plans to support high-priority customer opportunities.
  • Drive governance, reporting, and business management processes that improve predictability, accountability, and execution excellence.

Business Insights & Continuous Improvement

  • Convert successful practices into scalable global motions that improve business performance and operational efficiency.

title: AI Workforce Transformation Architect
description:
Overview

Microsoft Frontier Company is redefining how enterprises transform — bringing agentic AI, cloud-scale computing, data, simulation, and human expertise together so customers turn ambition into measurable business impact. As customers look to reinvent how work gets done — redesigning business processes, operating models, and human-agent ways of working across industries and functions — they need more than a platform. They need experts who can understand their business outcomes, reinvent new ways of working, and enable their employees to adopt that change at speed.

The AI Workforce Reinvention Architect will be the expert on the ground with customers developing the new ways of working, deploying agents and AI to enable and reinforce those patterns, and empower customers to own the behavioral transformation as they evolve from AI experimentation to AI-native operations. In this role, you will own the end-to-end operations reinvention with the end results being a continuous, always-on cycle rather than a one-off program. You will embed AI-first ways of working into culture, processes, and performance systems, working directly with business, technology and HR leaders, along with Microsoft account teams, industry specialists, and engineers.

This is a role for people who do the higher-judgment human work that technology can inform but not perform. You will help customer reimage how people and agents work together – while shaping repeatable patterns specific to industries and functions. If you’re energized by making change stick rather than launching programs that fade, this role is for you.

In this role you bring a unique blend of technical, industry, and change management expertise. Your edge is translating a customer’s business outcomes into a tangible operating model, powered by agents, with a clear path for adoption. Customers feel confident investing in frontier transformation because they see a viable plan for their teams to transform in parallel.

Microsoft Frontier Company redéfinit la manière dont les entreprises se transforment en réunissant l’IA agentique, l’informatique à l’échelle du cloud, les données, la simulation et l’expertise humaine afin d’aider ses clients à convertir leurs ambitions en résultats commerciaux mesurables. Alors que les entreprises cherchent à réinventer la façon dont le travail est effectué en repensant les processus métier, les modèles opérationnels et les modes de collaboration entre humains et agents dans tous les secteurs et fonctions, elles ont besoin de plus qu’une simple plateforme. Elles ont besoin d’experts capables de comprendre leurs objectifs d’affaires, de concevoir de nouvelles méthodes de travail et de permettre à leurs employés d’adopter rapidement ces changements.

L’Architecte en Réinvention de la Main-d’œuvre par l’IA sera l’expert de terrain auprès des clients. Il ou elle développera de nouvelles méthodes de travail, déploiera des agents et des solutions d’IA pour soutenir et renforcer ces pratiques, et aidera les clients à prendre en charge leur propre transformation comportementale à mesure qu’ils évoluent de l’expérimentation de l’IA vers des opérations nativement alimentées par l’IA. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la réinvention complète des opérations, avec pour objectif un cycle continu et permanent d’amélioration plutôt qu’un programme ponctuel. Vous intégrerez des méthodes de travail fondées sur l’IA au sein de la culture, des processus et des systèmes de performance, en collaborant directement avec les dirigeants des secteurs d’activité, des technologies et des ressources humaines, ainsi qu’avec les équipes de compte Microsoft, les spécialistes de l’industrie et les ingénieurs.

Ce poste s’adresse à des personnes capables d’accomplir des tâches humaines à forte valeur de jugement, que la technologie peut éclairer sans pour autant les exécuter. Vous aiderez les clients à repenser la collaboration entre les personnes et les agents tout en développant des approches reproductibles adaptées à des secteurs et fonctions spécifiques. Si vous êtes motivé par l’idée d’ancrer durablement le changement plutôt que de lancer des programmes qui s’essoufflent avec le temps, ce rôle est fait pour vous.

Dans ce rôle, vous apporterez une combinaison unique d’expertise technique, sectorielle et en gestion du changement. Votre valeur ajoutée résidera dans votre capacité à transformer les objectifs d’affaires du client en un modèle opérationnel concret, soutenu par des agents intelligents, avec une feuille de route claire pour l’adoption. Les clients seront confiants dans leurs investissements en transformation de pointe parce qu’ils verront un plan crédible permettant à leurs équipes d’évoluer en parallèle.



Responsibilities

Workforce Reinvention

  • Define new ways of working and employee roles based on the customer’s industry, function, and business outcomes/KPIs

  • Design and deploy agents and AI systems that empower and scale employees and teams to execute

  • Deliver retraining programmes ensuring no employee is left behind

  • Embed AI adoption into performance evaluations and onboarding processes

  • Protect employee privacy to maintain trust and stay on the right side of regulations

Strategic Change Leadership

  • Design and execute comprehensive operating model changes powered by AI with enterprise scale, structured as a continuous, always-on cycle rather than a fixed, one-off sequence

  • Conduct AI/Agent readiness assessments to identify organisational barriers and enablers

  • Develop AI literacy plans that position AI and agents as new ways of working, not tools

  • Establish and lead AI Council and Champion networks to drive grassroots adoption through the informal networks of trusted peers

Adoption Programme Delivery

  • Implement a structured adoption framework powered by workplace adoption analytics and role-based enablement

  • Coordinate communications, training, and champion efforts across thousands of users

  • Drive behavioural change by creating recognition rather than pushing content at them

  • Scale training globally: live sessions, on-demand tutorials, internal support communities

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Facilitate business and technology leadership workshops and roundtables to design for required impact and scale

  • Ensure cross-functional collaboration across IT, HR, operations, and business unit leadership on how work will change and their hands-on role

  • Build trust through responsible experimentation and transparent communication

  • Monitor usage statistics and qualitative feedback, adjusting programmes to maintain momentum, and measure success by whether change persists at 90, 180, and 360 days

Réinvention de la main-d’œuvre

Définir de nouvelles méthodes de travail et de nouveaux rôles pour les employés en fonction du secteur d’activité, de la fonction et des objectifs d’affaires/KPI du client

Concevoir et déployer des agents ainsi que des systèmes d’IA permettant aux employés et aux équipes d’accroître leur efficacité et leur capacité d’exécution

Mettre en œuvre des programmes de requalification professionnelle afin qu’aucun employé ne soit laissé pour compte

Intégrer l’adoption de l’IA dans les évaluations du rendement et les processus d’intégration des nouveaux employés

Protéger la confidentialité des employés afin de maintenir la confiance et de respecter les exigences réglementaires

Leadership stratégique du changement

Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des transformations complètes du modèle opérationnel alimentées par l’IA à l’échelle de l’entreprise, dans le cadre d’un cycle continu et permanent plutôt que d’une initiative ponctuelle

Réaliser des évaluations de préparation à l’IA et aux agents afin d’identifier les freins et les leviers organisationnels

Élaborer des plans de maîtrise de l’IA qui présentent l’IA et les agents comme de nouvelles façons de travailler, et non comme de simples outils

Mettre en place et diriger des conseils de gouvernance de l’IA ainsi que des réseaux d’ambassadeurs afin de favoriser l’adoption à la base grâce aux réseaux informels de collègues de confiance

Mise en œuvre des programmes d’adoption

Déployer un cadre structuré d’adoption fondé sur les analyses de l’adoption en milieu de travail et sur un accompagnement adapté aux différents rôles

Coordonner les communications, la formation et les initiatives des ambassadeurs auprès de milliers d’utilisateurs

Favoriser le changement comportemental grâce à la reconnaissance plutôt qu’à une diffusion excessive de contenu

Déployer les programmes de formation à l’échelle mondiale : sessions en direct, tutoriels à la demande et communautés internes de soutien

Mobilisation des parties prenantes

Animer des ateliers et tables rondes avec les dirigeants des secteurs d’activité et des technologies afin de concevoir des solutions répondant aux objectifs d’impact et d’échelle requis

Assurer une collaboration transversale entre les équipes TI, RH, opérations et les responsables des unités d’affaires concernant l’évolution du travail et leur rôle actif dans cette transformation

Établir un climat de confiance grâce à une expérimentation responsable et à une communication transparente

Suivre les statistiques d’utilisation et les commentaires qualitatifs, ajuster les programmes pour maintenir l’élan et mesurer le succès en fonction de la pérennité du changement après 90, 180 et 360 jours



Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security) OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security) OR equivalent experience.

    Master en informatique, en technologies de l’information, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe ET au moins 6 années d’expérience dans les solutions technologiques, le développement de pratiques, l’architecture, le conseil et/ou un domaine technologique (p. ex., la sécurité) OU baccalauréat en informatique, en technologies de l’information, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe ET au moins 8 années d’expérience dans les solutions technologiques, le développement de pratiques, l’architecture, le conseil et/ou un domaine technologique (p. ex., la sécurité) OU expérience équivalente

  • 3+ years managing cross-functional teams.
