title: Americas - Frontier Industry Advisor - Banking
location: United States, New York, New York
description:
Overview

Americas – Frontier Industry Advisor – Banking

Are you passionate about banking industry transformation for the Frontier AI era? Banking is undergoing a fundamental shift in how institutions grow, operate, manage risk, meet regulatory expectations, and serve customers. Banks are moving from experimentation to enterprise-scale transformation, reshaping customer engagement, relationship management, lending, payments, deposits, treasury services, fraud and financial crime, credit and risk decisioning, compliance, operations, and core banking modernization. By applying trustworthy, secure, scalable AI, Microsoft is helping banks reimagine their businesses from outcomes inward—using breakthrough technologies to simplify operations, improve decision quality, strengthen resilience, deepen customer trust, and unlock new sources of growth. Microsoft’s Frontier Industry Advisory team is at the heart of that innovation, working directly with banking business leaders to rewrite the playbook in light of disruption while staying grounded in the mission and business objectives of the industry.

As a Frontier Industry Advisor on the Americas Frontier Banking Industry team, you will help Microsoft’s most strategic banking customers define and execute AI-led transformation agendas. This role is responsible for originating industry-led business opportunities and executive conversations that connect business outcomes to Microsoft cloud, data, AI, security, and partner capabilities. You will be the banking industry subject matter expert engaging with senior business decision makers to identify, generate, and nurture transformational opportunities. You will go deep with select customers to help them move beyond isolated pilots toward governed, scalable AI adoption that delivers enterprise outcomes such as profitable growth, improved operating leverage, faster and more trusted credit decisioning, stronger fraud and financial crime controls, better customer and banker experiences, operational resilience, and regulatory confidence. You will also develop Microsoft’s frontier banking practice through thought leadership, targeted customer engagements, and strategic planning with Microsoft’s account teams and industry leadership.



Responsibilities

Serves as the banking industry subject matter expert in digital and AI transformation and account planning. Engages internal stakeholders on account planning and partner business planning, including key business leaders, global systems integrators, independent software vendors, solution partners, and Microsoft account teams. Reviews customer industry plans and lends credibility by aligning Microsoft capabilities to strategic insurance priorities.

Brings a multi-year strategic Industry perspective to digital and AI transformation. Provides thought leadership via focus on broad global industry trends to evangelize worldwide industry strategies and/or large ecosystem plays into local market and/or must-win accounts. Drives stakeholder mapping to identify and influence key stakeholders and decision makers in the customer business. Partners locally with ISVs to inform industry knowledge. Participates in planning rhythms with core account team and other team members to discuss strategy needed to deliver on the account plan. Increases the speed of adoption of Microsoft technologies by plotting the strategic, long-term vision of the customer's/partner's business strategy and driving appropriate actions to bring it to fruition.

  • Leads multi-horizon planning to outline an approach for industry-oriented solution selling with the customer. Creates segment-focused three-horizon roadmaps for impactful accounts based on business and technology priorities, as well as deep understanding of their industry.

  • Builds and Maintains relationships with external senior- and executive-level decision makers and partners, leveraging targeted stakeholders at assigned customer.

  • Acts as an industry advisor to the executive-level business decision makers at the customer's business by applying deep understanding of their business strategy, market dynamics, relevant technology trends and Microsoft’s Industry point of view (POV).

Sales Execution

Identifies customer needs, industry readiness, and business-value opportunities across the banking value chain, including retail banking, commercial banking, corporate banking, payments, lending, deposits, treasury services, cash management, branch and contact center operations, customer service, marketing and personalization, financial crime and fraud, risk, compliance, regulatory reporting, data and analytics, core banking modernization, operations, and digital banking channels.

Leads industry-led conversations that position Frontier AI as a catalyst for banking transformation, connecting Microsoft technology to measurable business outcomes across revenue growth, operating leverage, credit and risk decisioning, fraud reduction, regulatory confidence, customer experience, employee productivity, and enterprise resilience.

Applies an outcomes-inward approach to shape market-making opportunities, starting with the customer outcome and working backward to the process, architecture, data, AI, security, governance, and change-management requirements needed to scale. Focus areas include faster customer onboarding, improved relationship manager and banker productivity, accelerated loan origination and servicing, improved fraud detection, enhanced credit and risk insights, stronger compliance controls, more efficient regulatory reporting, modernized branch and contact center experiences, personalized digital engagement, and resilient banking operations.

Collaborates with account teams, rapid deployment teams, industry solution teams, partner teams, and internal stakeholders to build and mature banking pipeline. Conducts customer and market research to understand operating models, revenue levers, cost pressures, credit and risk posture, regulatory priorities, data estates, and the highest-value opportunities to apply AI, cloud, and agentic workflow technologies to enterprise-scale transformation.

Represents the banking industry perspective in customer conversations and ideation sessions, helping create a shared vision for how Microsoft can transform the business from customer acquisition and engagement to credit decisioning, risk and compliance, operations, data and analytics platforms, payments, digital channels, branch and contact center experiences, and core banking modernization.

Identifies, advances, and scales high-impact Frontier AI scenarios for strategic banking accounts, including AI-assisted relationship management, banker and contact center copilots, intelligent document processing, loan origination and servicing automation, credit decisioning support, fraud and financial crime investigation, customer service automation, personalized digital banking, treasury and cash management workflows, regulatory and compliance automation, enterprise knowledge assistants, branch modernization, payments modernization, and core banking transformation.

Helps customers move beyond AI pilots to enterprise-ready Frontier AI transformation by rethinking banking operating models, redesigning workflows, modernizing data foundations, and embedding responsible AI, security, and governance at scale. Develops a banking vision and business-value cases that connect Microsoft technology to growth, productivity, risk reduction, resilience, regulatory readiness, customer experience, and long-term commercial success. Acts as a trusted advisor to senior decision makers, leveraging customer success, market insight, and banking priorities to shape strategic opportunities, expand solutions across business lines and regions, and incubate early-stage transformation pipeline.

Collaboration and Partner Management

Collaborates with account teams, business strategy leads, business development managers, solution architects, technical specialists, industry solution teams, consulting teams, and partner organizations to plan, orchestrate, and execute customer opportunities.

title: Senior Engineer - Security Engineering
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a Zscaler & Network Security Engineer responsible for administering, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuously improving secure internet access, endpoint connectivity, remote access, and security controls. The role will work closely with security operations, network teams, and senior security stakeholders to maintain a strong security posture while ensuring reliable user connectivity.
Key Responsibilities
  • Administer and maintain Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) policies, including:
  • SSL inspection
  • Application control
  • Sandbox policies
  • URL filtering
  • CASB controls
  • Malware exceptions, blocks, and security policies
  • Manage and troubleshoot Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) deployments, including installation, connectivity, authentication, policy enforcement, and endpoint-related issues.
  • Manage PAC file changes through a controlled, tested, peer-reviewed, and approved deployment process.
  • Monitor security alerts and operational dashboards, investigate issues, and resolve day-to-day security incidents within defined SLAs.
  • Raise, document, implement, and drive changes through formal Change Control processes, particularly where changes deviate from the approved security baseline.
  • Manage and troubleshoot VPN/remote-access solutions, such as Palo Alto GlobalProtect, addressing connectivity, authentication, performance, and user-access issues.
  • Use asset inventory and vulnerability-management tools, such as Qualys or similar platforms, to support troubleshooting, asset identification, security investigations, and vulnerability-management activities.
  • Review and assess policy, URL, application, and whitelisting requests, escalating higher-risk requests to senior security stakeholders for appropriate risk assessment and approval.
  • Apply least-privilege access principles across different user populations, including employees, contractors, privileged users, and executives.
  • Support security audits and compliance reviews by collecting, validating, and providing appropriate control evidence and supporting documentation.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Hands-on experience administering Zscaler ZIA and Zscaler Client Connector.
  • Strong understanding of web security concepts, including SSL inspection, URL filtering, application control, CASB, sandboxing, and malware protection.
  • Experience troubleshooting ZCC, PAC files, proxy connectivity, and endpoint access issues.
  • Experience with VPN technologies, preferably Palo Alto GlobalProtect.
  • Familiarity with security incident management, alert monitoring, and SLA-driven operations.
  • Understanding of Change Management and Change Control processes.
  • Experience using Qualys or similar vulnerability/asset-management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of least privilege, secure baselines, access control, and security governance.
  • Ability to assess security risks and appropriately escalate exceptions or higher-risk requests.
  • Strong documentation skills, including writing SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
Preferred Skills
  • Experience working in an enterprise Security Operations or Network Security environment.
  • Palo Alto Networks security technology experience.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability-management and security-compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting internal and external security audits.
  • Relevant certifications such as Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Security+, or equivalent.
Key Competencies
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Security-focused mindset
  • Attention to detail and risk awareness
  • Effective incident and change management
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Ability to work within defined SLAs and operational processes
  • Strong stakeholder management and escalation skills

Within Datacenter Engineering (DCE), Architects play a critical role in delivering the infrastructure that powers Microsoft's global cloud services. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional engineering, construction, and operations teams to design and deliver mission-critical datacenter facilities from site selection and master planning through construction and handover. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. title: Technical Product Lead - AI Investing App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Job Description

We’re a leading financial operations company that provide businesses and accounting firms with real-time financial control and visibility to do business anywhere in the world. With an innovative platform and 24/7 human support, we automate and simplify doing business across borders, reducing risk and eliminating routine operational tasks. We offer global business accounts, payments to 180 countries in 30+ currencies and currency risk management solutions. We further enhance business operations with corporate cards, spend management, bill payments, vendor management and integrations with accounting and HRIS software.

What you do

Your role will perform a range of engineering and analytics tasks as part of a cross‑functional data and insights team. Day to day, you will:

  • Experience with BigQuery, Looker Studio, Mixpanel, or DBT

description:
Overview

Aperçu du poste:

Notre objectif est de donner aux organisations les moyens de transformer leur façon de travailler en exploitant tout le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle. Dans l’équipe de « Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C) », nous dirigeons une équipe de vente mondiale en forte croissance, propulsée par l'IA — une équipe profondément connectée à nos partenaires et portée par la réussite client. En unissant nos équipes Petites Entreprises Moyennes, Entreprises, Stratégie et Partenaires, nous débloquons la plus grande opportunité client, soutenue par les investissements les plus importants de l'industrie. En tirant parti de la puissance de l'IA et de notre vaste écosystème de partenaires, nous redéfinissons la façon dont les entreprises de toutes tailles adoptent la technologie pour stimuler la croissance et l'innovation.

SME&C est plus qu'une organisation de vente — c'est une culture d'innovation, d'opportunités et d'inclusion. Ici, vous ferez partie d'une équipe diversifiée, performante et obsédée par la clientèle, où la collaboration, la connexion et l'apprentissage continu alimentent tout ce que nous faisons.

Si vous vous épanouissez dans un environnement dynamique, axé sur le numérique, et que vous souhaitez avoir un impact significatif, explorez comment PME&C peut être la prochaine étape de votre carrière. Ensemble, nous façonnons l'avenir des affaires.

Joignez-vous à Microsoft en tant que spécialiste des solutions numériques des processus d'affaires en IA. Dans ce rôle de contributeur individuel et porteur de quotas, vous serez responsable de tout le cycle d'engagement, en identifiant les opportunités, en élaborant des propositions de valeur et en favorisant des transformations des processus d'affaires alimentées par l'IA. En collaborant étroitement avec des cadres de compte, des ingénieurs en solutions numériques et des équipes marketing, vous concevez des stratégies gagnantes, livrerez des démonstrations et des pilotes convaincants, et réaliserez des plans de réussite client qui accélèrent l'adoption des solutions Dynamics 365, Power Platform et Copilot. En tirant parti d'une expertise approfondie du domaine et des compétences en vente consultative, vous transformerez des scénarios complexes en résultats d'affaires clairs, éliminerez les obstacles et atteindrez ou dépasserez constamment vos objectifs de revenus. Vous partagerez également les meilleures pratiques, élargirez votre profondeur technique et agirez comme un conseiller de confiance qui relie l'innovation Microsoft à un impact client mesurable, faisant progresser votre propre carrière dans la vente de solutions et les technologies infonuagiques.

Our purpose is to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence. We guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences. By integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications, we help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era.
At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation.
SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do.
If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.
Join Microsoft as an AI Business Process Digital Solution Area Specialist. In this individual-contributor, quota-carrying role you will own the entire engagement cycle, pinpointing opportunities, crafting value propositions, and driving AI-powered business-process transformations. Partnering closely with Account Executives, Digital Solution Engineers, and marketing teams, you will design win strategies, deliver compelling demos and pilots, and land customer success plans that accelerate adoption of Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Copilot solutions. Leveraging deep domain expertise and consultative selling skills, you will translate complex scenarios into clear business outcomes, remove blockers, and consistently meet or exceed revenue targets. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Toutefois, pour ce poste précis, la maîtrise de l’anglais constitue une exigence professionnelle justifiée en raison de tâches techniques et spécialisées nécessitant l’utilisation de l’anglais afin de répondre aux besoins de la clientèle, tout en travaillant de façon intégrée avec des collègues partout dans le monde. title: Data Center Technician
description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
  • Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
  • Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
  • Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
  • Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
  • Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
  • Embodies our culture and values.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree in IT or Telecommunications or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND 1+ year(s) industry work experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • This position requires verification of Indonesian Citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions applicable to the role and as a result, you will need to provide a valid Indonesian passport to verify your Indonesian Citizenship.

Whilst not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years' industry work experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

title: Metro Cost Lead
description:
Overview

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO&I) is the team behind the cloud. Within CO&I, the Engineering Procurement & Construction (EPC) organization is responsible for delivering core Data Center infrastructure for Microsoft’s cloud business. The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year Data Center construction projects. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build the cloud Data Centers that power the world’s largest online services.

To help us achieve our objectives, growth, and transformation, we are looking for a Metro Cost Lead for Sydney, Australia to work alongside the Metro Construction Director to commercially manage all Data Center construction projects. Being part of this team would give you an opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing business and enable regional impact.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

This role is a field-based role for the Sydney metro. 100% on-site role - this role is not eligible for hybrid or remote work.



Responsibilities

Cost Governance, Forecasting & Portfolio Commercial Management:

  • Own and maintain project and metro-level Budget at Completion (BAC), Estimate at Completion (EAC), and cashflow forecasts, ensuring alignment with approved funding and business objectives.
  • Lead monthly cost reviews with project teams, Cost Management consultants, Project Controls and key stakeholders to validate forecast accuracy, risks and opportunities.
  • Provide commercial oversight and governance of project contingency, including review of contingency drawdowns, change trends and forecasted exposure.
  • Provide the PER (funding) team all commercial support necessary to ascertain the required timing of the funding intervals and all commercial information needed to back up these funding requests to management. This will normally involve the production of multiple option cost scenarios.
  • Establish and maintain benchmark data across the metro portfolio, utilizing historical project performance to challenge costs, improve estimate quality and drive consistency.
  • Lead commercial risk identification and assessment throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring risks are quantified, tracked and reflected within project forecasts where appropriate.
  • Lead commercial governance of project change management, ensuring proposed changes are appropriately evaluated, challenged, approved and incorporated into project forecasts and funding requirements.
  • Review and recommend approval of pay applications, invoices and all vendor payment requests in accordance with Microsoft governance requirements.
  • Partner with Cost Management firm, GC and Project Controls to ensure cost reporting, commitments, accruals, forecasts and cashflow projections are accurate, timely and aligned with corporate reporting requirements.
  • Capture and apply lessons learned from completed projects to improve future estimating, procurement strategies, cost controls and commercial outcomes across the metro portfolio.

Deep understanding of the commercial management of the General Contractor (GC) from liaison with our procurement office on the Request for Proposal (RFP) documents through to the final payments and agreement of the final accounts and paperwork. This will also include:

  • Provide on-location commercial management to the projects to ensure that Microsoft is financially and contractually protected.
  • Lead cost planning, estimate validation and scenario analysis, including agreement of the contract sum.
  • Estimation of and commercial agreement of all change orders.
  • Review and provide commercial recommendation on subcontract Letters of Authorization (LOAs) and major subcontract package awards.
  • Provide commercial support and analysis relating to project disputes and claims.

Commercial management of all other program vendors including:

  • Provide commercial leadership, performance management and functional oversight to Cost Management consultants and project commercial resources supporting the metro portfolio, ensuring consistency in governance, reporting and commercial outcomes.
  • Presenting proposals to head office for purchase order approval.
  • Final account agreement & closeout for all vendor accounts.
  • Design Team commercial support: From project kick-off through to final design provide commercial support on business cases, value engineering studies and change control as the design evolves though to final decision.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction management, Engineering, or related field OR equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of experience managing estimating, cost management, quantity surveying, or commercial functions on major construction projects or portfolios.

  • 3+ years' experience with Data Centers, Mission-critical facilities, or similar complex infrastructure projects.

  • Experience delivering major construction projects with individual build values exceeding A$300M and/or managing construction portfolios with aggregate values exceeding A$500M.

  • Experience leading and managing external cost consultants, quantity surveyors, or commercial teams supporting major construction programs.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years' experience with procurement of General Contractor contracts and other construction vendors.
  • Demonstrated experience managing commercial or cost activities on major construction projects within the Sydney market.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and cross-functional forums.
  • Communication skills, ability to collaborate with all other areas of the Data Center program, think strategically, and build the trust of our construction partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand what “right” looks like contractually and financially and then negotiate with the other parties to ensure that this is the final position.
  • Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) full membership, Australian Institute of Quantity Surveyors (AIQS) full membership, or equivalent.

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Humanforce’s vision is to make work easier and life better for frontline and flexible workforces. Our HCM suite covers Workforce Management, HR, Talent, Payroll, and Wellbeing, and is designed to be highly integrated and composable.

Who you are

You will help build and run the data infrastructure for our real-time, customer-facing analytics platform. You’ll collaborate with a cross-functional squad and partner with our Senior Data Engineer to work across Streamkap, dbt Core, ClickHouse, and AWS to continually improve our data platform.

  • Warehouse: ClickHouse
  • Ingestion/CDC: Streamkap
  • Transformations: dbt Core
  • Cloud: AWS (S3, Lambda, ECS, EventBridge)
  • Infra/CI: Terraform, GitHub Actions

Nice to have

  • CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions.
  • Security-minded habits (IAM, tenancy isolation, PII handling).
  • Agile delivery experience (Jira) and code review via GitHub PRs.

Our values

  • We are bold
  • We are all in
  • We are customer obsessed
  • We do what we say
  • We are good humans

Our approach to flexibility

We support hybrid working where possible to help people be effective, empowered, and productive to achieve career and personal goals. Flexible working exists in many forms.

  • Flexible workplace through our Flex@HF approach
  • Fast-growing global tech company
  • Learning and development through Humanforce HR

title: Research Sciences INTERN

Microsoft Research Asia – Tokyo is committed to advancing cutting-edge AI technologies that enable deeper understanding and interaction with people, objects, and environments in the 3D real world. Our research spans a diverse range of areas, including computer vision, generative AI, 3D perception, and robotic action learning, among others relevant to Embodied AI. By pushing the boundaries of these domains, we aim to develop innovative solutions that bridge the gap between the digital and physical worlds, empowering AI systems to perceive, comprehend, and navigate complex real-world scenarios.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented PhD student to join our team as a Research Intern. This internship offers a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge research in the field of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), fundamental machine learning, computer vision, and Spatial AI, and Robotics, for realization of Embodied AI. title: Senior Quantum Test Engineer, cryo-mechanical and electrical
description:
Overview

Microsoft Quantum unites a talented and diverse international team working to create the world’s first scalable quantum computing system. Our full-stack approach advances innovation across the quantum computing stack—from fundamental physics and hardware to software, applications, and cloud integration—with the aim of addressing problems beyond the reach of today’s computers. In this role, you will help shape transformative technology while collaborating with theoretical and experimental physicists, hardware designers, and software engineers around the world. Our Denmark lab is seeking a Quantum Test Engineer, cryo-mechanical and electrical, specializing in cryogenic and mechanical systems for 4K cryogenic device measurements. You will perform hands-on hardware work, maintain and troubleshoot cryogenic setups and instrumentation, and support 4K measurement activities.

In this role, you will help deliver reliable 4K cryogenic measurement capabilities for the Microsoft Quantum program. You will build, maintain, and troubleshoot cryogenic hardware systems; integrate and validate cryogenic hardware and instrumentation; and support device measurements and smooth lab operations. Your hands-on experience with cryogenic systems, electronics, and hardware diagnostics will enable you to identify and resolve issues efficiently. Working closely with software, engineering, and supplier teams, you will improve procedures, documentation, inventory management, and safety practices. A practical, collaborative, and methodical approach will help you succeed in this rapidly evolving technology environment.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  • Assist in 4K measurement execution and collaborate with software and engineering teams to support robust and reliable lab operations

  • Design and build AI agents/copilots to document procedures, hardware configurations, and maintenance activities for knowledge sharing and reproducibility.

  • Manage and track hardware inventory: and coordinate procurement and restocking.

  • Uphold and improve safety standards and best practices in the cryogenic lab environment

  • Embody our culture and values.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or higher degree in Physics, Electronic Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred Qualifications

title: Data Center Technician (Nightshift)
description:
Overview

As a Data Center Technician (Nightshift), you will demonstrate expertise in standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment, as well as a holistic understanding of the functions of, and interactions between, network and server equipment. You will provide input for suggested modifications to these processes and procedures as needed to improve service quality and efficiency while providing guidance to other technicians.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.

Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role's job duties



Responsibilities

Datacenter Operations

  • Reviews Process Change Notifications (PCNs) and develops an understanding of the impact to work execution and awareness to changes within their area of work and/or the work of others. Asks questions when they do not have required information and may provide feedback on changes to processes to experienced technicians and/or direct-line management.
  • Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type with guidance from experienced technicians. Seeks guidance from more experienced technicians on challenging or complex tickets.
  • Receives guidance and supervision to develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning IT datacenter technology(ies) and equipment. Develops and acquires a fundamental understanding of the functions of, and interactions between cabling infrastructure, network, server, and storage equipment.
  • Complies with Data Center business unit policies, procedures, and deadlines with guidance from experienced technicians and/or direct-line management. Escalates issues related to compliance or operational assurance activities to direct-line management.

Datacenter Work Environment

  • Working for extended periods under elevated levels of ambient noise, heat, and light due to necessary equipment and ventilation systems.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with other shifts or technician teams, contributing in regular team meetings, asking questions, and partnering with other shifts of technician teams to complete smooth transition and effective handover of ticketed work. Encourages providing and responding to feedback received on ways to work more effectively or enhance efficiency within their team and adopts best practices shared within-and-across shifts or technician teams
  • Completes required security and data management training while complying with security and data management procedures/policies with guidance from other technicians. May escort third party vendors or IT support on-premises at data centers or network sites. Appropriately takes action and reports physical security access concerns and/or incidents to direct-line management or established reporting methods.
  • Participates in daily safety briefings. Completes required Environmental & Health Safety (EHS) training, complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use), completes required Task Hazard Analysis (THAs), and uses appropriate equipment and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for assigned tasks. Adheres to and promotes a culture of safety, taking proactive action to alert others of safety concerns, near-misses, and/or incidents. Participates in regular cadence proactive safety observation reporting processes and systems.
  • Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting up to 25lbs / 11kg without assistance. Occasional lifting 25-50lbs / 11-22.5kg with lift assistance. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.
  • Traveling up to 25% typically domestically to and from multiple locations during the workday, and occasionally domestically to other sites for overnight stays. May work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours such as evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
Managing Service
  • Maintains an awareness of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) through reporting dashboards, systems, for personal monthly performance discussions as needed.
  • Escalates and/or seeks guidance from experienced technicians or direct-line management regarding client interactions.
  • Develops an understanding of cross-functional Data Center processes to support partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Completes required training aligned to job focus areas and workloads (i.e., Break fix, Deployment, Simple Change, Decommission, IT Critical Environment) in a timely manner per direct-line management assignment(s). Observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training (OJT). May complete additional or supplemental training to obtain or maintain relevant industry or technical certifications.
Service Delivery
  • Develops an understanding of effective execution order strategy(ies) for assigned tasks with assistance from experienced technicians or direct-line management. Prepares, stages, sets up, and performs basic startups and shutdowns for hardware (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches) according to specific written instructions provided via checklists, guides, standard processes, emails, guidance from other technicians, and/or direction from management. May perform tasks in tandem with other technicians to comply with procedures and safety requirements.
  • Follows procedures to immediately communicate, report, and escalate data center technical or safety related incidents to direct-line management. May participate in bridge calls to provide details on incident status and executes on-site follow-up actions as directed if necessary.
  • Directly performs decommissions, simple changes (e.g., memory upgrades, OS rebuilds) and refreshes of infrastructure cabling, network, storage, and server equipment, following standard procedures whilst seeking clarification and guidance from more experienced technicians as needed. Processes data-bearing devices (DBDs) for destruction or confirms any-and-all such devices (e.g. hard-drives, solid-state drives, flash cards, etc.) contained within network, storage, or server equipment has been identified for eradication or destruction with guidance.
  • Performs basic diagnostics and troubleshooting with guidance from experienced technicians and/or via standard procedures to identify the cause(s) of technical issues and replace faulty components in network, storage, or server equipment with zero-to-minimal customer and/or business disruption. Develops awareness of conditions, circumstances, and scenarios which may reflect significant customer or business impact within the Data Center environment.
  • Learns about post-execution verification of grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling to align with all safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Templates (NDTs). Learns about errors in deployment standards or Network Design Templates (NDTs) and escalates to relevant technicians or specialists to coordinate corrections as needed.

title: Director, Partnerships & Channel Programs

Monetization Strategy & Licensing (MSL) sits at the center of Microsoft's commercial strategy. MSL is looking to hire a Director, Partnerships & Channel Programs. The organization brings together the teams that shape how Microsoft prices, packages, and monetizes commercial products, alongside the programs, partner motions, and operational frameworks that bring those models to market.

MSL's charter is to modernize the commercial engine for an AI- and cloud-led market. The organization connects economic strategy, go-to-market design, field and partner adoption, licensing programs, and regulatory considerations so that Microsoft can create durable customer value while operating with commercial clarity and discipline.

The Director, Partnerships & Channel Programs leads the partner engagement, launch readiness, commercial-program policy, and regulatory work required to bring Microsoft's modern commerce strategy to market. The role spans partner communications, readiness for major Cloud Solution Provider launches, program and offer design, and regulatory matters affecting Microsoft's global partner ecosystem.

This role operates at the intersection of commercial policy, external engagement, partner experience, digital commerce, and market execution. This candidate will lead an experienced team of business planners and translate complex business, policy, and regulatory changes into credible market narratives, partner-ready launches, durable programs, and disciplined execution. The role offers significant opportunity to work with senior leaders and influential external stakeholders.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. title: Director-Content & Events

You are a strategic operator who has demonstrated experience in what it takes to stand up an events center of excellence. This role will define how we show up in the market, turning events into a strategic advantage that strengthens the brand, fuels demand and deepens customer relationships.

Role Summary

The Director, Head of Events will own CBTS/OnX’s event strategy—designing, operationalizing, and scaling a high-performing events program that drives brand awareness, pipeline growth, and meaningful client engagement. This role is responsible for standing up and leading our events center of excellence, establishing the standards, structures, and team capabilities that ensure consistent, high-quality execution across all event types.

  • Own and evolve the annual events strategy in partnership with Growth Marketing, aligned to brand narrative, go-to-market priorities, and growth goals

  • Define the roles of events across the full funnel—from brand awareness to pipeline acceleration and customer expansion
  • Lead, develop, and grow the events team, including direct reports and event contractors, fostering an inclusive, high-performing team culture
  • Bring a business-development mindset to every event – identifying opportunities to maximize the value of our presence beyond the event itself, including coordinating strategic meetings and interactions for business leads in attendance
  • Champion cross-functional collaboration across corporate, partner, and regional marketing teams to deliver events that serve shared business goals
  • Plan and execute events end-to-end, including promotion, storytelling, logistics, and on-site execution
  • Manage event budgets with a rigorous focus on cost-effectiveness, ROI, and investment optimization
  • Own operational processes, timelines, vendors, and agencies
  • Ensure consistent brand presence and high-quality execution across all events
  • Define and track event performance metrics (pipeline impact, ROI, engagement), and build scalable processes for capture, reporting, and optimization
  • Use data and insights to continuously refine strategy and improve program performance

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience building and leading B2B events programs, including standing up or maturing an events function or center of excellence
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience—building, managing, and developing event teams
  • Strong strategic mindset paired with deep operational rigor and a bias for execution
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder events at scale across multiple event types
  • Demonstrated ability to connect events to pipeline and revenue outcomes
  • Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment with competing priorities

Strategy
Events Center of Excellence / Program Building

Event Management & Best Practices
Budget Management
Project management
Written + verbal communication

title: Chief Risk Officer
description:
Job Title\: Chief Risk Officer

Closing Date\: 15 September 2026

About us

At Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, our employees are at the heart of our business. Our colleagues provide a range of financial solutions designed around the changing needs of our diverse customers. It doesn’t matter the colour of your skin, the beliefs you value, the people you love or the tattoos you wear, we support you for being you.

Through the doors of Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, you will find a passionate team working to support our customers and our colleagues. We ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to learn and develop.

We want to celebrate your individuality, embrace your personality and welcome you into our culture. It’s the differences of our colleagues that enable us to thrive. We believe our backgrounds, skills and cultures contribute to our shared culture and help us deliver outstanding Customer Experience. Inclusion is the driving force behind our ethos.

At MBFS, we are proud to be a Menopause Friendly Accredited Employer, reflecting our ongoing commitment to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace. We offer wellbeing support options and resources for colleagues experiencing menopause and to those who are supporting someone through it.

How you’ll play your part

In this role, you will provide leadership, direction and oversight of the Risk & Compliance function, and provide independent second-line oversight of the firm's Non-Financial Risk Management Framework, Regulatory Compliance Framework and Financial Crime Framework, ensuring the business operates in accordance with applicable regulatory, legal and ethical requirements whilst supporting strategic objectives, operational resilience and good customer outcomes.

Main Accountabilities

People Leadership\:

  • Provide leadership, direction and oversight of the Risk & Compliance function, comprising risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime professionals.

  • Lead, motivate and develop employees through clear objectives, performance management and succession planning.

  • Foster a strong risk and compliance culture across the organisation aligned to the firm's values and regulatory expectations.

Non-Financial Risk Framework, Governance & Culture\:

  • Establish, implement and continuously enhance the firm's Non-Financial Risk Management Framework, ensuring risks are effectively identified, assessed, monitored, reported and managed in line with the firm's risk appetite.

  • Lead the development and embedding of risk governance, policies, risk methodologies, reporting and Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), providing independent challenge and oversight of operational, conduct, regulatory, reputational, outsourcing and operational resilience risks.

  • Promote a strong risk culture across the organisation, ensuring risk ownership, accountability and informed decision-making are embedded within business activities and strategic initiatives.

Regulatory Compliance Framework\:

  • Maintain and oversee an effective Compliance Framework that supports compliance with applicable regulatory and legal obligations, including FCA requirements, Consumer Duty, Consumer Credit legislation, Insurance Distribution requirements, SM&CR and other applicable regulatory standards.

  • Provide strategic advice and challenge to the Board, Executive Management and Senior Managers regarding regulatory obligations, conduct risk and compliance matters.

  • Ensure compliance risks associated with new products, business initiatives, customer journeys, outsourcing arrangements and strategic change programmes are appropriately identified, assessed and managed.

  • Maintain effective compliance policies, standards and governance arrangements.

Financial Crime Framework & MLRO Responsibilities\:

  • Fulfil the role of Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and maintain responsibility for the firm's Financial Crime Framework.

  • Oversee the management of Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), sanctions compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, fraud risk oversight and financial crime prevention arrangements.

  • Ensure financial crime risk assessments, controls, training, monitoring and reporting programmes remain effective and proportionate to the firm's risk profile.

  • Oversee suspicious activity reporting, financial crime investigations and regulatory notifications where required.

Monitoring, Assurance & Testing\:

  • Develop and maintain integrated Risk and Compliance Monitoring Plans using a risk-based methodology.

  • Ensure sufficient monitoring, thematic reviews, assurance activity and testing is undertaken to assess the effectiveness of risk management, compliance and financial crime controls.

  • Report findings, control weaknesses, breaches, incidents, emerging risks and thematic trends to appropriate governance forums.

  • Ensure management actions are tracked through to satisfactory closure.

Corporate Compliance & Data Protection\:

  • Maintain and oversee the Corporate Compliance and Data Protection Frameworks, ensuring compliance with applicable legal, regulatory and ethical requirements.

  • Lead oversight of Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Conflicts of Interest, Gifts & Hospitality, Whistleblowing, Competition Law, Policy Governance and Data Protection obligations, ensuring appropriate controls, governance, monitoring and reporting arrangements are maintained.

  • Promote a culture of integrity, ethical behaviour and accountability through effective training, awareness and employee engagement programmes.

Horizon Scanning, Governance, Reporting & Regulatory Engagement\:

  • Maintain an effective horizon-scanning process to identify emerging regulatory, legislative, industry and risk developments and assess their potential impact on the business.

  • Develop and maintain robust risk and compliance management information, key risk indicators and governance arrangements to support effective oversight and decision-making.

  • Provide regular reporting to Executive Management, Risk Committees, Audit Committees and the Board, including annual Compliance, Risk and MLRO reports.

  • Act as the primary liaison with the FCA and other relevant regulatory bodies, managing regulatory interactions, submissions, supervisory engagement, investigations, information requests and regulatory inspections.

About you

Essential\:

  • Significant senior leadership experience within an FCA-regulated financial services organisation.

  • Proven experience leading Non-Financial Risk, Compliance and/or Financial Crime functions.

  • Experience operating under the Senior Managers & Certification Regime.

  • Strong working knowledge of\:

    • Risk Management Frameworks and Governance

    • FCA Handbook

    • Consumer Duty

    • SM&CR

    • Fraud risk management

    • Operational Resilience requirements

  • Experience engaging directly with the FCA and other regulators.

  • Strong influencing, communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Proven ability to provide independent challenge at Executive and Board level.

Desirable\:

  • Motor Finance industry experience.

  • Professional qualifications such as ICA, ACAMS, FCII, ACII, IRM or equivalent.

  • Experience leading enterprise-wide risk and compliance transformation programmes.

What’s in it for you?

We’ll offer you a competitive salary and discretionary bonus structure. We also hope you’ll love our products as much as we do, with access to our colleague car schemes. On top of that, you’ll be able to join our pension scheme and you’ll get a flexible benefit pot that can be used to find the benefits that are right for you.

We’re here to support you – we offer access to colleague wellbeing resources, including an Employee Assistance Programme, Mental Health First Aiders and the Inclusion Advocates as well as flexible opportunities to support work life balance. We’ll also encourage your development, with the training and knowledge you need to reach your potential.

Through the doors of Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, you’ll find a passionate team working to put our customers first. We know that to keep this team motivated, we need to ensure that everyone has equal opportunity to learn and develop. We celebrate a culture of appreciation and respect, where everyone is valued for who they are. We believe our backgrounds, experiences and cultures contribute to our shared experience and shape who we are and what we do. The diversity of our colleagues reflects the diversity of our customers. This diversity is the driving force behind our ideas.

What’s next?

When you apply, you’ll be asked to complete a short online application where we’ll ask that you include your current CV. You’ll also be asked some application questions, including your current salary information. The Mercedes-Benz recruitment process reflects our obligations under relevant UK legislation. Whilst all applications are carefully considered, we are only able to progress applications from candidates who have the right to work in the United Kingdom.

Please be assured that we’re here to support you throughout the recruitment process and beyond, and reasonable adjustments are available to any candidates who need them. We’re also open to working flexibly and are happy to discuss flexible working options.

Managing your data

We care about your personal data. The General Data Protection Regulation provides you with more control and by submitting an application to us; we consider this an agreement to process your personal data in support of our recruitment and selection process.

Data categories that we process in relation to your application are the ones that you provided as part of the application process. We process your personal data in relation to the application, in accordance with the legal requirements. Recipients of your personal data within our company are the managers of the specialist unit in charge of filling the position and the responsible colleagues from HR.

Your application data is held within our secure application tracking system called Taleo – you will be given access to a candidate zone in the system where you can monitor and manage your application and see status updates. We will communicate with you, by email or phone throughout the recruitment process so that we can keep you updated and inform you of your progress through the recruitment process. You can also seek ‘job alerts’ once you are registered in Taleo and it’s possible your details may be returned in searches we conduct for new positions and we may contact you by email to let you know about them. We limit the storage of your data to the necessary period. Contact us as careers@mercedes-benz.com for further information.

If you have any questions about any matter relating to data protection or the personal data that we process about you for the purpose of personnel recruiting, please contact the Chief Officer of Corporate Data Protection for the Mercedes-Benz Group AG at the following address\: Mercedes-Benz Group AG, HPC E600, 70546 Stuttgart, data.protection@mercedes-benz.com.

title: Team Leader Enrollment Advisor
description:
The Team Leader Enrollment Advisor plays a vital role in leading and implementing strategies to attract a diverse and qualified student population to the college or university, combining strong sales/call center team management with strategic recruitment leadership. Reporting to the Head of Student Recruitment, the Team Leader oversees the recruitment team — including day-to-day sales floor performance — and collaborates with various departments to meet enrollment goals and promote the institution's offerings. 1. Recruitment Strategy and Planning
  • Develop and execute comprehensive recruitment strategies to achieve enrollment targets while aligning with the institution's mission and values.
  • Analyze market trends, demographic data, and competition to identify opportunities for reaching prospective students effectively.
  • Manage local direct sales teams.
  • Work collaboratively with the International direct team to achieve enrollment targets.
  • Accountable for achieving enrollment targets.
2. Team Leadership and Management
  • Lead, mentor, and manage the recruitment team, providing guidance, training, and performance evaluations.
  • Foster a collaborative and results-driven team culture that emphasizes student-centered approaches and data-informed decision-making.
  • Run 1:1s, performance reviews, and individual development plans, recognizing and retaining top performers.
3. Call Center Sales Management
  • Manage the daily sales floor operation: lead distribution, speed-to-lead, call volume targets, and follow-up cadence.
  • Monitor core call center KPIs (talk time, contact rate, conversion rate, lead-to-enrollment ratio) and adjust team strategy accordingly.
  • Conduct regular call monitoring/listening sessions with structured feedback to improve pitch, objection-handling, and closing technique.
  • Manage CRM and dialer/telephony tools to ensure accurate lead tracking and reporting.
4. Outreach and Relationship Building
  • Build and maintain relationships with high schools, community colleges, educational agencies, and other key partners to enhance recruitment efforts.
  • Represent the institution at college fairs, conferences, and other events to engage with prospective students and their families.
  • Create and manage all events, open days, campus tours.
5. Marketing and Communication
  • Collaborate with the marketing and communications team to develop compelling messaging and promotional materials that highlight the institution's strengths and offerings.
  • Utilize digital platforms, social media, and traditional marketing channels to reach and engage prospective students.
  • Ensure messaging and scripts used by the sales team are compelling, consistent, and on-brand.
6. Data Analysis and Reporting
  • Collect, analyze, and interpret data related to recruitment trends, application rates, and conversion rates to inform strategic decisions.
  • Prepare regular reports and presentations for senior leadership detailing recruitment progress and outcomes.
  • Include sales/call center performance and pipeline forecasting in reporting to senior leadership.
7. Admissions Process Support
  • Work closely with the admissions team to ensure a smooth and efficient application process, providing guidance on admission requirements, deadlines, and procedures.
8. Diversity and Inclusion
  • Implement strategies to enhance diversity and inclusivity within the student body by reaching out to underrepresented populations and promoting a welcoming environment.
9. International Student Recruitment
  • Develop and manage international recruitment initiatives, collaborating with international partners and organizations to attract and support international students.
10. Enrollment Management
  • Collaborate with enrollment management and financial aid teams to optimize financial aid packaging, scholarships, and other incentives to attract and retain students.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
  • Several years of experience in student recruitment, admissions, or related roles within higher education.
  • Proven experience managing a sales team in a call center or high-volume phone sales environment, including hands-on experience as a sales agent prior to leadership.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire others.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Data-driven mindset, with proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
  • Familiarity with enrollment management systems and CRM software.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM and dialer/telephony platforms and comfort managing real-time sales KPIs.
  • Knowledge of marketing and communication strategies, particularly in the context of student recruitment.
  • Understanding of higher education trends, demographics, and the competitive landscape.
  • Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in recruitment efforts.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and engage with external stakeholders.
  • Ability to motivate and retain a team in a high-pressure, target-driven, high-turnover sales environment.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency.
