Låter detta som en möjlighet för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag - vi ser verkligen fram emot att höra från dig!

Observera att urval sker löpande, så vänta inte för länge.

title: Principal Investigator
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Principal Investigator to lead and support complex corporate internal investigations and help advance Business and Regulatory Investigations (BRI) team’s investigative capabilities. In this role you will demonstrate strong investigative judgement, planning, interviewing, credibility assessment, fact-finding, and evidence analysis capabilities, together with experience leveraging electronic evidence and technical data sources to support complex investigations. This role will work closely with attorneys and partners across Human Resources, Security, Finance, or other organizations globaly.



Responsibilities
  • Conduct complex and sensitive corporate internal investigations under the direction of counsel, involving allegations of employee misconduct, including financial misconduct fraud, conflicts of interest, misuse or unauthorized disclosure of company information, security-related misconduct, other potential policy violations.
  • Develop and execute investigative strategies, including identifying and collecting relevant evidence, conduct complex and sensitive interviews, perform document review and evidence analysis, and conduct or support digital forensic examinations.
  • Identify, search, collect, review, and analyze electronic evidence using Microsoft Purview eDiscovery, Relativity, or equivalent enterprise investigative, forensic and document review platforms, ensuring investigative activities are appropriately targeted and proportionate.
  • Analyze documents, interviews, and technical evidence. Identify relevant facts, inconsistencies, and evidentiary gaps. Develop clear, objective fact summaries to support counsel’s investigative decisions and findings.
  • Collaborate effectively with attorneys and cross-functional partners, including Security, Human Resources, and other stakeholders to obtain and evaluate information relevant to investigations.
  • Develop investigative playbooks, standards, and scalable practices that improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of BRI investigations.


Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications
  • Master's Degree in Business, Accounting, Criminal Justice, Law, International Relations, Global Intelligence, Engineering or related field AND 4+ years experience conducting employee misconduct investigations or other complex corporate internal investigations involving multiple evidence sources and significant organizational risk, or related field
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Accounting, Criminal Justice, Law, International Relations, Global Intelligence, Engineering or related field AND 6+ years experience conducting employee misconduct investigations or other complex corporate internal investigations involving multiple evidence sources and significant organizational risk, or related field
      • OR equivalent experience.
Additional or preferred qualifications
  • Advanced experience using eDiscovery and electronic document review platforms, preferably Microsoft Purview eDiscovery and Relativity, or comparable enterprise platforms, to search, collect, and analyze large volumes of electronic evidence.
  • Understanding of electronic evidence, including electronic communications, documents, metadata, audit records, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Interviewing, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to distinguish established facts from assumptions, identify evidentiary gaps, and develop appropriate investigative follow-up.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, collaborate across geographically dispersed teams, and appropriately handle highly confidential information.
  • Experience conducting or supporting investigations across diverse geographies and jurisdictions.
  • Ability to write and interpret data query languages such as Kusto Query Language (KQL), SQL, or similar query languages to independently identify, collect, analyze, and validate relevant evidence.
  • Experience using Microsoft Defender, including Defender Advanced Hunting, or comparable security and endpoint investigation platforms.
  • Experience analyzing security and audit telemetry, including authentication, device, file, cloud application, and data movement activity.
  • Experience conducting or supporting digital forensic examinations, including analysis of endpoint, browser, file system, removable media, or other forensic artifacts.
  • Familiarity with scripting, automation, data analytics, or AI-assisted investigative and document review capabilities is a plus.

title: EL1 Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Data Standards Body
description:
EL1 Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Data Standards Body at Commonwealth Treasury

This is an exciting opportunity to work in the Data Standards Body (DSB) and across government to deliver high quality regulatory standards.

The DSB supports the Data Standards Chair who is responsible for making the Data Standards that are necessary for the effective operation of Australia’s Digital ID System and the Consumer Data Right (CDR) regulatory frameworks. The DSB is part of Treasury’s Digital, Competition and Payments Division in Markets Group.

Further information about the CDR and Digital ID Data Standards, for which the Data Standards Chair is responsible, can be found on the DSB’s website: Data Standards Body. The Data Standards set requirements for entities to build to and comply with in order to share data in compliance with the regulatory frameworks of the CDR and Digital ID. The Data Standards Body does not receive, store or analyse any data captured in accordance with the Data Standards.

Key Duties

  • Design, build, test and maintain full-stack applications, reference implementations, testing tools and internal systems supporting standards development, delivery and support services.
  • Provide engineering input into standards design and option development processes, working with solution architects and industry stakeholders to assess implementation feasibility and technical change impacts.
  • Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, testers and analysts to translate standards requirements into working implementations.
  • Apply DevOps practices to foster a culture of collaboration, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver high-quality solutions to meet customer needs quickly and securely, with a focus on efficiency, reliability and stability.
  • Champion coding, testing, and documentation practices.
  • Contribute to planning, estimation and continuous improvement initiatives across the DSB.

Desirable Qualifications / Experience

The candidate must:

title: Senior Software Engineer - Dynamics 365 Contact Center AI team
description:
Overview

The Contact Center AI team is building the conversational AI runtime that powers the next generation of intelligent, agentic customer engagement across chat, digital channels and real-time voice. We deliver Contact Center AI as a highly available, enterprise-grade service that integrates cleanly with Azure and a broad ecosystem of first- and third-party products, enabling any surface to embed rich contact center experiences and advanced AI capabilities out of the box. We transform Microsoft’s advances in foundation models, multimodal systems, and AI agents into production-ready capabilities that help customers resolve complex needs with speed, consistency, and trust. Our mission is to deliver a world-class agentic platform where Copilot agents can reason, plan, act, collaborate with other agents, and transition seamlessly to human experts—turning frontier AI into dependable customer outcomes on a global scale.

Our charter spans the full Microsoft Copilot Studio (MCS) runtime: intelligent agent authoring, orchestration, and invocation; secure tool and connector execution; knowledge grounding and retrieval; and a dynamic evaluation system that continuously measures quality as agents, models, data, and customer behaviors evolve. We use targeted evaluations, and drift detection to identify regressions early, understand their causes, and iterate rapidly - creating a closed learning loop that improves accuracy, resilience, and consistency over time.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will design, build, and operate the services at the heart of this platform - shaping the technical architecture and shipping production-grade features across the agentic stack, from real-time voice and orchestration to Copilot agents, tool invocation, and the Copilot Studio runtime that brings them to life. We are an AI-first organization: we rethink every workflow in an agentic way, innovate quickly, and collaborate closely with our partners and customers in an agile, fast-paced, high-energy environment. If this opportunity excites you, come and talk to us!

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Be a great engineer - Design, implement, and ship reliable, production-grade agentic systems across the stack, owning the quality, delivery, and support of the services you build.

  • Build agentic experiences on the Microsoft Copilot Studio (MCS) runtime - contributing to agent orchestration, planning, grounding, memory, knowledge sources, connectors, the Tool Gateway, and the control plane that ties them together.

  • Develop real-time voice agents - low-latency, speech-to-speech experiences with sub-second turn-taking, barge-in, interruption handling, and graceful human hand-off that feel natural in live calls.

  • Build scalable, resilient backend services using event-driven and service mesh patterns, with high-throughput APIs (REST, gRPC), and participate in the full service lifecycle - CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, on-call, and SLA-driven reliability.

  • Earn respect - Work in the code, support the service, and understand at a detailed level how the software works; partner with AI/ML, PM, and design, and mentor fellow engineers through design and code reviews.

  • Champion Responsible AI - Embed fairness, safety, privacy, grounding, and reliability into everything you build.

  • In short, we are looking for some great engineers to come and do what great engineers truly love to do: Solve complex problems by building great software.

title: Clustermanager Omgeving & Strategie
description:
Waar ga je werken

Welkom bij Waterschap De Dommel. Water is onmisbaar voor natuur, landbouw, economie en ons dagelijks leven. Tegelijk staan we voor grote uitdagingen zoals klimaatverandering, extreme droogte en hevige buien, de energietransitie en digitalisering. Maatschappelijke belangen komen daarbij regelmatig samen of tegenover elkaar te staan.

In onze Watervisie 2050 hebben we hoge ambities geformuleerd voor de toekomst van onze leefomgeving. Binnen De Dommel noemen we dit de watertransitie. Samen met onze omgeving en maatschappelijke partners werken we aan een toekomstbestendig leefgebied en ontwikkelen we ons verder tot een toonaangevende, zichtbare, wendbare en slagvaardige samenwerkingsorganisatie.

Dat vraagt om samenhang, integrale prioritering én soms om fundamenteel anders denken. Strategische ambities moeten worden vertaald naar duidelijke keuzes en uitvoering. Om dat beter te organiseren is in 2025 een nieuwe tactische sturingslaag ingericht: het clustermanagement.

De vier clustermanagers vormen samen de schakel tussen de strategische koers van bestuur en directie en de operationele aansturing. Zij zijn gezamenlijk verantwoordelijk voor de doelrealisatie van De Dommel. Iedere clustermanager heeft een eigen portefeuille, maar het organisatiebelang staat altijd voorop.

Over de functie

Als Clustermanager Omgeving & Strategie maak je deel uit van dit collectief. Drie clustermanagers zijn inmiddels gestart. Je stapt daarmee in een nieuwe managementstructuur die volop in ontwikkeling is en waaraan je samen verder vorm geeft.

Je vervult nadrukkelijk een tactische managementrol. De directie bepaalt de strategische koers en neemt de besluiten over de lange termijn. Jij voedt die koers met inzichten en voorstellen en vertaalt deze naar tactische doelen, prioriteiten, programmering en resultaten. Daarbij voer je het gesprek met directie en collega-clustermanagers over ambitie, haalbaarheid, samenhang en keuzes.

Je geeft richting aan de managers binnen je portefeuille. Je maakt verwachtingen helder, vraagt door op voortgang en resultaten en helpt bij het stellen van prioriteiten. Je neemt hun verantwoordelijkheid niet over, maar stimuleert juist eigenaarschap en past je leiderschap aan op wat de situatie vraagt.

Je bent daarnaast een stevige gesprekspartner voor bestuur en directie. Je begrijpt bestuurlijke verhoudingen en belangen, hebt gevoel voor timing en weet dat niet alleen de inhoud, maar ook de manier waarop een voorstel wordt ingebracht bepalend kan zijn voor het resultaat.

Je bent het herkenbare aanspreekpunt voor Omgeving & Strategie en verbindt bestuur, directie, managers, strategische professionals en externe partners. Je kijkt vooruit, signaleert maatschappelijke en bestuurlijke ontwikkelingen en vertaalt wat deze op langere termijn betekenen naar keuzes voor vandaag.

Je stimuleert de organisatie om niet alleen bestaande oplossingen te optimaliseren maar ook te onderzoeken of het fundamenteel anders kan of moet. Je brengt nieuwe perspectieven in en prikkelt anderen. Daarbij ben je niet zelf de inhoudelijk specialist maar benut je de kennis van strategen, managers en professionals en stuur je op richting, samenhang en realisatie.

Ook buiten De Dommel vervul je een belangrijke rol. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk in bestuurlijke en maatschappelijke netwerken en onderhoudt relaties met andere overheden, regionale partners en relevante partijen. Je doorgrondt belangen en krachtenvelden en weet waar verbinding, overtuiging of beleidsbeïnvloeding nodig is om de doelen van De Dommel verder te brengen.

Je zorgt ervoor dat onze belangen en opgaven op het juiste moment en aan de juiste tafels worden ingebracht. Je weet hoe bestuurlijke besluitvorming werkt, kunt uiteenlopende belangen overbruggen en positioneert voorstellen zo dat zij bestuurlijk en maatschappelijk effectief kunnen landen.

Portefeuille Omgeving & Strategie

Binnen deze portefeuille komen strategie, bestuur en omgeving nadrukkelijk samen.

De portefeuille verbindt de strategische koers van De Dommel met bestuurlijke en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen in de omgeving. Het doel is om ontwikkelingen tijdig te signaleren, verschillende belangen te verbinden en deze te vertalen naar samenhangende keuzes voor vandaag en de langere termijn.

De wateropgaven vragen daarbij niet alleen om optimalisatie van bestaande oplossingen. Binnen de portefeuille wordt ook onderzocht waar fundamenteel andere benaderingen nodig zijn om de ambities van De Dommel te realiseren. Inhoudelijke kennis vanuit de organisatie wordt daarbij verbonden en vertaald naar bruikbare voorstellen en plannen.

Daarnaast richt de portefeuille zich op de bestuurlijke en maatschappelijke positionering van De Dommel. Goede relaties met andere overheden, regionale partners en relevante netwerken zijn belangrijk om onze belangen en opgaven op het juiste moment en aan de juiste tafels te brengen.

Wat wij vragen

We zoeken een tactisch sterke en authentieke leider met oog voor mensen én resultaten. Je hebt strategische diepgang en kunt complexe vraagstukken en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vanuit verschillende perspectieven bekijken, zonder de verbinding met realisatie te verliezen.

Politiek-bestuurlijke sensitiviteit is essentieel. Je doorgrondt belangen en verhoudingen, communiceert zorgvuldig en diplomatiek en weet wanneer je moet luisteren, verbinden, beïnvloeden of juist positie moet kiezen. Je combineert daarin stevigheid met natuurlijk gezag.

Je brengt rust en overzicht in complexe situaties en neemt de tijd voor zorgvuldige afweging wanneer dat nodig is. Tegelijkertijd ben je besluitvaardig en resultaatgericht. Je denkt vanuit kansen, durft bestaande patronen ter discussie te stellen en weet anderen mee te nemen in nieuwe denkrichtingen.

Als leider geef je managers richting én ruimte. Je stimuleert eigenaarschap, stuurt op resultaat en kunt afhankelijk van de situatie coachen, verbinden, confronteren of duidelijk richting geven. Binnen het clustermanagement breng je een eigen perspectief mee, maar staat het gezamenlijke organisatiebelang voorop.

Een achtergrond binnen een waterschap is geen vereiste. Wel is aantoonbare ervaring met en inzicht in een complexe politiek-bestuurlijke context van groot belang.

Voor deze positie zijn strategische verdieping, bestuurlijke sensitiviteit, omgevingsgerichtheid en verbindend vermogen van groot belang. Je overziet het grotere geheel en weet langetermijndenken te vertalen naar richting en realisatie.

Wat wij bieden

Je krijgt een uitdagende en invloedrijke managementfunctie binnen een organisatie met grote maatschappelijke betekenis. Je krijgt ruimte om richting te geven aan de portefeuille Omgeving & Strategie én om samen met directie, collega-clustermanagers en managers verder vorm te geven aan de nieuwe tactische managementlaag.

We vinden het belangrijk dat je met plezier werkt en de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Daarom kun je bij het Waterschap rekenen op goede arbeidsvoorwaarden. Een salaris van minimaal € 6.438,- en maximaal € 9.165,- per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur, functieschaal 14, afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring.

Daarnaast bieden we je:

  • Een individueel keuzebudget van 21% van je brutosalaris bij een werkweek van 36 uur waarmee je onder andere extra verlofdagen of je salaris mee aan kan vullen (minimaal € 1.352,- en maximaal € 1.924, - bruto per maand).
  • Een ruim opleidingsbudget én toegang tot de Brabant Aquademie met een breed aanbod aan trainingen en cursussen.
  • 144 verlofuren + 7,2 bovenwettelijke verlofuren bij een werkweek van 36 uur.
  • Flexibele werktijden en goede faciliteiten om thuis te werken zoals een laptop, telefoon en thuiswerkvergoeding.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling bij het ABP.
  • Het betreft een functie voor 32-36 uur per week.

Sollicitatieprocedure

De eerste selectiegesprekken vinden plaats op vrijdagochtend 2 oktober.
De tweede selectiegesprekken vinden plaats op vrijdag 16 oktober.
Een assessment maakt deel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure en vindt plaats tussen 2 en 16 oktober.

Voor meer informatie over deze functie kun je contact opnemen met Joost van Groenestijn, 06-303 426 32 of via joostvangroenestijn@jsconsultancy.nl.

Heb je interesse, neem dan contact op? Een tijdige reactie wordt op prijs gesteld. De werving loopt exclusief via JS Consultancy, we verzoeken je dan ook om via de website van JS Consultancy te solliciteren. Alle sollicitaties die via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton binnen komen worden rechtstreeks naar JS Consultancy doorgestuurd.

title: Data Center Technician
description:
Overview
As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) (Location: Fayetteville, GA ), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.
Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role's job duties.


Responsibilities

Datacenter Operations

Asks questions when they do not have required information and may provide feedback on changes to processes to experienced technicians and/or direct-line management.
  • Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type with guidance from experienced technicians. Seeks guidance from more experienced technicians on challenging or complex tickets.
  • Receives guidance and supervision to develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning IT datacenter technology(ies) and equipment. Develops and acquires a fundamental understanding of the functions of, and interactions between cabling infrastructure, network, server, and storage equipment.

Datacenter Work Environment

  • Completes required security and data management training while complying with security and data management procedures/policies with guidance from other technicians. May escort third party vendors or IT support on-premises at data centers or network sites. Appropriately takes action and reports physical security access concerns and/or incidents to direct-line management or established reporting methods.
  • Participates in daily safety briefings. Completes required Environmental & Health Safety (EHS) training, complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use), completes required Task Hazard Analysis (THAs), and uses appropriate equipment and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for assigned tasks. Adheres to and promotes a culture of safety, taking proactive action to alert others of safety concerns, near-misses, and/or incidents. Participates in regular cadence proactive safety observation reporting processes and systems.
  • Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting up to 25lbs / 11kg without assistance. Occasional lifting 25-50lbs / 11-22.5kg with lift assistance. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.
  • Traveling up to 25% typically domestically to and from multiple locations during the workday, and occasionally domestically to other sites for overnight stays. May work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours such as evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Working for extended periods under elevated levels of ambient noise, heat, and light due to necessary equipment and ventilation systems.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with other shifts or technician teams, contributing in regular team meetings, asking questions, and partnering with other shifts of technician teams to complete smooth transition and effective handover of ticketed work. Encourages providing and responding to feedback received on ways to work more effectively or enhance efficiency within their team and adopts best practices shared within-and-across shifts or technician teams

Managing Service

  • Develops an understanding of cross-functional Data Center processes to support partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Completes required training aligned to job focus areas and workloads (i.e., Break fix, Deployment, Simple Change, Decommission, IT Critical Environment) in a timely manner per direct-line management assignment(s). Observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training (OJT). May complete additional or supplemental training to obtain or maintain relevant industry or technical certifications.
  • Maintains an awareness of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) through reporting dashboards, systems, for personal monthly performance discussions as needed.
  • Escalates and/or seeks guidance from experienced technicians or direct-line management regarding client interactions.

Service Delivery

  • Performs basic diagnostics and troubleshooting with guidance from experienced technicians and/or via standard procedures to identify the cause(s) of technical issues and replace faulty components in network, storage, or server equipment with zero-to-minimal customer and/or business disruption. Develops awareness of conditions, circumstances, and scenarios which may reflect significant customer or business impact within the Data Center environment.
  • Learns about post-execution verification of grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling to align with all safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Templates (NDTs). Learns about errors in deployment standards or Network Design Templates (NDTs) and escalates to relevant technicians or specialists to coordinate corrections as needed.
  • Develops an understanding of effective execution order strategy(ies) for assigned tasks with assistance from experienced technicians or direct-line management. Prepares, stages, sets up, and performs basic startups and shutdowns for hardware (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches) according to specific written instructions provided via checklists, guides, standard processes, emails, guidance from other technicians, and/or direction from management. May perform tasks in tandem with other technicians to comply with procedures and safety requirements.
  • Follows procedures to immediately communicate, report, and escalate data center technical or safety related incidents to direct-line management. May participate in bridge calls to provide details on incident status and executes on-site follow-up actions as directed if necessary.
  • Directly performs decommissions, simple changes (e.g., memory upgrades, OS rebuilds) and refreshes of infrastructure cabling, network, storage, and server equipment, following standard procedures whilst seeking clarification and guidance from more experienced technicians as needed. Processes data-bearing devices (DBDs) for destruction or confirms any-and-all such devices (e.g. hard-drives, solid-state drives, flash cards, etc.) contained within network, storage, or server equipment has been identified for eradication or destruction with guidance.

title: Post Doc Researcher
description:
Overview

The Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in CoreAI, Microsoft, invites applications for postdoctoral researcher positions. FoSSE is an applied research team focused on solving real-world software engineering (SE) problems for large codebases, including code migration, code translation, and static analysis, using AI and formal methods. Our postdoc program provides an opportunity to work on practical research problems while collaborating closely with Microsoft researchers and product groups. Postdocs spend 1-2 years with us and receive ongoing guidance and mentoring from experienced colleagues. We work at the intersection of programming language design, formal methods, static analysis, and AI.

Applicants should have a strong background in one or both of the following tracks:

PL track: Strong background in programming languages, compilers, or related areas, and an interest in combining AI with these techniques to solve SE problems at scale and with high quality.

Reinforcement Learning (RL) track: Strong background in LLM post-training (e.g., RLHF, instruction tuning, alignment, evaluation) and an interest in applying these techniques to SE.

Apply with your CV and at least two letters of recommendation. For any queries, please write to fosse-hiring@microsoft.com.

The positions are based in Bangalore, where we are co-located with Microsoft Research India. FoSSE provides an excellent research environment and a welcoming, diverse community. title: Software Engineer
description:
Overview

Do you have a passion for software design, engineering, debugging and problem-solving? Are you self-motivated, proactive, and results oriented, with the ability to generate clarity in ambiguous situations, ramp up quickly, understand complex problems, and create solutions across products? If so, join us in building the future of Windows!

Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop are fundamentally changing the nature of personal computing, pushing technology in the cloud to make remote experiences better, more secure, and easier to manage than local. Both have recently been recognized as a leader in the inaugural Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Desktop as a Service (DaaS), and together they are already a billion-dollar business, with solid customer pull from on-premises Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) customers looking to modernize and move to the cloud.

The Windows Cloud Experiences team builds Windows App, the unified client for connecting to Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Dev Box, Remote Desktop Services, and remote PCs. We create secure, reliable, and high-performance client experiences that bring together native operating system capabilities and cloud-powered services across devices and form factors. Our vision is to provide the world with the best expression of Windows from any client, any operating system, and any form factor.

Linux is an important endpoint platform for Windows Cloud, spanning developer workstations, thin clients, and highly regulated environments in healthcare, government, finance, and contact centers. We are investing in a Microsoft-built Windows App for Linux to give these customers a consistent and fully supported way to reach their Windows desktops and apps in the cloud. This role is centered on Linux client and platform engineering, working close to the operating system, the desktop stack, and the remoting protocol, not only surface-level user interface development. You will join a diverse and agile team of motivated engineers and product managers whose culture is customer obsession: we do what is necessary to help customers succeed, move fast, and have fun building meaningful products.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer on Windows App, you will develop features in the native Linux client, working in the technical areas and at the component level.

You will be responsible for:

  • Implement features in the native Linux client. Write production C/C++ for scoped areas.
  • Build and debug device redirection channels. Implement and troubleshoot individual redirection features such as clipboard, audio and microphone, printer, camera, drive and folder redirection, and keyboard and mouse input, validating them against real peripherals and real remote sessions.
  • Work directly against Linux system interfaces. Learn and use the operating system APIs your features depend on, including audio, video capture, USB and HID, printing, input and display protocols, and D-Bus, and understand how they differ across distributions and hardware.
  • Debug native code across layers. Reproduce, isolate, and root-cause defects using gdb, logs, traces, packet captures, and profiling tools, building the ability to reason across application, protocol, operating system, and service boundaries.
  • Build working knowledge of the remoting protocol. Understand Remote Desktop Protocol concepts such as virtual channels, transports, and connection establishment, and apply them when implementing and diagnosing features.
  • Own quality for what you build. Write unit and integration tests, add telemetry and diagnostic logging, validate on supported distributions and client hardware, and triage incoming issues from internal self-host users and preview customers through to a fix.
  • Participate fully in the engineering cycle, taking part in design discussions and code reviews and following through from requirement to production.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Neobank App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

  • Security and compliance: taking part in the annual penetration test and remediation follow-up, contributing to access reviews across infrastructure and product systems, preparing audit evidence, maintaining the third-party register.

  • Good command of macOS; working knowledge of Windows

macOS for most of the fleet, Windows as a complement. Google Workspace, Slack, Jira and Confluence. Google Cloud Platform. title: Technical Product Lead - AI Investing App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Master Thesis Program - Spring 2027
description:
At Sectra, we use technology to contribute to a safer and healthier society. Across our different business areas, we develop solutions that address some of society’s most important challenges — from improving healthcare to protecting sensitive information and critical communications.

For the spring of 2027, we welcome driven and talented soon-to-be graduates to our Master Thesis Program in Linköping. This is an opportunity to use your ideas, energy, curiosity, and determination to work on real challenges together with experienced colleagues at Sectra.

Two business areas - one thesis program

As a master thesis student at Sectra, you can explore opportunities within two different areas: Sectra Medical and Sectra Communications. While our missions are different, both areas share a strong focus on technology, innovation, problem-solving, and creating real value for society.

Sectra Medical – technology for the future of healthcare

At Sectra Medical, we develop medical imaging IT solutions that increase the efficiency of hospitals and clinics worldwide. With decades of experience in the field, our knowledge and passion for technology and healthcare drive us to create solutions that contribute to more patient-centered care.

As a thesis student, you can explore challenges within areas such as AI/ML, complex software development, image analysis, visualization, and advanced database applications. We also welcome students with a UI/UX profile who are interested in contributing to the future of healthcare.

If you are passionate about technology and MedTech and want to use your skills to help create a healthier society, Sectra Medical offers an opportunity to work on challenges that have a real impact.

Sectra Communications – technology for a safer society

At Sectra Communications, we develop secure communication solutions that help defense forces, authorities, and other critical functions in society protect sensitive information and systems from eavesdropping and unauthorized access.

Our solutions are used at national and international levels, including by the EU, NATO, and more than half of the EU member states. As part of our team, you get the opportunity to work with challenges within cybersecurity, AI/ML, secure communications, software, and hardware engineering.

If you are passionate about technology and cybersecurity and want to contribute to a safer society, Sectra Communications offers an opportunity to work on real challenges with a meaningful purpose.

Your thesis at Sectra

Regardless of which area interests you most, we want your thesis project to be a good match for your skills, interests, and ambitions. Our scope includes a wide range of interesting challenges, and we are more than happy to discuss possible projects with you.

Our thesis workers work to solve real challenges, often spurring innovations that change the way we do business. You will have the opportunity to bring your own ideas and perspectives while working closely with experienced colleagues.

During your thesis project, you become a full-fledged member of the Sectra family. We hope that your time with us will be the beginning of a long-term relationship, whether you continue your career in Sweden or at one of our offices around the world.

Being part of Sectra means joining an innovative organization with hundreds of colleagues who are serious about what we do — but who also enjoy having fun together.

At Sectra, we hire for attitude and ability – train for skill. This means that who you are and your potential are more important than your previous experience.

For our Master Thesis Program, we are looking for people who:

  • Are enrolled in a master’s-level engineering program, preferably within IT, software engineering, hardware engineering, or a similar field, with a strong academic background.
  • Have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy understanding, breaking down, and solving complex problems.
  • Are curious, ambitious, and motivated to learn and take on new challenges.
  • Can quickly grasp new information and make use of previous experiences.
  • Are good communicators who can interact with colleagues, partners, and customers in an effective, clear, and constructive way.
  • Are fluent in English.

For Sectra Medical, we also welcome students with a UI/UX profile and a passion for technology and the medical IT industry.

For Sectra Communications, you need to be fluent in both Swedish and English and be a Swedish citizen.

Most importantly, we are looking for pioneers and problem solvers who want to use technology to make a difference — whether that means helping create a healthier society or a safer one.

Application

Please make sure to attach the following to your application:

  • CV
  • Cover letter
  • Transcripts/grades from university
  • Transcripts/grades from gymnasium/upper-secondary school

In your application, feel free to tell us which of our two business areas interests you and what kind of challenges you would be excited to explore. We are very open to discussing what you would like to work on within our scope.

Applying as a pair? Please submit an individual application for each person. In your application message, mention that you are applying as a pair and include your partner’s name so that we can match your applications.

We look forward to hearing from you!

If you have any questions regarding the program, feel free to reach out to our recruiter Cajsa Hjortzberg, cajsa.hjortzberg@sectra.com

title: Principal Software Engineer - Windows App and Windows Platform
description:

The Windows Cloud Experiences team builds the Windows App, the unified client for connecting to Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, and remote PCs. We create secure, reliable, and high-performance client experiences that bring together native Windows capabilities and cloud-powered services across devices and form factors.

We are looking for a principal engineer who combines deep Windows systems expertise with broad architectural leadership. You will turn complex operating-system, networking, identity, remoting, performance, and reliability challenges into a coherent technical strategy for Windows App. This role is centered on native Windows client and platform engineering, with impact that spans multiple teams and partner organizations.

As a Principal Software Engineer on Windows App, you will set the technical direction for critical areas of the native Windows client and lead architecture from customer scenarios through implementation, release, and live-site operation. You will work across application, platform, and service boundaries to make remote Windows experiences secure, responsive, dependable, and deeply integrated with the operating system.

You will operate as a technical leader across teams, creating clarity in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning engineering investments with the product vision, and guiding durable decisions in complex codebases. You will grow other technical leaders through design guidance, architecture reviews, debugging support, and mentoring.



Responsibilities
  • Define and drive the long-term architecture and technical strategy for major areas of Windows App and its native Windows platform, using modern C++ and C# where appropriate and integrating deeply with Win32, WinRT, COM, Windows services, and operating-system APIs.
  • Lead the design and delivery of high-impact, cross-cutting scenarios spanning connection setup, session lifecycle, authentication, OS integration, reliability, performance, and security.
  • Architect secure, scalable, and maintainable systems that span processes, threads, services, client applications, SDK boundaries, and cloud-backed experiences.
  • Lead investigations of the most complex engineering issues using debuggers, dumps, traces, logs, and telemetry, including problems involving concurrency, memory, networking, latency, compatibility, and operating-system integration.
  • Drive multi-team execution from customer and business outcomes through architecture, design, implementation, validation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring, and live-site response; identify risks and make clear technical tradeoffs.
  • Build alignment across Windows, Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, identity, security, design, and product teams, influencing partner roadmaps, interfaces, and end-to-end engineering decisions.
  • Establish and evolve engineering standards for performance, reliability, accessibility, security, testability, operational excellence, and long-term maintainability across the client platform.
  • Develop technical leaders, mentor senior engineers, lead architecture and design reviews, and create clarity in ambiguous or cross-organization problem spaces.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep expertise in Windows systems technologies such as Win32, WinRT, COM, RPC, Windows services, inter-process communication, and core Windows APIs.
  • Expertise in remote desktop, virtualization, or virtual desktop infrastructure technologies such as RDP, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, VMware Horizon, HDX, or ICA.
  • Experience setting architecture for networking, authentication, and identity in Windows clients, including Microsoft Entra ID, MSAL, or Web Account Manager.
  • Experience leading the design and debugging of multi-process, multi-threaded, performance-critical native systems, including memory, concurrency, latency, compatibility, and reliability concerns.
  • Experience influencing the architecture of Windows App SDK, WinUI, XAML, WebView2, MSIX, or related Windows client technologies.
  • Experience building and operating secure, accessible client software at enterprise scale, using telemetry and live-site insights to guide architectural investments.
  • Experience with device, input, display, audio/video, or peripheral integration for remote or virtualized scenarios.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity.

title: Teamleader winkel Mariakerke Gent
description:
dit ga je doen

Als teamleader ben jij de motor achter een succesvolle afdeling in de winkel – of dit nu mode, hardware of food is. Jij zorgt samen met de filiaalmanager en andere teamleaders dat alles op rolletjes loopt, neemt elkaars taken over bij afwezigheid, en staat klaar om te helpen waar nodig. Jouw taak? Het informeren, coachen en begeleiden van jouw team, zodat ze elke dag met plezier aan de slag gaan.

Je maakt jouw afdeling tot een succes door duidelijke doelen te stellen, zowel op commercieel vlak als in de persoonlijke ontwikkeling van je teamleden. Denk aan het delen van de commerciële kalender, nieuwe productinformatie en dagelijkse targets, maar ook aan het ontwikkelen van talenten binnen jouw team. Je hebt een dynamische rol waarin je stuurt op KPI’s, organiseert, activiteiten plant, nieuwe collega’s inwerkt en samen met jouw team de klant een geweldige ervaring biedt.

dit bieden wij
Bij HEMA werk je in een omgeving waar mensen écht samenwerken. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, wordt goed begeleid en krijgt feedback waar je écht iets aan hebt. Of je nu net begint of al ervaring hebt: bij ons ben je welkom. Daarnaast krijg je bij HEMA:

  • 💸Een goed salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring (barema’s van paritair comité 311)
  • 🌴 Dubbel vakantiegeld
  • 🍽️Maaltijdcheques
  • 🛍️ 15% personeelskorting op al je HEMA-favorieten – van stroopwafels tot handdoeken en notitieboeken.
  • 🎄Kerstpremie
  • 🧓Een groepsverzekering
  • 🚍Terugbetaling van vervoerskosten
  • 🎡 Toegang tot het 'benefits at work'-platform, met korting op topmerken, dagjes uit en andere extra's die het leven leuker maken.
  • 🚀 Leren & ontwikkelen: volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen, met trainingen en hulp van je collega’s.

dit breng je mee

  • Ervaring in leidinggeven: Je hebt al aantoonbare werkervaring in een leidinggevende of senior medewerker rol in de retail, supermarkt, horeca of een vergelijkbare omgeving en bent klaar voor je volgende stap.
  • Ondernemend denken: Jij hebt ideeën over hoe dingen beter kunnen. Kom maar op, want wij willen leren van jouw frisse blik!
  • Gastvrijheid: Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands (minimaal niveau B2); dit is essentieel voor het begeleiden van je HEMA-winkelteam én voor het bieden van goede service aan onze klanten.
  • Denken én Doen: Van plannen maken tot uitvoeren, jij doet het allebei moeiteloos.
  • Ontwikkelmentaliteit: Niet alleen jij, maar ook jouw team groeit onder jouw leiding.

jij maakt HEMA echt
Bij HEMA werken we met ruim 17.000 collega’s aan een beter alledaags leven in een mooiere wereld. Met producten die praktischer, mooier, beter zijn en ook nog eens langer meegaan. Én met kleurrijke winkels in dorpen, steden en online. We zijn trots op hoe ver we zijn gekomen, maar we zijn nog niet tevreden. HEMA is weer écht HEMA en klaar voor de volgende stap. Onze ambitie? Koploper worden in een uitdagende markt. Dat doen we samen, als één team, met trotse collega’s, ondernemers en partners. Door te spelen om te winnen. Dat betekent dat je nieuwsgierig bent, kansen grijpt, met plezier samenwerkt en altijd gaat voor het beste resultaat. Je durft jezelf uit te spreken en anderen uit te dagen om samen beter te worden. Jij kunt met jouw unieke bijdrage meebouwen aan het HEMA van morgen. Jij maakt HEMA echt. Doe je mee?

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Finance App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

We're looking for an MLOps Engineer to own the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning models in production at CUBE. As our AI capabilities grow — spanning both proprietary ML models and large language model integrations — we need someone who can build the infrastructure and operational discipline that keeps those systems reliable, observable, and cost-effective.

You'll sit at the intersection of data engineering, software engineering, and machine learning, translating the work of data scientists and AI architects into robust, scalable production systems. In a platform undergoing significant consolidation following CUBE's acquisitions, this role has real scope: you'll be helping to establish MLOps as a discipline from the ground up, not inheriting a fully formed practice.

This role reports to the Lead Data Scientist and works closely with the broader Data and AI Engineering team. You'll be expected to bring rigour and ownership to everything from pipeline automation and model deployment to LLM observability and provider governance.

We're looking for someone who cares about operability as much as capability — who understands that a model no one can monitor, retrain, or roll back isn't production-ready, regardless of its benchmark scores.


Build and maintain ML pipelines — design, automate, and operationalise end-to-end pipelines for model training, evaluation, and deployment using Azure-native tooling including Azure AI Foundry and Azure Machine Learning

3-4 years of experience into Machine learning, Azure, deployment, pipeline is needed.

Own model deployment and serving infrastructure — manage containerised model endpoints, versioning, traffic management, and rollback mechanisms across environments

Implement monitoring and observability — establish model performance monitoring, data drift detection, and alerting frameworks that give the team early warning of degradation in production

Govern LLM usage across CUBE's platform — take ownership of LLM provider relationships (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic), manage API access and versioning, track token consumption, and optimise cost across workloads

Manage the LLM gateway and prompt versioning — maintain tooling such as LangSmith or Helicone for tracing, evaluation, and prompt lifecycle management in production environments

Support experiment tracking and model registry — ensure that experiments are reproducible, models are catalogued, and the path from experiment to production is governed and auditable

Collaborate with data scientists and engineers — work closely with the Lead Data Scientist and Data Engineering team to understand modelling requirements and translate them into reliable production systems

Champion engineering best practices — bring CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and automated testing discipline to ML workflows; reduce toil and manual intervention wherever possible

Drive platform reliability and cost efficiency — monitor infrastructure spend, identify optimisation opportunities, and ensure platform SLAs are met

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
