About the role:

The Peripheral Vascular Consultant position requires someone with strong clinical aptitude that can excel in a team environment. Key responsibilities include developing new accounts and expanding usage of company products within existing accounts to meet sales quota based on company goals to increase revenue. The Peripheral Vascular Consultant will have the opportunity to sell and promote company products within a defined geography territory. The Vascular Therapies team with Boston Scientific is looking for high energy, driven, and passionate people who are not just looking for a job but for a career.


At Boston Scientific, our products and technologies are used to diagnose and treat a wide range of medical conditions within the arterial and venous system such as deep vein thrombosis, post-thrombotic syndrome, pulmonary embolism, and compressive diseases. We continue to innovate in key areas and are extending our innovations into new geographies and high growth adjacency markets. We are able to provide a number of solutions to patients that include: Angiojet, Zelante DVT, thrombectomy catheter, EKOS, Peripheral guide wires, drug-eluting stents and balloons, atherectomy, and IVUS. We have a robust product pipeline and will continue to make an investment in interventional treatments that positively impact patient lives.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Sells products by scheduling sales calls to meet with current and potential customers to fulfill revenue and unit growth objectives assigned by company on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.
  • Develops and implements sales strategies by determining the relevant factors (e.g., product, competition and pricing needs) of existing and potential accounts to effectively promote the company's products to appropriate hospital personnel and physicians.
  • Develops action plans (i.e., weekly, quarterly, monthly) by analyzing quarterly and monthly sales figures and reports identifying the needs of particular accounts and discussing issues with Regional Sales Manager to help the organization achieve its annual sales goals.

  • Managing clinicals throughout cases and across different territories.
  • Educates customers on the merits and proper clinical usage of company products by giving presentations and demonstrations using a wide variety of formats and platforms (e.g., slides, transparencies, manuals) to secure purchasing commitments, often with the help of incentive programs and services made available to the account being developed.

title: Economic Development Project Manager
description:
City of Bay City

Full Time - Economic Development Project Manager

Community Development Department - Teamsters 214NS

JOB SUMMARY

This is administrative and technical work in economic development and project management. The work involves developing and coordinating the City's economic development strategies; maintaining liaison with local, state and federal agencies responsible for economic growth; acting as a contact person for business concerns requiring information on local economic development programs and policies and providing staff assistance for organizations as assigned.

Individual will be called upon to manage public improvements for special projects relating to economic development.

An employee in this position may be called upon to do any or all of the following essential functions. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or logical assignment to the class. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily.

  1. Responsibilities include the packaging, coordination and document management of local, state and federal economic development incentives.
  2. Collaborates with the Community Development Director and the Economic Development Program Manager as well as other City Divisions and Departments to plan and implement the City's economic development programs and objectives.
  3. Builds and maintains effective, professional relationships with business leaders, advisory groups, citizens, state and local government leaders, private developers, realtors, banking and financial leaders, professional economic development and trade associations, economic development professionals and other community leaders.
  4. Provides technical support and coordinates clerical and other staff support organizations such as the special assessment boards and/or other organizations as assigned.
  5. Proposes and writes resolutions, staff reports, and other official documents as required related to economic development. Makes presentations to the City Commission, business community groups, and the general public regarding economic development programs, issues, policies, initiatives and incentives. Follows up on Commission actions and requests related to Economic Development and City-owned property.
  6. Gathers information on other local, state and federal economic development programs to ensure the City's programs are contemporary and competitive. Develops and implements short and long-range economic development strategies and work plans. Recommends adjustments in programs, activities, policies, and procedures to further economic development goals.
  7. Liaison for federal and state grants obtained, including grant management and reporting.
  8. Supports the Economic Development Program Manager in certain aspects of their roles and responsibilities.
  9. Frequent interaction with developers and serves as a primary contact with environmental consultants, attorneys, architectural and/or engineering design professionals as well as building and infrastructure contractors and crews to implement the City's development activities.
  10. Provides professional services related to real estate including: property negotiations, acquisitions, title review, document preparation, closing, property research, and property inventory.
  11. Maintains confidentiality while participating in negotiations for the acquisition or disposition of real property.
  12. Meets with prospects, developers, and business representatives to discuss opportunities and incentive programs; provides information regarding development sites, City regulations, and conducts client and prospect tours. Provide technical assistance to clients interested in local, state and federal incentive programs.
  13. Participates in civic organizations and related activities in the interest of maintaining contacts.
  14. Sensitive handling of confidential and proprietary information is required.
  15. Assists with preparation of the Economic Development Division Budget as well as preparation and administration of several other budgets
  16. Coordinates City's efforts with infrastructure improvements in connection with economic development related projects including, but not limited to, preparing requests for bids, solicitation of consultants, project plans and specifications.
  17. The writing, coordination, recordkeeping and administration of multiple grants is also required.
  18. Performs related work as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

The Director of Community Development may accept any combination of experience, education, skills and certifications, or substitutions at their discretion.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, abilities, and qualifications necessary to perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the job.

Ability to:

  • Work effectively under stress and changes in work priorities.
  • Establish effective working relationships with employees, the public, developers, financiers, and other government agencies and officials
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written are required
  • Effectively prioritize tasks, work well under pressure and impending deadlines
  • Work in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Work individually and as part of a work team.
  • Attend after hour's meetings and public speaking.
  • Meet project deadlines which may require working more than 40 hours per week.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in economics, marketing, planning, public or business administration or related field. A Master's Degree in Administration or Business Administration is preferred.
  • Five years of increasingly responsible work experience in any combination of public or private business, real estate development or construction management, or economic development and/or experience in a legal environment.
  • Experience in municipal administration highly desirable. Other combinations of experience and education which indicate the Job Requirements and Essential Duties can be satisfactorily performed will be considered.
  • Strong organizational skills required to manage multiple responsibilities concurrently.
  • It is expected that a person in this position will participate in various activities to maintain knowledge of current programs and practices in the economic development arena.
  • Must possess and maintain a valid Michigan driver's license.

title: Principal Applied Scientist for Copilot Evals
description:
Overview
CADET (Customer and Analytics Driven Evals Team) is building a customer-grounded quality system for Copilot. Our mission is to rapidly identify the customer scenarios that matter most, represent them faithfully in evaluation and learning assets, run quality gates continuously, and turn every important failure into reusable product and model improvements.
We bring together DSAT and other product signals, deep customer engagements to create representative eval sets. Operating in a fast-paced environment, we connect customer grounded quality issues with quality teams to advance Copilot quality and product innovation.
We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist to work directly with enterprise customers and Copilot teams, translating high-value workflows, expected outcomes, and recurring pain points into trusted evaluation and learning signals. You will set the scientific direction for customer-grounded quality: define what “good” means, assess whether eval portfolios represent real needs, diagnose model and agent failures, and convert evidence into reusable evals, RLEs, reward signals, and post-training priorities. The ideal candidate combines scientific depth with product judgment and can turn ambiguous customer problems into rigorous, scalable methods in partnership with applied researchers and ML engineers.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.


Responsibilities
  • Set the scientific strategy for customer-grounded quality across priority Copilot intents, defining what good means and the tradeoffs across various quality and safety attributes
  • Translate user research, enterprise customer feedback, DSAT, and production incidents into evaluation and post-training priorities, then lead cross-team creation of reusable evaluation, regression, RLE, and post-training assets for the highest-value workflows and failure patterns.
  • Develop methods to assess evaluation-set representativeness, coverage, freshness, discrimination, grader reliability, and alignment with production outcomes, identifying material gaps, drift, and emerging loss patterns.
  • Design behavior and task evaluations, rubrics, graders, and calibration methods that translate qualitative customer expectations into measurable release-over-release quality.
  • Establish methods to attribute quality losses across grounding, retrieval, tools, orchestration, model reasoning, response generation, and evaluation, linking offline movement with online signals such as DSAT, task completion, retries, abandonment, and escalation.
  • Set a high bar for scientific rigor, reproducibility, documentation, and interpretation of results while mentoring scientists and engineers and influencing evaluation and post-training strategy across organizational boundaries.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR equivalent experience.

Preferred: Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, applied mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Significant experience applying machine learning, natural language processing, information retrieval, reinforcement learning, experimentation, or evaluation methods to complex production systems.
  • Experience designing evaluations, metrics, experiments, datasets, graders, or reward functions for AI or agentic systems.
  • Hands-on ability to inspect model outputs, identify behavioral patterns, and translate qualitative judgments into testable hypotheses and measurable evaluation criteria.
  • Solid understanding of statistical inference, sampling, measurement validity, bias, uncertainty, and experimental design.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to drive results across organizational boundaries by aligning science, engineering, product, and platform teams around shared quality goals, explicit ownership boundaries, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience with large language models, copilots, agents, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, or enterprise grounding.
  • Experience running or partnering on RLHF, direct preference optimization, instruction tuning, fine-tuning, or human-preference data programs.
  • Experience connecting offline metrics with online product behavior and customer outcomes.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers or translating qualitative research and customer signals into scientific assets.
  • Publication record, patents, or demonstrated industry impact in relevant applied research areas.

title: SR Frontier Industry Advisor - Insurance
description:
Overview

Japan – Frontier Industry Advisor – Financial Services

Are you passionate about banking & Insurance industry transformation for the Frontier AI era? Financial Services(FSI) is undergoing a fundamental shift in how institutions grow, operate, manage risk, meet regulatory expectations, and serve customers. Banks/Insurers are moving from experimentation to enterprise-scale transformation, reshaping customer engagement, relationship management, lending, payments, deposits, treasury services, fraud and financial crime, credit and risk decisioning, compliance, operations, and core banking modernization. By applying trustworthy, secure, scalable AI, Microsoft is helping FSI reimagine their businesses from outcomes inward—using breakthrough technologies to simplify operations, improve decision quality, strengthen resilience, deepen customer trust, and unlock new sources of growth. Microsoft’s Frontier Industry Advisory team is at the heart of that innovation, working directly with banking business leaders to rewrite the playbook in light of disruption while staying grounded in the mission and business objectives of the industry.

Across Japan, banks/ insurers are navigating a distinctive regulatory and market environment, alongside supervisory expectations from FSA. This role brings that regional context to how Microsoft helps banks scale trustworthy AI.

As a Frontier Industry Advisor on the Asia Frontier Financial Services Industry team, you will help Microsoft’s most strategic banking/ insurance customers define and execute AI-led transformation agendas. This role is responsible for originating industry-led business opportunities and executive conversations that connect business outcomes to Microsoft cloud, data, AI, security, and partner capabilities. You will be the banking/ insurance industry subject matter expert engaging with senior business decision makers to identify, generate, and nurture transformational opportunities. You will go deep with select customers to help them move beyond isolated pilots toward governed, scalable AI adoption that delivers enterprise outcomes such as profitable growth, improved operating leverage, faster and more trusted credit decisioning, stronger fraud and financial crime controls, better customer and banker experiences, operational resilience, and regulatory confidence. You will also develop Microsoft’s frontier banking/ insurance practice through thought leadership, targeted customer engagements, and strategic planning with Microsoft’s account teams and industry leadership.

A defining element of Microsoft’s Frontier Company strategy is Forward Deployed Engineering

(FDE)—multidisciplinary, AI-accelerated engineering teams that embed with customers to co-build and productionize AI and agent solutions. As an Industry Advisor, you are a primary originator of FDE opportunities: you identify where embedded engineering can move a bank from AI ambition and isolated pilots to production-grade outcomes, and you partner closely with FDE teams and the account team to turn industry vision into deployed business value.



Responsibilities

Planning and Engagement

  • Serves as the banking/ insurance industry subject matter expert in Japan, in digital and AI transformation and account planning. Engages internal stakeholders on account planning and partner business planning, including key business leaders, global systems integrators, independent software vendors, solution partners, and Microsoft account teams. Reviews customer industry plans and lends credibility by aligning Microsoft capabilities to strategic banking priorities.

  • Brings a multi-year strategic industry perspective to digital and AI transformation. Provides thought leadership via focus on broad global industry trends to evangelize worldwide industry strategies and/or large ecosystem plays into local market and/or must-win accounts. Drives stakeholder mapping to identify and influence key stakeholders and decision makers in the customer business. Partners locally with ISVs to inform industry knowledge. Participates in planning rhythms with the core account team and other team members to discuss strategy needed to deliver on the account plan. Increases the speed of adoption of Microsoft technologies by plotting the strategic, long-term vision of the customer’s/partner’s business strategy and driving appropriate actions to bring it to fruition.

  • Leads multi-horizon planning to outline an approach for industry-oriented solution selling with the customer. Creates segment-focused three-horizon roadmaps for impactful accounts based on business and technology priorities, as well as a deep understanding of their industry.

  • Builds and maintains relationships with external senior- and executive-level decision makers and partners, leveraging targeted stakeholders at the assigned customer.

  • Acts as an industry advisor to the executive-level business decision makers at the customer’s business by applying deep understanding of their business strategy, market dynamics, relevant technology trends, and Microsoft’s Industry point of view (POV).

Sales Execution

  • Identifies customer needs, industry readiness, and business-value opportunities across the banking value chain, including retail banking, commercial banking, corporate banking, payments, lending, deposits, treasury services, cash management, branch and contact center operations, customer service, marketing and personalization, financial crime and fraud, risk, compliance, regulatory reporting, data and analytics, core banking modernization, operations, and digital banking channels. Will also be needed to step in on insurance accounts as the situation demands.

  • Leads industry-led conversations that position Frontier AI as a catalyst for banking & insurer transformation, connecting Microsoft technology to measurable business outcomes across revenue growth, operating leverage, credit and risk decisioning, fraud reduction, regulatory confidence, customer experience, employee productivity, and enterprise resilience.

  • Applies an outcomes-inward approach to shape market-making opportunities, starting with the customer outcome and working backward to the process, architecture, data, AI, security, governance, and change-management requirements needed to scale. Focus areas include faster customer onboarding, improved relationship manager and banker productivity, accelerated loan origination and servicing, improved fraud detection, enhanced credit and risk insights, stronger compliance controls, more efficient regulatory reporting, modernized branch and contact center experiences, personalized digital engagement, and resilient banking operations. For insurers this will additionally include Underwriting, Claims management, actuarial operations, customer engagement across channels and distribution.

  • Collaborates with account teams, rapid deployment teams, industry solution teams, partner teams, and internal stakeholders to build and mature banking pipeline. Conducts customer and market research to understand operating models, revenue levers, cost pressures, credit and risk posture, regulatory priorities, data estates, and the highest-value opportunities to apply AI, cloud, and agentic workflow technologies to enterprise-scale transformation.

  • Represents the financial services industry perspective in customer conversations and ideation sessions, helping create a shared vision for how Microsoft can transform the business from customer acquisition and engagement to credit decisioning, risk and compliance, operations, data and analytics platforms, payments, digital channels, branch and contact center experiences, and core banking modernization.

  • Identifies, advances, and scales high-impact Frontier AI scenarios for strategic banking and insurance accounts, including AI-assisted relationship management, banker and contact center copilots, intelligent document processing, loan origination and servicing automation, credit decisioning support, fraud and financial crime investigation, customer service automation, personalized digital banking, treasury and cash management workflows, regulatory and compliance automation, enterprise knowledge assistants, branch modernization, payments modernization, and core banking transformation.

  • Helps customers move beyond AI pilots to enterprise-ready Frontier AI transformation by rethinking FSI operating models, redesigning workflows, modernizing data foundations, and embedding responsible AI, security, and governance at scale. Develops a banking/ insurer vision and business-value cases that connect Microsoft technology to growth, productivity, risk reduction, resilience, regulatory readiness, customer experience, and long-term commercial success. Acts as a trusted advisor to senior decision makers, leveraging customer success, market insight, and banking priorities to shape strategic opportunities, expand solutions across business lines and regions, and incubate early-stage transformation pipeline.

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)

  • Champions Forward Deployed Engineering—a core motion of Microsoft’s Frontier Company strategy—helping strategic banking/ insurance customers move from AI ambition and isolated pilots to embedded, co-engineered, production-grade solutions delivered by Microsoft’s forward-deployed engineering teams.

  • Actively identifies, originates, and qualifies FDE opportunities across the account portfolio, recognizing the signals of a strong engagement—a material business problem with senior executive sponsorship, clear intent to reach production, a need for embedded engineering rather than staff augmentation, and meaningful use of the Microsoft platform—and works with the account team to bring those opportunities forward.

  • Partners closely with FDE engineering crews throughout the engagement lifecycle and acts as an industry front door for FDE—connecting business sponsors, account teams, and delivery leaders around a shared agenda, and aligning industry strategy and business-value cases with hands-on co-engineering so that banking/ insurer AI and agent scenarios scale securely and sustainably into production.

Collaboration and Partner Management

  • Collaborates with account teams, business strategy leads, business development managers, solution architects, technical specialists, industry solution teams, consulting teams, and partner organizations to plan, orchestrate, and execute customer opportunities.

  • Works across the Microsoft partner ecosystem to bring together capabilities that solve complex banking business problems. Helps customers understand how Microsoft cloud, data, AI, Frontier AI, security, low-code, productivity, business applications, and partner solutions come together into practical, outcome-oriented transformation patterns.

  • Coordinates with commercial, legal, compliance, engineering, and customer success teams to establish formal partnerships and advance strategic programs that support customer transformation, Microsoft growth, and long-term trust.

Industry Expertise

  • Proactively builds and maintains knowledge of Microsoft’s and other industry-relevant solutions and capabilities. Proactively builds strong knowledge of the industry, including trends, policy implications (e.g., privacy), and competitors to act as a subject matter expert and inform decisions on pursuit or withdrawal.

  • Leads communication to provide feedback across the ecosystem (i.e., cross-pollinating information across teams/industries) to other teams (e.g., sales, marketing, engineering) on future product trends or sales blockers, and to guide industry solutions team members in a wide variety of specialties, leveraging deep industry knowledge to articulate nuances and anticipate gaps.

  • Advises and presents at industry and customer communities. Provides recommendations on accounts and establishes a learning baseline for less experienced colleagues. Proactively seeks out additional training to build on career competencies, including information that adds to the understanding of customers’ businesses, and shares it with team members.



Qualifications

Attitude Requirements

  • Embody our culture and values.

  • Should have a “Can do“ attitude

  • Must be a strong collaborator, maturity to navigate complex and matrixed internal org with the ability to manage through influence

  • Building relationships in the organization is key to getting things done

  • Someone who demonstrates perseverance, grit and finds a compliant way to get things done, when obstacles are encountered

  • Should be able to lead with an “entrepreneur” and “owner mindset” and lead with accountability to bring value to customers and therefore Microsoft

Required / Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 7+ years customer-facing experience in financial services, management consulting, consultative selling, technology, or industry-relevant equivalent management or technical work experience,

  • OR Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Health Sciences, Supply Chain, Education, Business, or related field AND 5+ years customer-facing experience in financial services, management consulting, consultative selling, technology, or industry-relevant equivalent management or technical work experience,

title: Senior Software Engineer - Windows App
description:
Overview

About the team
The Windows Cloud Experiences team builds the Windows App, the unified client for connecting to Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, and remote PCs. We create secure, reliable, and high performance client experiences that bring together native Windows capabilities and cloud-powered services across devices and form factors.

We are looking for a senior engineer who enjoys working close to the Windows platform and can turn complex operating-system, networking, identity, and remoting challenges into polished customer experiences. This role is centered on Windows client and platform engineering, not only surface-level user interface development.

About the role
As a Senior Software Engineer on Windows App, you will own important areas of the native Windows client from architecture through implementation, validation, release, and live-site support. You will work across application, platform, and service boundaries to make remote Windows experiences feel secure, responsive, dependable, and deeply integrated with the operating system.

You will join a collaborative, fast-moving team that values technical depth, customer focus, engineering craftsmanship, and end-to-end ownership. You will also help other engineers grow through design guidance, code reviews, debugging support, and mentoring.



Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and ship native Windows client features using modern C++, with C# used where appropriate, and integrate deeply with Win32, WinRT, COM, Windows services, and operating-system APIs.
  • Own Windows App scenarios across resource discovery, connection setup, authentication, OS integration, reliability, and performance.
  • Develop secure, scalable, and maintainable components that span processes, threads, services, client applications, and cloud-backed experiences.
  • Diagnose complex problems using debuggers, dumps, traces, logs, and telemetry, including issues involving concurrency, memory, networking, latency, and operating-system integration.
  • Drive features through the full engineering lifecycle: architecture, design, implementation, testing, deployment, experimentation, monitoring, and live-site response.
  • Partner with Windows, Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, identity, security, design, and product teams to deliver coherent end-to-end customer experiences.
  • Raise the engineering bar for performance, reliability, accessibility, security, testability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Mentor engineers, lead technical discussions, and create clarity in ambiguous or cross-team problem spaces.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C++, or C#.
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.

  • Production experience designing, implementing, debugging, and shipping software in modern C++; experience with C# is also valuable.
  • Experience building native Windows applications, platform components, services, or other systems-level software.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, s, with a record of mentoring or providing technical leadership to other engineers.
  • Deep knowledge of Windows systems technologies such as Win32, WinRT, COM, RPC, Windows services, inter-process communication, and core Windows APIs.
  • Experience with remote desktop, virtualization, or virtual desktop infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience with networking, authentication, and identity in Windows clients, including Microsoft Entra ID, MSAL, or Web Account Manager.
  • Experience debugging multi-process, multi-threaded, performance-critical native code, including memory, concurrency, latency, and reliability issues.
  • Experience with Windows App SDK, WinUI, XAML, WebView2, MSIX, or related Windows client technologies.

title: Vastaanoton vuoropäällikkö, Scandic Simonkenttä & Scandic Helsinki Station
description:
Meillä on paikka sinulle, vastaanoton vuoropäällikkö!

Haemme vastaanoton vuoropäällikköä Scandic Simonkentän ja Scandic Helsinki Stationin yhteiseen tiimiin! Tehtävä on kokoaikainen (112,5 h / 3 viikkoa) ja on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja aloitusajankohta sovitaan kanssasi erikseen. Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään kahdessa vilkkaassa Helsingin keskustan hotellissa, joissa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen. Vastaanoton vuoropäällikkönä olet tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa, että vieraamme saavat sujuvan, lämpimän ja unohtumattoman palvelukokemuksen jokaisella vierailullaan.

Työtehtäväsi vastaanoton vuoropäällikkönä

Vastaanoton vuoropäällikkönä vastaat vuorosi sujuvuudesta, asiakastyytyväisyydestä ja tiimin onnistumisesta. Johdat vuoroa omalla esimerkilläsi osallistuen aktiivisesti vastaanoton päivittäiseen työhön ja huolehdit siitä, että palvelu on laadukasta kiireisimpinäkin hetkinä.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

  • vastaanoton operatiivisen toiminnan johtaminen vuoron aikana
  • vieraiden erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen varmistaminen
  • tiimin tukeminen, ohjaaminen ja innostaminen jokapäiväisessä työssä
  • hotellin palveluiden, lisäpalveluiden ja tuotteiden aktiivinen suosittelu yhdessä tiimin kanssa
  • lisämyynnin kehittäminen ja myynnillisen toimintatavan vahvistaminen
  • uusien tiimiläisten ja harjoittelijoiden perehdyttäminen
  • hallinnollisista tehtävistä ja vuorokäytännöistä huolehtiminen
  • vieraiden ja henkilökunnan turvallisuuden varmistaminen vuoron aikana.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän kahdessa tunnetussa kaupunkihotellissa, joissa pääset kehittämään sekä omaa osaamistasi että tiimisi toimintaa. Saat tueksesi ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa vastaanoton arkeen ja asiakaskokemuksen kehittämiseen. Lisäksi tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia kouluttautumiseen ja urakehitykseen osana kansainvälistä hotellikonsernia.

Odotamme sinulta

Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta hotellin vastaanottotyöstä sekä aitoa innostusta ihmisten johtamiseen ja asiakaskokemuksen kehittämiseen. Aiempi kokemus vuoropäällikön tai muun esihenkilötehtävän tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.

Etsimämme henkilö:

  • osaa rakentaa luottamusta ja motivoida tiimiään yhteisiin tavoitteisiin
  • johtaa valmentavalla otteella ja auttaa muita onnistumaan
  • innostaa tiimiä myynnilliseen työskentelyyn ja tunnistamaan lisämyynnin mahdollisuuksia
  • seuraa aktiivisesti tavoitteiden toteutumista ja kehittää toimintaa yhdessä tiimin kanssa
  • omaa positiivisen, ratkaisukeskeisen ja vastuullisen työskentelytavan
  • viihtyy vaihtelevissa tilanteissa ja säilyttää toimintakyvyn myös kiireessä
  • kommunikoi sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti
  • haluaa luoda vieraille erinomaisia hotellikokemuksia joka päivä

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa Hotel Manager Pipsa Pulkkinen: pipsa.pulkkinen@scandichotels.com

title: Senior Hardware Integration Engineer
description:
As TwentyFour grows, our bottleneck is no longer just designing individual subsystems—it's integrating them into reliable, flight-ready UAVs.

Today, much of the knowledge and decision-making required to bring mechanics, electronics and embedded systems together sits with a small number of senior engineers. As prototype frequency increases and multiple products are developed in parallel, this creates both a throughput bottleneck and a key-person dependency.

The Hardware Integration Engineer exists to own the execution of hardware integration, taking released subsystem designs and transforming them into validated flying prototypes while enabling specialist engineers to remain focused on their disciplines. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role, not a project management or people management position.

The Hardware Integration Engineer works across Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Embedded Software and Flight Test to ensure complete UAV systems are successfully integrated, debugged, validated and ready for flight.

The role combines practical engineering with technical leadership of prototype execution.

Core Responsibilities

Hardware Integration & Prototype Execution

  • Own the transition from subsystem designs to complete flight-ready prototypes.
  • Lead prototype integration, hardware bring-up and multidisciplinary debugging.
  • Identify and resolve integration issues before they become flight test problems.
  • Ensure prototypes are built, validated and technically ready for testing.

Hands-on Engineering

Remain actively involved in engineering work across multiple disciplines, including:

  • PCB modifications, interface boards and wiring harnesses.
  • Mechanical prototype components, fixtures and integration hardware.
  • Hardware debugging, assembly, rework and rapid prototyping.
  • Embedded bring-up and hardware validation activities where required.
The role complements specialist engineers rather than replacing them.


Flight Test Interface

Act as the primary Hardware Engineering interface to Flight Test by:
  • Preparing aircraft for testing.
  • Ensuring tests answer the intended engineering questions.
  • Supporting investigation of hardware issues.
  • Driving engineering improvements from flight test results.
Flight Test owns test execution; this role owns ensuring Hardware Engineering extracts maximum learning from it.


Hardware Enablement

Develop tools and methods that improve hardware development, including:
  • Board validation firmware.
  • Testautomation.
  • Manufacturing and EOL test solutions.
  • Engineering utilities and instrumentation.
  • Improved prototype workflows and repeatability.

Role Boundaries

Mechanical Engineering: Owns mechanical architecture and major subsystem design.

Electronics Engineering: Owns electronics architecture and major PCB development.

Embedded Software: Owns production firmware and embedded software.

Systems Engineering: Owns requirements, system architecture and verification strategy.

Hardware Integration Engineering: Owns the technical execution of integrating these disciplines into validated, flight-ready hardware.

This role is intentionally different from Systems Engineering. Systems Engineering defines how the system should work; Hardware Integration Engineering ensures the hardware is successfully built, integrated, debugged and validated.

Success Measures

Success is measured by improved engineering throughput rather than individual output.

Examples include:
  • Reduced time from design release to flight-ready prototype.
  • Reduced dependency on senior specialists for prototype integration.
  • Improved prototype quality and repeatability.
  • Faster resolution of hardware issues.
  • Better learning from flight testing.
  • Increased ability to develop multiple products in parallel.

Vision

Initially, this role will be highly hands-on, personally building, integrating and debugging hardware alongside the engineering team. As TwentyFour grows, the role should evolve into the technical owner of prototype integration—establishing better integration methods, validation approaches and prototype workflows while remaining fundamentally an engineering position.

Longer term, this capability could expand into a broader Prototype Integration function supporting multiple products, additional integration engineers and dedicated prototype infrastructure.

The objective is not to create another management layer, but to build a scalable engineering capability that allows specialist teams to focus on designing excellent subsystems while Hardware Integration ensures those subsystems become reliable flying products.

title: Principal Researcher - Quantum
description:
Overview

Join Microsoft Quantum’s laboratory in Lyngby, Denmark, and help build advanced quantum computing platforms that connect scientific discovery with system engineering. You will work with physicists, engineers, computer scientists, and researchers across disciplines to advance quantum devices, control systems, architectures, software, and cloud-connected capabilities as an integrated system.

At Microsoft Quantum, we aim to empower science and scientists to solve the world’s biggest problems by realizing advanced computing platforms at the intersection of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and quantum information technology. Microsoft Quantum will change the world of computing and help solve some of humankind’s currently unsolvable problems. For more information about our team, visit .

As a Principal Researcher, you will take technical ownership of a major subsystem or capability within a quantum hardware program and help move technology from scientific concepts through experimental validation and system realization. You will define system strategy, make architectural decisions grounded in scientific and engineering evidence, identify the experiments that reduce the most important uncertainties, and guide technical investments. Your primary impact will come from system-level thinking, technical judgment, and leadership, while maintaining the technical depth needed to work closely with theorists, engineers, software developers, external collaborators, and technology partners. You will mentor scientists and engineers and help establish technical excellence across the organization. We expect to make multiple hires, and we welcome candidates with depth and leadership in any quantum hardware architecture or adjacent advanced experimental-systems discipline.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

• Own the technical strategy, architecture, and design of a major subsystem or capability within a quantum hardware program, evaluating trade-offs, risks, and opportunities using scientific and engineering evidence.

• Design and drive critical experiments that reduce uncertainty, enable informed technical decisions, and uphold high standards for data quality, validation, calibration, and reproducibility.

• Translate scientific insight into practical system requirements, designs, performance targets, and execution plans.

• Partner across theory, engineering, and software teams to connect models, simulations, measurements, controls, and implementation into an integrated system.

• Work with external suppliers, technology partners, and research collaborators to advance program goals and mitigate technical risks.

• Mentor scientists and engineers, communicate complex technical topics to senior leaders and external stakeholders, and contribute to technical excellence across the organization.

• Embody our culture and values.



Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

• Doctorate in Physics, Engineering, or a related field, OR Master’s Degree in Physics, Engineering, or a related field, OR Bachelor’s Degree in Physics, Engineering, or a related field, OR equivalent experience.

• Experience in leading or building complex quantum architecture.

• Experience designing experiments and interpreting evidence for critical decisions.

• Experience in quantitative systems reasoning across physical mechanisms and architecture.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • Citizenship & Citizenship Verification: This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) or Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U.S. permanent residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading the architecture, development, and validation of at least one complex experimental, quantum, semiconductor, photonic, or other advanced physical system.

• Demonstrated deep expertise in at least one of the following: quantum hardware systems or device technologies; precision measurement or instrumentation; control, calibration, or characterization systems; advanced electronics, photonics, cryogenics, vacuum systems, radio frequency systems, materials, or integrated-system technologies; or reliability and error characterization.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary technical work involving at least two of the following: theory, hardware engineering, software, modeling or simulation, and experimental validation.

As a Microsoft Senior Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT), you will prioritize and assign ticketed work to technicians on the team, provide guidance on inbound/outbound logistics tasks, and ensure that inventory balances are accurate. This opportunity will allow you to demonstrate your expertise in standard processes and procedures for Inventory & Asset Management and develop skills around mentorship of peer technicians accelerating your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Prioritize ticketing queues, work to resolve escalations, and clear blocking issues to enable continued delivery of Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) activities.
  • Provide task specific guidance to a team of technicians responsible for preparing and executing incoming/outgoing deliveries and documenting inbound/outbound packages (e.g. purchase order [PO] receiving, Rack Movement Supervisor [RMS] activities).
  • Coordinate with external stakeholders including third-party warehouses, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) vendors, and suppliers as necessary to facilitate inbound and outbound deliveries.
  • Perform assigned tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations.
  • Leverage process knowledge and technical skills to resolve escalations (or further escalate if needed), clear blocking issues, and may enable on site and/or remote data center support activities.
  • Maintain a strong stakeholder focus to improve quality and ensure that the customer receives the highest return on their investment.
  • Ensure teams maintain and perform steps required to keep the inventory balance accurate.
  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) about the Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) warranty process ensuring teams process failed vendor hardware devices using tools and processes RMAs.
  • Manage schedule of DBD destruction or shredding in partnership with senior leadership and ensure team is following all processes and procedures to perform DBD destruction.
  • Attend, conduct, or assist in conducting daily safety briefings, completes required safety training, provides guidance to technicians to facilitate compliance with safety procedures (e.g., Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, rack moving, heavy-equipment usage, lifting, ladder/rolling stair use).

  • Embody our culture and values.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma AND 2+ year(s) experience warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field
    • OR equivalent experience.

title: Lead QA Engineer with VoIP/SIP stack (manual)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Lead QA Engineer with strong VoIP and SIP stack expertise to join our Net2Phone UCaaS platform team.

This role focuses primarily on manual testing, microservices/API validation, requirements testing alongside Product Owners, and establishing team-wide release guidelines. While the core day-to-day focus is manual execution and release orchestration, exposure to performance testing tools, build management, or Java test automation is a plus.

What You Will Do

  • Requirements Analysis & PO Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Owners to build robust requirement lists, refine acceptance criteria, and execute early-stage requirements testing before development begins.

  • Release Governance & Guidelines: Help design, document, and standardize end-to-end release processes, quality gates, and deployment guidelines for the engineering team.

  • Lead Manual & Integration Testing: Plan and execute rigorous manual test cycles across microservices and REST/gRPC APIs to validate complex integration scenarios.

  • Manage Release Operations: Orchestrate deployment tasks, build triggers, and post-deployment verifications in Jenkins across testing and staging environments.

  • Test Case Architecture: Write, organize, and maintain detailed, step-by-step manual test cases and execution runs in Allure TestOps.

  • VoIP & SIP Validation: Conduct functional testing on real-call scenarios, media flows, and SIP protocol behavior under active network conditions.

  • Agile Quality Gateway: Participate actively in SCRUM ceremonies, manage defect lifecycles in Jira, and serve as the final quality sign-off for release candidates.

What we expect:

Must-Have

  • 6+ Years in QA Engineering: Deep focus on Backend and API/Microservices testing (REST, JSON, gRPC).

  • 2+ Years in VoIP / SIP Protocol Testing: Call flow verification, media stream validation, WebRTC, or telecom load tools.

  • SIP Tracing & System Diagnostics: Strong command of Linux CLI and SIP tracing instruments (e.g., Hepic, CP Tools, tcpdump).

  • English Proficiency: Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher (written and spoken).

Nice to Have

  • Load & Performance Testing: Hands-on experience with load and performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, SIPp).

  • Build & Release Testing: Direct experience validating, testing, and promoting software builds through release cycles.

  • Programming & Automation Background: Experience or familiarity with Java (11/17) and testing frameworks (JUnit5, TestNG, Gradle) to read code, assist with debugging, or contribute to automation efforts.

Tech Stack & Tooling

  • Domain & Protocols: VoIP, SIP stack, WebRTC, REST APIs, gRPC, Microservices

  • SIP Tracing & Diagnostics: Hepic, CP Tools, tcpdump, Linux CLI

  • CI/CD & Deployments: Jenkins

  • Test & Defect Management: Allure TestOps, Jira

  • Performance & Load (Bonus): JMeter, Gatling, SIPp

  • Languages & Frameworks (Bonus): Java 11/17, JUnit5, TestNG, Gradle

  • Methodology & Process: Agile / SCRUM, Requirements Testing, Release Governance

title: Sr Counsel - Commercial
description:

As a Sr Counsel you will provide a wide range of legal counsel and support services (including commercial, transactional, and regulatory) to multiple business units. Supports Valero’s commercial operations (the transportation, storage, purchase, sale, and trading of both refinery feedstocks and finished petroleum products).

At Valero, we are committed to advancing the future of energy through innovation, ingenuity and unmatched execution. You can help achieve this goal if you can\:

Within Interventional Solutions, we design, develop and manufacture technologies that diagnose and treat coronary artery disease and other cardiovascular conditions, including acute myocardial infarction. Our portfolio includes drug-eluting stents, drug-coated balloons, bare-metal stents, catheters, balloons, guidewires, coronary atherectomy systems and coronary intravascular ultrasound (IVUS). Supported by a robust portfolio and innovation pipeline, we continue to invest in advancing interventional therapies that improve outcomes for patients around the world.

title: Data Scientist - Event Analytics
description:
Overview

The Global Marketing Engines and Experiences (E&E) team within Microsoft is responsible for delivering integrated marketing experiences for Microsoft by building, running, and innovating a globally scaled engine to deliver connected journeys that delight customers and create fans. The Marketing Analytics and Data Science team within E&E enables data-driven decision making by providing data products and insights that measure marketing's performance and impact, deepen understanding of customer behavior, and drive marketing efficiency and return on investment (ROI).

We are looking for a Marketing Data Scientist - Event Analytics who thrives at the intersection of events intelligence, causal measurement, and business impact - someone who can transform complex event and multichannel data into rigorous models that quantify how events influence marketing and business outcomes. Are you passionate about causal measurement, applied modeling, and understanding how marketing events actually move the business? Would you like to build the models and measurement approaches that partner with some of the world's most innovative event marketers and demand generation leaders, all whilst working in the dynamic, data-rich world of global-scale events supporting cloud-based business products? As a Marketing Data Scientist – Event Analytics in E&E, you will be a key modeler and hands-on contributor for events measurement across Microsoft's marketing ecosystem, from flagship events like Microsoft Ignite, Build, and AI Tour to regional roadshows, virtual, and hybrid formats. You'll build the modeling layer that estimates the incremental impact of events on downstream business outcomes (such as engagement, demand, and pipeline), connecting event registration and engagement data with customer relationship management (CRM), sales, and multichannel demand generation signals to isolate the impact of events. You'll design causal and statistical frameworks, accounting for confounding, selection bias, and attendee self-selection, and translate the results into executive-ready insights that help Event Marketing, Brand, product marketing management (PMM,) Customer Insights, and demand generation leaders make faster, better-informed decisions. We are seeking someone who is curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to use rigorous causal and statistical techniques to develop scalable, trustworthy event measurement. You build on the successes of others, value cross-team collaboration, and contribute to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.



Responsibilities

Event Impact Modeling & Causal Measurement

  • Help build and maintain the modeling framework that quantifies the impact of Microsoft marketing events, including flagship global events (Ignite, Build, AI Tour), regional experiences, virtual events, hybrid formats, and industry conferences
  • Design and apply causal inference approaches to estimate the true impact of events in settings where randomized experiments may be limited or infeasible
  • Connect event participation and engagement signals to CRM data to estimate event contribution
  • Establish standardized, defensible measurement methodologies and benchmarks for event impact across different event formats, scales, and business objectives

Modeling, Statistics & Analysis

  • Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., regression modeling, propensity scoring, survival analysis, cohort analysis, time-series forecasting, uplift modeling) with a bias toward interpretability and causal validity over purely predictive performance
  • Balance methodological rigor with pragmatism, selecting approaches that are fit for purpose given observational, incomplete, or biased marketing data
  • Write high-quality analytical code (Python, SQL) to support reproducible research, exploratory analysis, and ongoing measurement efforts
  • Develop and support experimentation frameworks (A/B tests, holdouts, geo-based designs) to strengthen causal claims and rigorously test event marketing tactics, channel strategies, and audience targeting approaches

Demand Generation & Multichannel Attribution

  • Build and refine attribution and contribution models that connect demand generation activities - email campaigns, paid media, social promotions, owned content, seller outreach - to event registrations, attendance, and downstream outcomes
  • Integrate and normalize data across web analytics, marketing automation, event registration systems, email platforms, paid media tools, and CRM/sales systems to create a unified, analysis-ready view
  • Analyze channel effectiveness, funnel performance, and audience journey patterns to identify which channels and tactics drive the highest-quality business outcomes
  • Develop frameworks that relate event and channel investment to opportunity, pipeline, and revenue outcomes by segment and campaign

Data Understanding, Enablement & Stewardship

  • Prepare, validate, and analyze complex event, web, marketing automation, and sales datasets, identifying data quality issues, structural changes, and limitations
  • Communicate data risks, constraints, and appropriate caveats proactively to senior partners, ensuring conclusions are appropriately scoped
  • Help productize models and measurement into repeatable outputs and self-service dashboards (e.g., Power BI) that democratize access to event impact insights across Event Marketing, Demand Generation, PMM, Brand, and regional teams
  • Collaborate with Data Services and Data Engineering to ensure event, web, marketing automation, and sales data are accurate, integrated, compliant, and ready for analytical use, upholding high standards for data ethics, privacy, and responsible use

Other

  • Embody our Culture and Values


Qualifications

description:
Join to apply for the Data Engineer role at Woolworths Group

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Data Engineer role at Woolworths Group

  • Harness huge datasets and work on projects to create innovative retail tools
  • Experiment with new ideas, taking a test and learn approach to your work
  • Work collaboratively with other data professionals in an Agile squad setup

We strive to create better experiences together for a better tomorrow for our customers and team, bringing the best of Woolworths Group and Quantium together to make data driven decisions. By partnering with Quantium, a world-class data science and advanced analytics business we’re excited about the future as we unlock the power of data to reimagine retail.

Through this partnership, we’ve created a new business called WiQ who will harness the best of Woolworths Group and Quantium to reimagine retail by solving the most complex problems using data and analytics. As a team, we leverage Agile ways of working to help our team develop their skills while also making sure our team is focusing on solving the most complex problems for both our customers and team.

What you’ll do

The Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, scaling and maintaining Advanced Analytics solutions using predominantly Google Cloud (GCP) products. This includes for example building data pipelines, and logging and monitoring. This work is done in multidisciplinary teams in close partnership with Data Scientists, with engineers having the primary responsibility for productionising and scaling solutions and developing cutting edge retail tools.

  • Develop Cloud based data pipelines to solve a broad range of business problems.
  • Be a part of the Engineering capability helping pioneer new tech and approaches to improve time to market, reliability and performance of Data Science and Analytical applications
  • Create, present and seek inputs and feedback on architecture, solution designs and foster alignment and support for solutions
  • Apply relevant testing frameworks to ensure the robustness of solutions
  • Communicate analysis, insights, solution designs and showcase working solutions

What you’ll bring

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer, with a problem solving mindset, able to take sometimes nebulous and abstract challenges, break it down into components and develop solution hypotheses for a range of business problems across Woolworths’ ecosystem.

  • Proficient in Python,SQL and Airflow or other orchestration tools.
  • Experience with Google Cloud or other cloud technologies to build Data Engineering solutions.
  • Growth mindset and ability to work together with the broader team in an Agile setup
  • Understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data integration techniques and engineering principles
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g. Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Understand data governance, security, and compliance frameworks

What you’ll experience

Our Team Members are at the heart of everything we do and we’re always looking for ways to support your career journey and reward great work:

  • Team discounts across our range of Woolworths Group brands you know and love and a robust rewards program that celebrates and incentivises purpose-driven work.
  • A global business with endless career possibilities around every corner and across every discipline – with valuable exposure to a vast and exciting business network.
  • High impact role supporting our teams who enrich our communities.
  • A range of programs to help you prioritise and manage your wellbeing, including 24/7 access to the Sonder app.
  • A progressive and competitive leave policy that gives you more space for what matters to you.

Endless possibilities with Woolworths Group

We’re a proud part of the Woolworths Group – 200,000+ bright minds, passionate hearts and unique perspectives working together connected by a shared Purpose – ‘to create better experiences together for a better tomorrow.’

Here you’ll be supported and empowered to explore new ideas, make brave commitments and innovate better ways to meet the food and everyday needs of more than 24 million customers every week. Backed by a culture of genuine care, a flexible approach to work and the support to grow your career and make a meaningful impact, the possibilities for what we can achieve together are endless.

Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.

Microsoft is a place where passionate innovators come together to collaborate, imagine what’s possible, and accelerate their careers. In a cloud-first, AI-powered world, we embrace bold thinking, continuous innovation, and a culture that empowers individuals to make a global impact.

Join us at the forefront of innovation within Microsoft's CoreAI Division at the Microsoft India Development Center (IDC). The mission of the Azure Native Integrations organization is to make Microsoft the best platform for agentic and application workloads for developers by enabling seamless integration of industry-leading partner solutions directly into the Azure and Foundry ecosystem.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Azure Native Integrations team, you will help build and operate the foundational platforms and services that enable customers to discover, provision, and manage best-in-class Independent Software Vendor (ISV) offerings natively within Azure and Microsoft Foundry. Our platform delivers a unified Azure-native experience across identity, billing, provisioning, governance, and lifecycle management, making partner services feel like a natural extension of Azure through the portal, APIs, SDKs, and operational tooling.

The team partners with some of the world's leading enterprise technology providers across key domains including Data & Storage, Observability, Security, Networking, and AI. Our work spans partner onboarding platforms, provisioning and control-plane services, integration frameworks, and engineering platforms that enable rapid innovation while upholding the highest standards of reliability, security, and compliance.

In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and operation of critical platform services powering Azure Native Integrations. You will provide technical leadership, collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product managers, and strategic partners, and drive end-to-end execution across two important areas: the Azure Native Infrastructure Platform and Native Partner Integration Experiences for leading data ecosystem partners across Azure and Foundry.

As Azure continues to scale globally, you will work on mission-critical distributed systems that support millions of customer interactions. You will help improve developer and partner onboarding experiences, enhance platform reliability, respond to operational challenges, and evolve next-generation AI-powered capabilities that simplify and accelerate partner integration. This role offers a unique opportunity to combine technical depth, platform engineering, and operational excellence while delivering meaningful impact to Azure and Foundry customers and partners worldwide.

title: Director of Critical Environment (CE) Operations
description:
Overview

We are looking for a Director of Critical Environment (CE) Operations to join our Microsoft Finland Team as we build out this next core region in the Microsoft's Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO). This is a leadership role with responsibility for the build-out and subsequent daily operations of the Critical Environment group, overseeing all Electrical, Mechanical, and associated Critical Environment staff and workstreams. The Critical Environment Operations Director will play a pivotal leadership role in enabling the infrastructure that supports Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive, Bing and other cloud services.

We are seeking candidates with demonstrated experience in data center operations or other critical environment settings, including work supporting mission-critical services and high-availability infrastructure. This experience may be developed across a range of industries, including data centers, manufacturing, oil and gas, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or similar critical infrastructure sectors, or through an equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience.

Microsoft's Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO) organization powers the cloud services that millions of people and organizations rely on every day. Our global infrastructure spans hundreds of datacentres and supports customers around the world.

At Microsoft, our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We embrace a growth mindset, respect diverse perspectives, and create an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive and do their best work.



Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Own Critical Environment operational accountability across safety, reliability, availability, compliance, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead executive response to critical incidents and business continuity events, driving service restoration, root cause resolution, and long-term resilience.
  • Establish governance for maintenance execution, operational readiness, procedural quality, performance management, and operational excellence.
  • Oversee enterprise operational risk, resilience, business continuity, and compliance programs.
  • Lead operational readiness for new datacenter capacity and major infrastructure programs, ensuring successful transition from construction to operations.
  • Influence multi-million-dollar investment decisions by translating technical risk into business priorities and reliability outcomes.
  • Partner with suppliers and service providers to drive performance, accountability, innovation, and value delivery.

  • Champion learning, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop future leaders and create opportunities for diverse talent to grow and advance.

Strategic Leadership

  • Translate complex technical and operational challenges into clear business decisions and strategic priorities.
  • Drive alignment across Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Security, Information Technology Operations, Environmental Health and Safety, Finance, and Business Leadership teams.
  • Shape the future of Critical Environment Operations through standardization, innovation, operational excellence, and transformation.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience leading, directly managing, and influencing large, diverse organizations of full-time employees across multiple operational, technical, and support disciplines.

title: Senior Customer Content Producer
description:
Overview

At Microsoft, we’re building a modern, AI-forward marketing organization that learns faster, activates smarter, and drives measurable impact. Our approach blends human creativity with AI-powered insights to fuel bold, culturally inspired creative strategies at scale. We prioritize outcomes over outputs, embrace rapid learning loops, and operate in agile flight formations that unite disciplines across Commercial Brand, Creative, and Customer Marketing.

Join a team that clears the path for you to thrive. As a Senior Customer Content Producer, you will sit at the heart of Customer Marketing and Advocacy, turning rich customer stories into purposeful, high‑value content that influences how Microsoft shows up with customers and partners. You will focus on priority campaigns and events, collaborating closely with teams across creative, social, events, public relations, integrated marketing, product marketing, and sales to ensure customer narratives are consistent, compelling, and aligned to business priorities.

In this role, you will own the end‑to‑end process of producing, and packaging customer content including video, interactive and multimedia packages so that it can be quickly repurposed and distributed across digital channels, events, campaigns, and key moments. Your work will help scale customer storytelling across Microsoft’s global customer base, with success measured by the volume, reach, and usage of the assets you create across the ecosystem of channels.

At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.



Responsibilities

  • Content Strategy and Planning. Bring to life the campaign strategy and business priorities by delivering high impact human-led storytelling. Develop and execute integrated content plans that extend customer stories into priority campaigns, events, and strategic initiatives. Partner with cross-functional teams to align content priorities with business objectives, audience needs, and commercial marketing moments.

  • Customer Story Development. Enable production to capture interviews that can transform into narrative arcs, plan capture of B-roll in innovative ways, deliver an organized set of media that is post-production ready, and manage an internal review cycle that ensures necessary feedback is synthesized, translated into actionable creative direction, and integrated rapidly prior to delivery.

  • Content Production and Asset Creation. Deep industry knowledge of video production and film best practices, experience leveraging AI assisted workflows for pre-production and story alignment. This includes creating clear production schedules, managing necessary agreements and releases, and coordinating logistics with internal and external teams.

  • Content Packaging and Asset Management. Own and manage customer marketing media, tag, label and archive projects and raw materials to ensure customer content is discoverable, reusable, and optimized for different audiences and moments. Partner with capabilities team and leverage intelligent tagging solution to further automate content discovery.

  • Cross-Functional Content Orchestration. Collaborate with product marketing, sales, events, public relations, social, creative, integrated marketing, and agency partners to align content plans, manage timelines, and ensure consistent storytelling across the customer journey. Coordinate multiple stakeholders while maintaining quality and delivery commitments.
