title: B2B Recoveries Specialist
description:
Cześć! 👋

Nasz klient to globalny, pozabankowy pożyczkodawca dla MŚP, który właśnie wchodzi do Krakowa 🚀

Elastyczne podejście do kredytowania oznacza też, że część klientów potrzebuje wsparcia, kiedy spłata się komplikuje — i tu wchodzi zespół Recoveries. Szukamy osoby, która połączy twarde negocjacje z rzeczowym podejściem do klienta — tak, żeby odzyskać należności, nie tracąc przy tym relacji ani reputacji firmy.

Mile widziane: 5–10 lat doświadczenia w windykacji zdobytego w kancelarii prawnej lub firmie windykacyjnej. Nie wymagamy uprawnień prawniczych — większość pracy to administracja, organizacja spraw i negocjacje, więc świetnie odnajdzie się tu doświadczony(a) paralegal, asystent(ka) prawn(y)/(a) lub manager z tego obszaru.

Najprawdopodobniej zaprosimy Cię na rozmowę, jeśli:

✔️ Masz min. 5 lat praktycznego doświadczenia w windykacji lub obsłudze trudnych/przeterminowanych należności — najlepiej w obszarze niespłacanych kredytów firmowych — np. w kancelarii prawnej, firmie windykacyjnej lub w banku,
✔️ Masz udokumentowane doświadczenie w negocjowaniu warunków spłaty, zabezpieczaniu zobowiązań do spłaty oraz rozwiązywaniu sporów z klientami,
✔️ Masz praktyczne doświadczenie w prawnych procesach windykacyjnych — w tym dokumentacji, koordynacji procesu i współpracy z zewnętrznymi doradcami prawnymi,
✔️ Potrafisz samodzielnie prowadzić złożone sprawy i koordynować różnych interesariuszy przy minimalnym wsparciu,
✔️ Masz bardzo dobre umiejętności komunikacji pisemnej i ustnej oraz podstawy analityczne (liczby, harmonogramy spłat),
✔️ Sprawnie interpretujesz i stosujesz polityki oraz procedury wewnętrzne, a także wymogi prawne.
✔️ Potrafisz dogadać się po angielsku - najlepiej jak native, ale wiemy jak jest i mocne B2 też będzie OK,

Dodatkowym atutem będzie:

✔️ Doświadczenie w fintechu, kredytach, bankowości lub usługach finansowych,
✔️ Doświadczenie w finansowaniu MŚP lub obsłudze niespłacanych kredytów firmowych,
✔️ Doświadczenie w szybko rosnącej firmie oraz w koordynacji złożonych spraw w środowisku komercyjnym.

Odnajdziesz się w tej roli, jeśli:

🔥 Potrafisz być stanowcz(y)/(a) i jednocześnie profesjonaln(y)/(a) w trudnych rozmowach,
🔥 Traktujesz każdą sprawę indywidualnie i szukasz rozwiązania korzystnego dla obu stron,
🔥 Lubisz przejmować sprawę od początku do końca i doprowadzać ją do rozwiązania.

Czym będziesz się zajmować? 📌

  • Zarządzaniem sprawami — obsługa zapytań klientów i złożonych spraw dotyczących zaległych płatności poprzez skuteczną komunikację, negocjacje i rozwiązywanie problemów.
  • Negocjacją warunków spłaty — ustalanie jasnych warunków płatności, zabezpieczanie zobowiązań do spłaty, dbanie o reputację firmy poprzez najwyższą jakość obsługi.
  • Kontaktem z klientem — odpowiadanie na zapytania i bardziej złożone potrzeby klientów różnymi kanałami komunikacji, prowadzenie połączeń przychodzących i wychodzących w sprawach windykacyjnych.
  • Prawnymi procesami windykacyjnymi — prowadzenie prawnych procesów odzyskiwania należności, przygotowanie i zarządzanie wymaganą dokumentacją, sprawdzanie sytuacji majątkowej dłużników oraz współpraca z zewnętrznymi doradcami prawnymi przy bardziej złożonych sprawach.
  • Współpracą z interesariuszami — kontakt z siecią wewnętrznych i zewnętrznych partnerów (w tym prawnych), przejmowanie pełnej odpowiedzialności za sprawę aż do jej rozwiązania, z uwzględnieniem dobrego doświadczenia klienta i wyniku biznesowego.
  • Wsparciem procesów kredytowych — wspieranie zespołu kredytowego i ryzyka w innych działaniach w miarę potrzeb.

Co oferujemy? 💰

💰 Wynagrodzenie 7 500 – 14 500 PLN brutto/mies., zależnie od doświadczenia
🌍 Udział w budowie zespołu Recoveries od podstaw w Krakowie
🤝 Bezpośrednią współpracę z zespołem prawnym i kredytowym

Brzmi jak coś dla Ciebie? Kliknij "Aplikuj" i pogadajmy 🚀

title: Software Engineer II - Data Platform & Database Systems
description:
Overview

Windows runs on over a billion devices worldwide, and the Windows Data team turns the signal from that ecosystem into the insights that shape the product. We manage, optimize, improve, and extend several multi-petabyte modern MPP (massively parallel processing) database systems — engineering at a scale where familiar solutions stop working and the harder, more interesting problems begin.

This is a code-intensive role. As a Software Engineer II, you'll work across cloud services, data platform engineering, database systems, and supporting data engineering, with room to go deep into the internals of distributed data and database engines: query execution, storage formats, and performance.

We're an AI-native team. Artificial Intelligence (AI) assisted development and agentic tooling are part of the daily craft here — not just to produce code but to build tools and observe cloud-based systems at scale.

This role is also at the intersection between Windows and data, potentially helping hundreds of millions of Windows users have a better experience.

At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress—people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.



Responsibilities

Day to Day Responsibilities

  • Build at a scale that changes the problem. Deploy, extend and operate multi-petabyte MPP — StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino/Presto, Spark, Druid, Kusto.
  • Go deep into database internals. Work on query execution, vectorized processing, cost-based optimization, and columnar storage formats such as Parquet and Arrow, and understand these engines from the inside out.
  • Work across the stack and across languages. Move between services in Python, Java, and Go and performance-critical native code in C++ — deep expertise in any single language isn't expected, just a readiness to follow the problem wherever it leads.
  • Engineer the lakehouse on cloud infrastructure working with open table formats (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi, Paimon) and build on cloud services and container orchestration with Kubernetes.
  • Practice AI-native engineering. Use AI-assisted development and agentic tooling as part of the daily workflow, build AI directly in decision-making systems and operations, and help define how the team uses it on real production systems.
  • Own components and partner for impact. Shape architecture, make build-vs-adopt decisions, and own components end to end while partnering with data scientists and product managers on data that shapes decisions for hundreds of millions of Windows users.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
    • OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of proven coding and debugging skills in object-oriented languages. C#, C++, Java, or equivalent.
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes, StarRocks, Clickhouse, Kafka, Flink, Trino, real-time/NRT systems, open-source data platforms.
  • Scripting language experience Python and SQL.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and services, such as Azure, etc.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with teammates and work successfully in a group environment.
  • Data science, experimentation, or model-building adjacent experience.
  • Experience in designing, developing, and shipping code with secure continuous integration and continuous delivery practices (CI/CD).
  • Experience with data streaming, data modeling, data warehousing, and ETL (extract/transform/load).

title: Credit Analyst
description:
Cześć! 👋

Nasz klient to globalny, pozabankowy pożyczkodawca dla małych i średnich firm, obecny już na kilku kontynentach, który właśnie otwiera biuro w Krakowie 🚀 Zamiast sztywnych modeli scoringowych — decyzje kredytowe oparte na realnej ocenie ryzyka i zdrowym rozsądku biznesowym.

Szukamy Analityka/Analityczki Kredytowej, który(a) oceni wniosek nie tylko przez pryzmat automatycznego modelu, ale też kontekstu biznesowego klienta — i podejmie za to odpowiedzialność.

Najprawdopodobniej zaprosimy Cię na rozmowę, jeśli:

✔️ Masz doświadczenie na stanowisku Analityka Kredytowego, Underwritera lub podobnym,
✔️ Masz udokumentowane doświadczenie w underwritingu, najlepiej w finansowaniu dla firm (business lending),
✔️ Potrafisz ocenić ryzyko bez nadmiernego opierania się na automatycznych modelach scoringowych,
✔️ Masz doświadczenie w podejmowaniu decyzji o finansowaniu — zarówno zabezpieczonym, jak i niezabezpieczonym,
✔️ Sprawnie czytasz sprawozdania finansowe; znajomość underwritingu zabezpieczonego nieruchomością to dodatkowy atut,
✔️ Masz doświadczenie w alternatywnym finansowaniu lub pozabankowych usługach finansowych — to zdecydowany plus.
✔️ Potrafisz dogadać się po angielsku - najlepiej jak native, ale wiemy jak jest i mocne B2 też będzie OK,

Odnajdziesz się w tej roli, jeśli:

🔥 Lubisz rozkładać skomplikowane sprawy finansowe na czynniki pierwsze i wyciągać z nich trafne wnioski,
🔥 Potrafisz strukturyzować rozwiązania finansowe wykraczające poza standardowe modele,
🔥 Chcesz mieć realny wpływ na to, jak wygląda proces kredytowy od pierwszych dni w nowym kraju.

Czym będziesz się zajmować? 📌

  • Oceną wniosków kredytowych — analiza wniosków MŚP i podejmowanie samodzielnych decyzji kredytowych przy zachowaniu zbalansowanego podejścia do ryzyka.
  • Analizą finansową — dogłębna analiza sprawozdań finansowych, raportów kredytowych i wskaźników ryzyka w celu określenia zdolności kredytowej.
  • Strukturyzowaniem finansowania — proponowanie rozwiązań dla pożyczek zabezpieczonych i niezabezpieczonych, także wtedy, gdy wykraczają poza standardowe modele.
  • Monitoringiem portfela — przegląd udzielonego finansowania, wnioski dot. trendów portfelowych i ekspozycji na ryzyko.
  • Usprawnianiem procesów — wsparcie w rozwoju dobrych praktyk i usprawnień w zespole kredytowym.
  • Śledzeniem rynku — bieżąca wiedza o trendach gospodarczych i ich wpływie na ocenę ryzyka kredytowego.
  • Co oferujemy? 💰

💰 Wynagrodzenie 8 500 – 15 500 PLN brutto/mies., zależnie od doświadczenia
🎯 Roczną premię za wyniki w wysokości 10–20%
🌍 Udział w budowie zespołu kredytowego od podstaw w Krakowie
🤝 Bezpośrednią współpracę z globalnym zespołem Credit

Brzmi jak coś dla Ciebie? Kliknij "Aplikuj" i pogadajmy 🚀

title: Azure Cloud Customer Experience Engineer 2
description:
Overview

Every minute of every day, customers stake their entire business and reputation on Microsoft Cloud. The Azure Engineering Operations (EngOps) team believes that when we meet our high standards for quality and reliability, our customers win. If we falter, our customers fail their end-customers. Our vision is to turn Microsoft Cloud customers into fans.


We are customer obsessed problem-solvers. We orchestrate deep engagements in areas like incident management, support and enablement. We analyze and amplify those customer voices, both within our own team, and across the Cloud + AI team, bringing the customer connection to the Quality vision for Azure. We innovate ways to scale what we learn across our customer base. Diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, how we work, and what we enable our customers to achieve. We know that empowering our customers starts with empowering our team to show up authentically, work in ways that are best for them, and achieve their career goals.


Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing teams within Microsoft Azure Engineering? Are you constantly customer-obsessed, and focused on enhancing customer experience? Are you passionate about cloud computing and love the challenge of solving the most complex technical problems?


Come join us and surround yourself with people who are passionate about cloud computing and believe that extraordinary support is critical to customer success.

As an Azure Cloud Customer Experience Engineer 2, you are the primary support and engineering contact accountable for the customer’s Azure support experience driving resolution of complex critical problems and supporting key customer projects on Azure. You will also act as the voice of the customer within Azure to escalate problems and to drive prioritization of platform/support improvement needs for customers.


In this role, you will work together with field teams (Customer Success Account Managers, Cloud Solution Architects, Support Escalation Engineers) and Azure engineering teams with our mission to turn Azure customers into fans with a world-class engineering-led support experience.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Technical Oriented
Utilizes engineering tools, customer telemetry and direct input. Flags the patterns of defects/signals in the products or issues across customers. Inform customers and partners about the complex thematic active issues, progress made on them and discuss next steps.
Synthesize feedback from customers and partners to learn about the product usage and identify and resolve feature and knowledge gaps and key performance indicators (KPIs) in the current product. Leads team in sharing insights and best practices with customers and partners on these service improvements.
Recommend changes to content improvement or troubleshooting guides and develops metrics to evaluate the changes.

Utilizes cross systems to conduct health checks to ensure the customer environment (e.g., product, service, feature) is optimized and configured for deployment. Relationship/Experience Management
Acts as a voice of customers and leverages customers' feedback to provide input on business plans developed by the relevant product and business groups. Identifies customer usage patterns and driving resolutions on reoccurring customer issues with engineering and product and business groups. Leads their team in engaging with feature and product groups on redesign/customer requested changes for Microsoft products. Close the loop of feedback with the customers on product features.
Partners with other teams (e.g., program managers, software engineers, product, customer service support [CSS] teams) prioritize and drive resolutions of complex, high-impact customer issues and integration of customer features into the products. Leads discussions with stakeholders on customer progression and provide expertise on resolutions plans for common types of customer issues. Proactively communicates the translation of signals into actionable insights/trends to product teams to improve service reliability. Leads coordination with stakeholders (e.g., engineering/product teams) to develop mechanisms that improve customer health engagement and reduce the turnover time.

Additional Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Data Analytics/Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), or related field AND 2+ years experience in technology industry, cloud, technical support, and/or customer experience engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • 4 years of demonstrated IT experience supporting and troubleshooting enterprise level, mission-critical applications resolving complex issues/situations and driving technical resolution across cross-functional organizations.

    Core IaaS: Compute, Storage, Networking, High Availability, Azure Kubernetes Service
  • Data Platform and Bigdata: SQL Server, Azure SQL DB, HDInsight/Hadoop, Machine Learning, Azure Stream Analytics, Azure Data Factory / Data Bricks, Cosmos DB
    Azure PaaS Services: Redis Cache, Service Bus, Event Hub, Cloud Service, IoT suite, Mobile Apps, etc.

title: Senior Data and Applied Scientist
description:
Overview

With the rapid acceleration of AI and the need to deliver trustworthy, high-performing models, Microsoft's Commercial Business & AI (CEAI) Data Science and Applied AI team is driving innovation at scale! Our mission is to advance AI capabilities through rigorous evaluations, fine-tuning, and large-scale experimentation to create intelligent, personalized experiences for customers worldwide. The CEAI Data Science and Applied AI team is seeking passionate AI practitioners and data scientists to join agile, cross-functional teams working on cutting-edge model evaluation frameworks, optimization pipelines, and experimentation platforms that power Microsoft's AI ecosystem.

We are looking for a Senior Data and Applied Scientist to join our team! As a member of the Commercial Business & AI (CEAI) Data Science and Applied AI organization at Microsoft, you will help us accelerate the company's own AI transformation. You will have the opportunity to partner directly with the engineering and product management groups responsible for managing the Dynamics 365 applications that power Microsoft's sales, marketing, and support platforms. You will apply advanced analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning and GenAI tools to uncover insights, drive action and deliver innovative solutions for complex business challenges.

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Collaborate across a diverse team of data scientists, engineers, and product managers.
  • Deepen your expertise in the evolving AI and ML landscape.
  • Drive impact for thousands of Microsoft sales, marketing and support platform users.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Work with key stakeholders to understand the underlying business needs and formulate the needs into discrete, manageable problems with well-defined measurable objectives and outcomes.
  • Transform formulated problems into implementation plans by defining success metrics, applying/creating the appropriate methods, algorithms, and tools, as well as delivering statistically valid and reliable results.
  • Write robust, reusable, and extensible code to support analysis and modeling.
  • Develop new ML or GenAI based models using advanced statistical and ML techniques.
  • Lead the evaluation of various GenAI based solutions, diagnosing issues and identifying root causes to support potential fine-tuning or reinforcement learning based fixes.
  • Use AI-powered tools in your daily work to accelerate coding, analysis, and other tasks.


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

Doctorate in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or related field AND 1+ year(s) data-science experience (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results) OR Master's Degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years data-science experience (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results) OR Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years data-science experience (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results) OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in data science, product/journey analytics, causal inference, and user behavioral modeling.
  • Experience driving product improvements through data and insights.
  • Experience in Python, R, SQL, KQL, PySpark, and modern analytics frameworks.
  • Experience designing experiments, defining standardized metrics, performing causal analyses, and delivering behavior-driven insights.
  • Experience with learning platforms and/or learner competency and skill modeling (e.g., proficiency, mastery, and skill signals).
  • Experience levering AI to deliver accelerate time to insight and depth of insights
  • Experience with large-scale enterprise data platforms (e.g., Fabric, Synapse, ADX, Delta Lake, ADF, Databricks, Snowflake).
  • Exposure to ML development platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry + Azure OpenAI.

title: Medewerker Inkoop
description:
Heb jij een scherp oog voor details, affiniteit met inkoopprocessen én een warm hart voor de watersector? Krijg jij energie van het structureren van administraties en floreer je in een gezellig team? Dan voel jij je bij het Waterschapshuis als een vis in het water.

Duik jij in deze uitdaging?

Als medewerker inkoop ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, bewaken en verbeteren van de administratieve en operationele processen binnen inkoop- en contractmanagement. Je zorgt voor een actuele, betrouwbare en rechtmatige inkoop- en contractadministratie en ondersteunt het team met procesondersteuning en managementinformatie.

Jij vormt de verbindende schakel tussen inkoop, contractmanagement, financiële administratie en interne opdrachtgevers en draagt bij aan een efficiënte, uniforme en rechtmatige uitvoering van de operationele inkoopprocessen.

Jouw rol

Als medewerker inkoop zorg je ervoor dat de administratieve basis van het inkoop- en contractproces op orde is. Je beheert de inkoop- en contractadministratie, verwerkt gegevens en dossiers en bewaakt termijnen en vervolgacties. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met inkopers, inkoopadviseurs, contractmanagers en andere interne en externe stakeholders. Ook signaleer je verbeterpunten en draag je bij aan een rechtmatig, transparant en efficiënt inkoopproces.

Concreet omvat je afwisselende takenpakket:

  • Je beheert en actualiseert de inkoop- en contractadministratie en zorgt dat gegevens volledig, juist en betrouwbaar zijn.
  • Je verwerkt inkooptrajecten, beheert dossiers en bewaakt contracttermijnen en administratieve vervolgacties.
  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en uniformiteit van administratieve processen en signaleert afwijkingen.
  • Je stelt managementinformatie en rapportages op en ondersteunt bij interne controles en audits.
  • Je bent een aanspreekpunt voor administratieve vragen rondom inkoop en contracten.
  • Je signaleert mogelijkheden om processen en systemen te verbeteren en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van de inkoopadministratie.

Hier stroom je in

Samen met een collega vorm je het Team Operationele Inkoop, als onderdeel van het team ICLM (Inkoop, Contract- en Leveranciersmanagement). Vanuit deze rol werk je nauw samen met inkoopadviseurs, contractmanagers en leveranciersmanagement, maar ook met de financiële administratie en interne opdrachtgevers.

Binnen Team Operationele Inkoop ligt de nadruk op het ondersteunen, beheren en verder professionaliseren van de operationele inkoopprocessen en de inkoop- en contractadministratie.

Je bestaat al voor meer dan 50% uit water! Daarnaast zoeken we in jou:

Je bent de regisseur van onze dagelijkse processen, behoudt overzicht en signaleert knelpunten. Je bent dienstverlenend ingesteld en denkt in oplossingen. Als je werk ziet liggen pak jij dit zelfstandig op. Naast een administratieve held ben je een gezellige, positieve teamplayer die de inkoopadministratie naar een hoger niveau tilt.

Verder vragen wij:

  • Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau.
  • Relevante werkervaring binnen administratieve en operationele processen, bij voorkeur binnen de publieke sector.
  • Affiniteit met inkoop- en contractmanagement.
  • Goede digitale vaardigheden en beheersing van Microsoft Office, waaronder Excel.
  • Je bent 32 tot 36 uur beschikbaar per week.

Ons verfrissende aanbod

  • Je salaris is afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring en ligt tussen € 3.539, - en € 4.626, - bruto per maand (schaal) 8 o.b.v. 36 uur.
  • Je ontvangt boven op je salaris een Individueel Keuze Budget van 21%. Dit kan je laten uitbetalen in extra vrije dagen, een opleiding of salaris.
  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor de duur van een jaar met de mogelijkheid tot verlenging naar een vast dienstverband.
  • Je werkt minimaal twee dagen op kantoor, afhankelijk van je werkzaamheden.
  • Een ruim opleidingsbudget van € 6.000, - (per 5 jaar) voor jou persoonlijk.
  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 netto per kilometer of een vergoeding op basis van 2e-klas woon-werk verkeer.
  • 151,2 verlof uur per jaar o.b.v. 36 uur en de mogelijkheid om flexibele verlof te sparen.
  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 3,50- netto per thuiswerkdag.
  • Een vergoeding van € 1.000, - om je thuiswerkplek in te richten.
  • Een pensioenverzekering via het ABP pensioenfonds.

Maak jij werk van water?

Wil jij een sleutelrol spelen in de digitale ontwikkeling van de waterschappen? Solliciteer dan vóór 27 september a.s. via onderstaande button en stuur je cv en motivatie mee.

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen? Neem contact op met Erwin Drees, Hoofd Inkoop, IT & Facilitair, via 06- 52 36 10 01. Vragen over het proces? Neem contact op met Carlijn Mutgeert, capaciteitsmanager, via 06 86 89 60 83.

Hoewel we enthousiasme waarderen, verzoeken wij vriendelijk om geen commerciële benaderingen naar aanleiding van deze advertentie. Bedankt voor uw begrip en medewerking.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data wordt pas waardevol als het betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar op de juiste plek staat. Als Data Engineer bij Macaw bouw je precies dat: de fundering onder de rapportages, modellen en AI-toepassingen van onze klanten. Je ontsluit bronsystemen, bouwt robuuste laadprocessen en modelleert data zo dat anderen er direct mee verder kunnen. Wij werken met Microsoft-technologie, dus je gaat aan de slag met Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks en Azure Data Factory. Je wordt onderdeel van het team Data Solutions & Insights (DSI), tussen data engineers, Fabric- en Power BI-consultants en data-architecten die elkaar scherp houden. Jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden hangen af van twee zaken: jouw klantprojecten en jouw interesse in interne initiatieven. De klantprojecten variëren enorm, van kleinere organisaties waar je zelfstandig het hele data-platform bouwt, tot grote ondernemingen waar je deel uitmaakt van een projectteam en samenwerkt met projectmanagers, solution architects en andere engineers. Onze klanten bevinden zich met name in Nederland en Duitsland.

Onze interne projecten draaien om jouw interesse: ben je gepassioneerd door Microsoft Fabric, AI en Copilot, Azure Databricks, of wil je je verdiepen in data governance en datakwaliteit? Er zijn veel interne initiatieven waaraan je kunt deelnemen en waarbij je de kans krijgt om ook op andere gebieden je kennis verder te ontwikkelen. Denk aan ons Smart Data Platform - een data-platform-accelerator die we intern ontwikkelen en onderhouden, met referentie-architecturen, standaardoplossingen en herbruikbare laadpatronen - of Project ARA, onze accelerator in Microsoft Fabric om klantprojecten snel op gang te brengen.

Wat ga je doen?
  • Ontsluiten van bronsystemen (Azure SQL, Dataverse, SAP, API's, files) en het bouwen van betrouwbare, herstartbare laadprocessen.
  • Bouwen van data pipelines en notebooks in Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory en/of AzureDatabricks.
  • Inrichten van Lakehouses en Warehouses in Fabric volgens een medallion-architectuur (bronze, silver, gold).
  • Modelleren van data tot overzichtelijke, goed presterende sterschema's waar onze Power BI-consultants direct mee verder kunnen. Voor de implementatie gebruik je SQL, Python, PySpark of Spark SQL.
  • Beheren van de klantomgeving in AzureDevOps of Git: deployment scripts, CI/CD-pipelines en release-afspraken horen bij jouw werk.
  • Monitoren, optimaliseren en troubleshooten van bestaande pipelines - op doorlooptijd, betrouwbaarheid én kosten (Fabriccapacity, Databricks clusters).
  • Vastleggen van je oplossing: documentatie, namingconventions en een overdracht waar de klant en je collega's echt mee vooruit kunnen.
  • Begeleiden van junior collega's via code reviews en pair programming.
Wat is jouw profiel?
  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt professioneel communiceren in het Engels. Een goede beheersing van de Duitse taal is een grote plus.
  • Je hebt 3 tot 6 jaar werkervaring als data engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen het data-domein.
  • Je bent sterk in SQL en werkt comfortabel met Python of PySpark voor datatransformaties.
  • Je hebt hands-on ervaring met minimaal één van: Microsoft Fabric, AzureDatabricks, Azure Data Factory of AzureSynapse Analytics - en je wilt je verbreden naar de andere.
  • Je kent de principes van datamodellering (dimensioneel /Kimball, sterschema, 3NF) en weet wanneer je ervan afwijkt.
  • Je hebt ervaring met grote datasets en weet hoe je verwerking efficiënt en kostenbewust inricht.
  • Je werkt met Git en AzureDevOps en bent bekend met CI/CD voor data-platformen.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met Agile/Scrum-werkwijzen.
  • Je hebt bij voorkeur de DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate) certificering, of je bent bereid die in je eerste jaar te halen. DP-600, DP-203 of een Databricks Data Engineer-certificering zijn een plus.
  • Ervaring met Microsoft Purview, datakwaliteitsframeworks of Real-Time Intelligence (Eventhouse, KQL, Event Streams) is een pré.
  • Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste Microsoft-ontwikkelingen zoals Copilot in Fabric en agentic AI, en bent enthousiast om hiermee te experimenteren.

Wat kan je van Macaw verwachten?
Never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down - We hebben een fijn team met veel ervaren collega's die je zullen helpen als iets te ver buiten je comfortzone ligt.
  • Een mooi salaris en een mobiliteitsvergoeding voor een leaseauto en/of NS Businesscard.
  • 29 vakantiedagen (tot 33 wanneer we onze targets halen).
  • Toegang tot een ruim opleidingsbudget en veel ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
  • Flexibele werktijden (32-40). De meesten van ons zijn 1-3 dagen op kantoor, een paar dagen thuis of bij de klant.
  • Een prachtig, goed verbonden kantoor met leuke extras zoals een pooltafel, tafeltennis en een Xbox (ja, we zijn Microsoft-fans).

Bij Macaw is iedereen welkom.

Wij geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedere sollicitant en in een wervingsproces dat inclusief, respectvol en vrij van vooroordelen is. Jouw talent, mentaliteit en vaardigheden staan voorop, ongeacht je achtergrond, identiteit of overtuigingen. Heb je tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure ondersteuning nodig?

Neem dan gerust contact met ons op via recruitment@macaw.nl

Liever bellen of appen?
Neem dan contact op met onze recruiter Marnix via 0651011595.

title: Superintendent - Fauquier County
description:
D.R. Horton, Inc., the largest homebuilder in the U.S., was founded in 1978 and is a publicly traded company on the New York Stock Exchange. It is engaged in the construction and sale of high quality homes designed principally for the entry-level and first time move-up markets. The Company also provides mortgage financing and title services for homebuyers through its mortgage and title subsidiaries. Please visit our website at www.drhorton.com for more information.


D.R. Horton, Inc. is currently looking for an Superintendent. Manage the construction of multiple homes from permit to closing by scheduling and supervising job site subcontractors, homeowner walk-throughs, and inspections while maintaining company construction and safety standards.

Successful Superintendents hitting their targets earn anywhere from $85,000 to $100,000+ per year which can include a bonus and/or any commissions or other cash incentives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Manage the construction schedule and ensure the highest quality product is delivered on time and within budget

  • Complete each home site on schedule from planning through occupancy, ensuring all contract obligations are satisfied
  • Inspect and determine subcontractor’s workmanship and product quality is completed on time and within defined scope of work. Halt any work that is not satisfactory or noncompliant with plans, specifications, or applicable code

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview

Our team is at the forefront of transforming digital advertising through intelligent automation and large-scale optimization. We design and build the bidding platform that powers real-time ad auctions across Microsoft’s marketplaces - leveraging cutting-edge AI, machine learning, and large-scale distributed systems to bid on behalf of millions of advertisers.

Our systems process billions of auction events daily, optimizing bids in milliseconds to maximize performance and return on ad spend. Engineers and scientists work hand-in-hand, blending algorithmic innovation, reinforcement learning, and large-scale data pipelines to create the intelligence that drives Microsoft Advertising’s success.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of AI systems, real-time decision-making, and scalable cloud infrastructure. You’ll help shape the next generation of our agentic bidding platform - one that learns, adapts, and optimizes autonomously. Your work will directly influence advertiser ROI and drive billions of dollars in revenue across Bing, MSN, and the Microsoft ecosystem.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.



Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to define requirements for agentic AI-driven bidding capabilities that observe, reason, and adapt autonomously.
  • Architect and implement the next-generation agentic bidding platform, enabling AI agents to monitor marketplace signals, interpret advertiser and user behavior, and continuously optimize bidding strategies.
  • Build large-scale data validation and quality frameworks to ensure correctness, consistency, and reliability across all auction-critical signals feeding the AI agents.
  • Act as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI): drive operational excellence, incident management, on-call readiness, and high-availability practices for mission-critical bidding services.
  • Develop experimentation and simulation frameworks to validate agent behavior and optimize policies before deployment in live auctions.
  • Proactively adopt new patterns, technologies, and engineering practices to improve availability, efficiency, performance, and scalability across the bidding stack.
  • Set technical direction, mentor engineers, and foster a culture of high-quality execution, innovation, and accountability.
  • Explore and invest in emerging AI techniques - multi-agent systems, adaptive optimization - to enhance the autonomy, intelligence, and impact of the bidding platform.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with large-scale streaming platforms such as Apache Spark or Flink.
  • 4+ years of experience as a technical lead, including mentoring and guiding engineers.
  • 5+ years of experience developing and deploying large-scale distributed systems in production environments.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning operations (MLOps), including pipeline automation, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Domain knowledge and experience building large scale distributed bidding or auction platforms.
  • Experience building real world applications using AI techniques.

title: Senior Director Business Analytics
description:
Overview

Commercial Engineering & AI (CEAI) partners closely with stakeholders across MCB to radically transform Microsoft’s commercial business into a frontier organization. We unite AI-native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to fundamentally rethink how we deliver and support the business—moving beyond traditional reporting toward intelligent, connected experiences that anticipate needs, accelerate decisions, and drive impact at scale.

The Business Intelligence Center of Excellence (BI COE) within CEAI is seeking a bold, visionary leader to spearhead a radical transformation in how our Commercial Business is supported with data and insights. The leader will challenge and rethink in an AI-native way both how we engineer & deliver those insights and data, AND how our sellers and sales leaders consume those insights. Leveraging the latest Microsoft AI stack —including Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Cowork, and more—you will simplify and modernize how insights are produced, delivered, and consumed, while keeping data integrity, quality, and consistency central to our mission: the right insight, at the right moment, through one trusted source of truth for Commercial Business decision-making.

What success looks like in this role

Transform insight delivery. Shift from static reporting to agile, agentic experiences that surface insights that matter and enable confident business decisions.

Co-create with the business. Partner across MCAPS to align insights delivery to business priorities and shape a transformative roadmap.

Connect strategy, data, and action. Translate sales priorities and go-to-market motions into forward-looking insights that guide action and improve performance.

Lead AI-first. Apply AI-native approaches to simplify experiences, accelerate BI delivery, and unlock value.

Shape the product as Customer Zero. Build a strategic feedback loop with the Fabric product group to advance internal transformation and customer outcomes.

Lead and inspire through change. Build an accountable, AI-ready team grounded in clear purpose, experimentation, and strong performance.



Responsibilities
  • Lead the BI COE team in radically transforming how MCB stakeholders access, understand, and act on business performance—delivering trusted, AI-powered insights through platforms such as MSXi, Copilot, Cowork, and Scout.
  • Set the strategic vision and transformation roadmap for the MSX Insights (MSXi) Power BI platform, evolving it from a reporting destination into an intelligent decision-support experience for a commercial business generating more than $200B in revenue.
  • Redesign the end-to-end BI delivery model using AI, automation, and modern engineering practices to improve speed, quality, scalability, and cost efficiency, including vendor spend optimization.
  • Own governance and portfolio management across the BI COE organization, making bold prioritization choices, accelerating value realization, and ensuring alignment with MCB business priorities and Microsoft data governance and compliance standards.
  • Partner across data engineering teams to reimagine the MCAPS data architecture and governance model, enabling trusted, consistent, and reusable insights across dashboards, copilots, agents, and other emerging surfaces.
  • Sponsor the Customer Zero partnership and product feedback loop with the Fabric product group, using our transformation journey to accelerate product innovation and showcase Microsoft’s AI-driven BI leadership to customers and the industry.

    • Equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Datacenter Security Operations Manager
description:
Overview

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Datacenter Security Operations Manager.

As a Datacenter Security Operations Manager in CO+I Physical Security, you will be part of a global team dedicated to delivering the most trustworthy security program to protect the personnel, infrastructure, data, and confidential information foundational to the Microsoft Cloud. You will be accountable for physical security operations at datacenters and other related facilities within your applicable region and will collaborate with the vendor security guarding staff to meet collective security requirements and provide security capabilities, anticipate site specific insecurity and security disruption (e.g., life safety, business operations, reputation) and lead discussions on developing strategies for mitigating risks and responding to residual risks. Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Datacenter Security Operations Manager you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

With minimal assistance, implements security protocols to support the physical protection of company personnel and assets. With minimal assistance, delivers and maintains security programs in areas of responsibility.

  • Deep understanding of generative AI, large language models (LLMs) and modern AI platform architectures, including agentic and retrieval-augmented approaches.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Overview

Join Microsoft’s Data Center Delivery team and play a critical role in building the infrastructure that powers the world's leading cloud services. In this role, you will lead and support data center construction and integration activities across campus and local projects, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to Microsoft’s high quality standards. This aligns closely with Data Center Delivery’s mission of safely delivering high-quality, sustainable data center facilities while meeting design, schedule, and budget objectives.

You will work closely with engineering teams, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders to oversee project execution, review technical designs and documentation, evaluate risks, and drive data-based decision making throughout the project lifecycle. The role requires strong collaboration, project management, and technical expertise to coordinate resources, monitor contractor performance, manage project metrics, and ensure compliance with safety, regulatory, and operational requirements.

As a trusted project partner and onsite safety advocate, you will help mitigate risks, promote a culture of safety, and contribute to the successful delivery of mission-critical data center infrastructure that supports Microsoft's global cloud and AI platform. This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in a fast-paced construction environment and are passionate about delivering large-scale, complex infrastructure projects through operational excellence and stakeholder collaboration.

At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress—people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.



Responsibilities

Budget and Controls

Monitors the approved project budget and provides oversight for project controls (e.g., Project Expenditure Request (PERs), Professional Services Request (PSRs), Change Orders, Pay Applications, etc.).

Change Management

Partners with the Internal Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I), and other Microsoft key stakeholders (e.g., Commercial Software Engineering [CSE] and Real Estate & Facilities [RE&F], etc.) and shares updated process flow information with the project team to ensure new processes are being followed that increase cost savings and improve overall cycle-time and efficiencies.

Coordination

Attends and advises during scheduled owner/architect/contractor and other project meetings, advocating for safe and secure security-first mindset during project planning. Coordinates meetings and activities of vendors and cost managers, and attends scheduled owner/architect/contractor and other project meetings.

Drives Results

Facilitates the delivery of local projects (e.g., new construction, infrastructure improvements) by making timely data-based decisions in partnership with local project teams and stakeholders. Champions team and project goals, adhering to business processes, engaging vendor relationships when/where applicable, and fostering cross-group collaboration efforts aligned to the project strategy, milestone delivery, and core values and priorities (Safety, Security, Quality, Schedule, Cost).

Financial Acumen

Applies best practices to identify and incorporate cost-effective solutions to meet project delivery at each site location. Applies influence, strategies, and negotiation skills to identify options and recommend solutions.

Goal Alignment

Collaborates with internal teams (e.g., Engineering, Operations, Center for International Social Science Research [CISSR], Commercial Software Engineering [CSE], Legal, Project Controls, etc.) to maintain the corporate vision and goals for the project.

Managing Resources

Confirms the scoped resources (e.g., people, materials, equipment) are available for the job. Partners with senior construction staff to procure additional materials as needed.

Project Management

Drives data center construction/integration activities on local/campus projects (e.g., new or retrofit data center facilities) and provides key input on all data center fit-out related activities, leveraging experiences and technical knowledge to ensure sound and data-driven decisions, as well as prioritization of security in documentation, design, and/or execution.

Project Tracking

Provides specific project data supporting cost and key performance indicator (KPI) metrics, invoices, processes, and policies in order to communicate status to client partners. Reports on project progress regarding scope, schedule, standards, and budget.

Risk Mitigation

Reviews and assists with developing risk mitigation activities and communicating metrics, dashboards and/or scorecards to track and drive progress. Analyzes safety and security metrics and communicates results to leadership to drive action and accountability.

Safety and Regulation

Represents Microsoft as a safety leader and advocate onsite ensuring adherence to safety standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., Occupational Safety and Health Administration [OSHA], or equivalent) to ensure compliance and aggressive management of risk. Conducts routine safety program, security, project, and contractor audits, and performs and participates in incident investigations.

Technical Acumen

Reviews engineering documentation/designs, site, and building plans by examining and analyzing technical information. Identifies potential risks/gaps and recommendations to teammates and/or other internal partners, ensuring solutions adhere to security core priorities and guidelines.

Vendor Management

Assists with the monitoring of vendor and/or contractor performance, ensuring compliance with security policies, non-disclosure agreements, contracts, and prior audit results. Reviews vendor performance relative to cash flow and budget summaries (with the cost management team) and clarifies those reports in presentations to the delivery and executive teams.

Vendor Selection

Assists with preparing Request for Proposal (RFPs), Project Expenditure Requests (PERs), and other project approval tools and templates.

Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.

7+ years experience working on data center projects.

title: Metro Construction Quality Leader
description:
Overview

Microsoft Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the team behind the cloud. CO+I is responsible for delivering over 200 Microsoft web portals, Live and Online Services around the world including infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide. We are looking for a passionate individual to help build the network that powers the world’s largest online services.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

A Microsoft Construction Quality Leader is responsible for governing the quality management system, auditing contractor quality performance, managing NCRs and quality metrics, identifying risks before they impact commissioning or operations, and ensuring data centers are delivered ready to perform—not just ready to complete.



Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities of a Microsoft Construction Quality Leader

1. Drive Construction Quality from Day One

  • Ensure facilities are built in accordance with design requirements, specifications, and Microsoft quality standards.
  • Promote a "Right First Time" culture to reduce rework, delays, and operational risks.

2. Audit Contractor Quality Programs

  • Verify General Contractors are executing their Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Conduct routine quality audits, inspections, and field observations.
  • Validate contractor compliance with Division 01 requirements, quality plans, inspection processes, and documentation requirements.

3. Manage NCRs and Quality Issues

  • Initiate and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).
  • Ensure corrective actions are developed, implemented, and verified.
  • Escalate unresolved quality issues to project leadership.
  • Trend recurring quality problems and drive systemic corrective actions.

4. Quality Management System Ownership

  • Establish and maintain project quality plans.
  • Review and align contractor quality plans before mobilization.
  • Standardize quality processes across projects and campuses.

5. Inspection & Test Planning Governance

  • Govern Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Define hold points, quality gates, and documentation requirements.
  • Ensure Installer Verification Checklists (IVCs) and readiness requirements are met before commissioning milestones.

6. Digital Quality Platform Management

  • Administer quality tracking systems (Nexus/ACMS).
  • Monitor issue closure timelines and SLA performance.
  • Produce dashboards and quality metrics for leadership visibility.

7. Field Quality Assurance

  • Perform field inspections and observations.
  • Monitor workmanship trends and installation quality.
  • Verify contractors are following approved procedures and specifications.
  • Provide early identification of risks that could impact commissioning, IST, or turnover.

8. Readiness and Turnover Support

  • Support energization and commissioning readiness reviews.
  • Ensure documentation, inspections, punch lists, and quality issues are appropriately closed prior to turnover.
  • Partner with Commissioning Managers and Operations to improve startup outcomes.

9. Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze trends across campuses and metros.
  • Capture lessons learned.
  • Recommend process improvements that improve quality performance and reduce recurrence of defects.

10. Contractor Accountability

  • Hold GCs accountable for their QA/QC responsibilities.
  • Monitor closure performance and response times.
  • Reinforce that workmanship quality remains the responsibility of the contractor. Microsoft Quality provides oversight and assurance.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.

  • Experience leading construction QA/QC, quality management, inspection governance, defect management, or non-conformance management on large-scale construction, industrial, mission-critical, or data centre projects.
  • Experience working with quality plans, ITPs/ITRs, inspection and test records, construction documentation, and project turnover requirements.
  • Experience working on data center or construction experience

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.

  • 7+ years experience working on data center projects.

  • Proficient in data analytics, reporting, and construction management tools such as Power BI, Procore, Cx Software, Bluebeam, and BIM with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong knowledge of construction specifications, quality standards, and installation compliance requirements.
  • Experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, DMAIC, Six Sigma, and change management.
  • Experience applying structured problem-solving tools such as RCA, FMEA, 8D, and CAPA.
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, quality auditing, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) principles.
  • Experience developing, implementing, and managing structured quality management systems.
  • Professional quality certifications preferred, including USACE CQM, OSHA 30, ASQ CQE, CQA, CMQ/OE, Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent.
  • Experience in data center, mission-critical, industrial, semiconductor, pharmaceutical, power, or oil & gas construction environments preferred.

description:
To be considered for this position you must complete the state application and attach all required documents through the Montana State Careers site at www.statecareers.mt.gov.

If the required documents are not submitted, your application will not be reviewed. When submitting the required documents, you must check the “relevant document” box to ensure your attachments are uploading correctly to the specific application for this position. Documents not requested will not be considered in the recruitment process.

The Montana Department of Public Health and Human Services (DPHHS) has a career opportunity within the Child and Family Services Division.

As a Child Protection Specialist, you will play a critical role in enhancing the well-being of Montana families. You will engage directly with families facing a wide range of challenges, investigating child abuse, providing support, advocacy, and connection to vital resources. This role is both rewarding and demanding. You will navigate complex, sometimes hostile, situations that require empathy, resiliency, and a deep understanding of social systems. While the path is not always easy, the difference you make is invaluable in Keeping Children Safe and Families Strong.

Essential Functions\: This is intended to describe the position but does not cover every function or task that may be required.

  • Conducts timely assessments of reports of child maltreatment, in accordance with requirements of state and federal statutes and agency policy, using standardized safety assessment tools and decision-making guides.

  • Carries a caseload and keeps all case file documentation current.

  • Works collaboratively with law enforcement, other welfare professionals, and agencies.

  • Prepares for and testifies in court, preliminary hearings, multi-disciplinary team meetings, family partnership meetings, and court hearings.

  • Places child(ren) in out-of-home care, when necessary, and ensures that the placement is safe and complies with statutory and policy preferences and is in the best interests of the child(ren). Identifies available resources and connects families and children to these resources.

  • Assures child(ren) is evaluated and assessed to determine medical and psychological needs throughout the case.

  • Prepares assessments, designs case plans, evaluates the progress of participants, and makes and monitors appropriate placements.

  • This role requires frequent travel and conducting in home visits and interviews, and may include out-of-state travel, which will require the willingness to have appropriate travel documents.

  • While you have a standard schedule, there will be times when critical business needs will require work during evenings, weekends, or holidays. Please note that as part of your job responsibilities, you will be assigned a rotating on-call schedule.

Why Join DPHHS

Our mission at DPHHS is serving Montanans in their communities to improve health, safety, well-being, and empower independence. By joining our department, you will have the opportunity to perform meaningful work in public service to our state and its residents.

The State of Montana's comprehensive benefits package includes healthcare coverage, retirement plans, paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays, work/life balance, and eligibility to participate in the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program. In addition, DPHHS is the largest state agency with a wide range of advancement opportunities whether you are joining the workforce or have several years of experience.

title: Myyjä (33h/vko) K-Market Veto, Vimpeli
description:
Haemme asiakaspalvelusta nauttivaa myyjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen K-Market Vetoon!

Meillä jokainen työntekijä on tärkeä osa tiimiä, ja yhdessä huolehdimme siitä, että asiakkaamme saavat sujuvan ja miellyttävän ostokokemuksen joka kerta. Työ vaatii reipasta otetta, oma-aloitteisuutta, hyvää tilannetajua ja aitoa kiinnostusta siihen, miltä kauppa asiakkaan silmissä näyttää ja tuntuu.

Työtehtävät sisältävät muun muassa:

  • Asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja pakettipalveluiden hoitamista
  • Aktiivista myyntityötä sekä asiakkaiden auttamista
  • Tavaroiden hyllytystä ja houkuttelevien esillepanojen rakentamista
  • Muita päivittäisen kaupan tehtäviä

Meillä kaikki toimivat tehtävissään kaupan pelisääntöjen ja arvojen mukaisesti; tavoitteinamme asiakastyytyväisyys, myynti ja toiminnan sujuvuus. Arvostamme vastuunottokykyä sekä tehokasta ja huolellista työskentelyotetta. Uskomme myös, että tyytyväinen työntekijä luo tyytyväisiä asiakkaita. Siksi teemmekin parhaamme, että meillä jokainen työntekijä viihtyy työssään!

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Reipasta ja itseohjautuvaa otetta työhön
  • Iloista asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä
  • Aitoa kiinnostusta kaupan alasta
  • Halua kehittyä ja oppia uutta
  • Vastuunottoa omasta työstä
  • Valmiutta työskennellä myös ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroissa
  • Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Vakituisen työn luotettavassa K-kaupassa
  • Mukavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön
  • Monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset ottamaan vastuuta
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittyä kaupan alan ammattilaisena
  • K-ryhmän henkilöstöedut ja ostoedun

Kokemus ja koulutus kaupan alasta on plussaa mutta ei pakollista, sillä koulutamme sinut tehtäviisi. Palkkaus on kaupan alan TES:n mukainen. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Työt alkavat marraskuun alussa sopimuksen mukaan.

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja CV 30.9.2026 mennessä oheisen linkin kautta. Tule mukaan tekemään Vimpelin parasta oman kylän kauppaa yhdessä meidän kanssamme!

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Mari Takala, mari.takala@k-market.com.

Rekrytointiin liittyvän tietosuojaselosteen saat rekrytoivasta kaupasta.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: Senior Product Manager- M365 Messaging
description:
Overview


The Microsoft 365 Messaging team builds and operates the trusted, secure, intelligent, and scalable messaging and notification platform that powers communication and collaboration across Microsoft 365. Our platform provides foundational messaging, conversation, notification, presence, and storage capabilities used by Microsoft Teams, Copilot, Outlook, ODSP, Dynamics, Intune and other Microsoft 365 experiences.

As a Senior Product Manager- M365 Messaging, you will define and deliver product investments that strengthen the shared messaging platform and enable new customer and partner scenarios. You will work closely with Microsoft Teams, Copilot, Outlook, and other Microsoft 365 partners to translate customer and business needs into durable platform capabilities that are secure, reliable, compliant, performant, and cost-effective.

This is a high-impact role for a product leader who can connect platform strategy to execution, navigate technical tradeoffs, and build alignment across multiple organizations. You will help shape priorities, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and drive measurable outcomes for services that operate at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Define product strategy, scenarios, requirements, and roadmap priorities for Microsoft 365 messaging platform capabilities.

  • Partner with IC3 engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective messaging services.

  • Collaborate with Microsoft Teams, Copilot, Outlook, ODSP, Dynamics, and other Microsoft 365 partners to identify shared needs and drive reusable platform solutions.

  • Translate partner, customer, compliance, and operational requirements into clear product specifications, success criteria, and phased delivery plans.

  • Drive cross-organizational alignment on priorities, architecture decisions, dependencies, and adoption plans while influencing without direct authority.

  • Identify patterns across partner scenarios and guide teams toward common schemas, APIs, platform primitives, and service standards instead of one-off implementations.

  • Use data and customer signals to define goals and improve reliability, latency, quality, usage, cost efficiency, and operational health.

  • Champion enterprise trust by incorporating security, privacy, compliance, auditability, data lifecycle, and resiliency requirements into product plans.

  • Manage multi-team execution, surface risks early, and develop mitigation plans with engineering and product leaders.

  • Communicate product direction, technical tradeoffs, progress, risks, and decisions to engineering teams, partner organizations, and leadership.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years experience taking a product, feature, or experience to market (e.g., design, addressing product market fit, and launch, internal tool/framework).
  • 4+ years experience improving product metrics for a product, feature, or experience in a market (e.g., growing customer base, expanding customer usage, avoiding customer churn).
  • 4+ years experience disrupting a market for a product, feature, or experience (e.g., competitive disruption, taking the place of an established competing product).
  • Demonstrated ownership of a platform, infrastructure, or enterprise service product, including strategy, roadmap, requirements, and partner adoption.
  • Experience translating complex partner and customer requirements into durable, reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off integrations.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-organizational technical strategy and execution across engineering, product, design, and operations teams.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and product decisions to engineering teams, senior leaders, and executives.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems, messaging, storage, real-time communication, pub/sub, notification, or presence platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI and Copilot scenarios, agentic workflows, conversation systems, or notification experiences.
  • Experience defining and driving non-functional requirements such as reliability, latency, security, compliance, auditability, resiliency, and cost.
  • Experience leading multi-team, multi-quarter initiatives with cross-organizational dependencies and phased delivery plans.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where customer needs, technical constraints, and partner priorities evolve in parallel.
